jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.
Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $75K - $95K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $75K - $95K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

We’re Not Looking for a Content Calendar Manager. We’re Looking for a Content Strategist Who Can Build the Engine.

Level Agency is hiring a Senior Content Strategist to build and run the content system that makes Level impossible to ignore.

This is not a “write the blog, post the recap, update the newsletter” role. This is for someone who can turn agency expertise into sharp market positioning, credible thought leadership, useful sales enablement, and repeatable content systems that actually support growth.

You’ll own the strategy behind how Level shows up in the market: what we say, why it matters, where it goes, how it supports pipeline, and how we use AI to produce smarter, faster, better work without lowering the bar.

You’ll work across owned channels, web content, case studies, sales enablement, podcast and event content, and internal subject matter experts. You’ll be expected to bring strong editorial judgment, operational discipline, and real AI fluency — not theory, not dabbling, not “I use ChatGPT sometimes.”

Success in this role means Level has a point of view worth following, the sales team always has relevant proof points to share, and content production runs like a system — not a series of last-minute sprints.

This role reports to the SVP of Marketing and Sales Enablement.

This Isn’t for Everyone.

We’re building something rare: a place where growth, truth, and high performance go hand-in-hand.

You’ll thrive here if:

✅ You’re a strong writer with sharp editorial instincts and a high bar for quality.
✅ You can turn complex marketing, performance, and business ideas into clear, compelling content.
✅ You think in systems — calendars, workflows, briefs, approval paths, repurposing plans, and distribution logic.
✅ You know content is only valuable when it helps build trust, move pipeline, sharpen positioning, or create demand.
✅ You’re genuinely fluent with AI tools and excited to build workflows other people can use.
✅ You can partner with sales, strategy, account teams, executives, clients, and subject matter experts without losing momentum.
✅ You’re comfortable owning ambiguity, asking better questions, and pushing work from idea to published asset.

And you’ll struggle here if:

❌ You want to be handed fully formed assignments instead of shaping the strategy.
❌ You treat AI as a shortcut instead of a system to improve speed, quality, and leverage.
❌ You need perfect inputs before you can start building.
❌ You’re focused only on writing, not on distribution, sales usefulness, or business impact.
❌ You struggle to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines at once.
❌ You protect the draft more than the outcome.

About Level

We’re an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We’ve been named one of Pittsburgh’s Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Senior Content Strategist, you’ll own the strategy, systems, and execution behind Level’s content engine. You’ll define what gets made, why it matters, how it supports go-to-market priorities, and how it gets produced at a high standard.

You’ll sit at the intersection of brand positioning, performance marketing expertise, sales enablement, AI-enabled workflows, and editorial execution.

You’ll:

  • Own Editorial Strategy: Lead Level’s content strategy across owned channels, including the website, blog, podcast, newsletter, social, and sales enablement.
  • Build the Content Calendar: Develop and maintain a 90-day content calendar tied to go-to-market priorities, active verticals, events, conferences, and sales needs.
  • Turn Expertise into Thought Leadership: Translate Level’s internal expertise into differentiated content that practitioners, buyers, and clients find credible and worth sharing.
  • Create Scalable Content Systems: Build repeatable workflows, templates, briefs, review loops, and production systems that make content creation more efficient and consistent.
  • Lead AI-Integrated Content Workflows: Use AI tools for research, drafting, repurposing, summarization, content scoring, search optimization, and distribution planning — while maintaining human judgment and editorial quality.
  • Own Web Content Strategy: Guide content for vertical pages, service pages, campaign landing pages, and other key website assets in partnership with design, SEO, and AI search teams.
  • Optimize for Search and AI Discovery: Structure content to perform across traditional organic search and AI-driven discovery surfaces like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
  • Lead Case Study Strategy: Own the pipeline, standards, production, and publishing cadence for case studies, including stories built in Level’s CAISR format: Challenge, Analysis, Insight, Strategy, Result.
  • Support Sales Enablement: Partner with sales and marketing leaders to create one-pagers, vertical-specific decks, objection-handling content, competitive positioning, and other assets that help move opportunities forward.
  • Coordinate Stakeholders: Work with account leads, strategists, subject matter experts, clients, freelancers, contractors, and internal teams to get accurate, approved, on-brand content published.
  • Repurpose with Purpose: Turn podcasts, events, case studies, internal expertise, and campaign learnings into useful content across multiple formats and channels.
  • Keep Quality High: Protect Level’s voice, standards, accuracy, and credibility across everything we publish.
  • Contribute Beyond the Core: Depending on your background, you may also support podcast operations, agency award submissions, event content strategy, conference recaps, or PR-related content.

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years of content experience. You’ve built content in professional environments and have at least 2 years in a strategy, senior individual contributor, or team lead capacity.
  • Strong writing and editorial judgment. You can turn complex ideas, performance data, strategy, and stakeholder input into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Content strategy experience. You’ve owned content plans, editorial direction, calendars, channel strategy, and production priorities — not just individual assignments.
  • Experience building content systems. You know how to create repeatable workflows, templates, approval processes, and production pipelines that help teams scale.
  • Hands-on AI content experience. You’ve used AI tools in real workflows for research, drafting, repurposing, summarization, content scoring, search optimization, or workflow design.
  • Project management strength. You can manage multiple concurrent workstreams, set deadlines, keep stakeholders moving, and follow through without being chased.
  • Stakeholder management skills. You’re comfortable interviewing and coordinating with executives, internal experts, account leads, sales teams, clients, freelancers, and contractors.
  • Long-form content experience. You’ve produced assets such as case studies, research reports, white papers, editorial articles, thought leadership, or sales enablement content.
  • Comfort with interviews. You can conduct qualitative interviews with internal and external stakeholders and turn messy input into useful content.
  • High quality bar. You catch gaps, inconsistencies, unclear claims, weak structure, and off-brand language before content goes live.
  • Self-directed work habits. You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable using project management tools to keep work visible and moving.
  • WordPress familiarity. You have experience publishing or editing web content in WordPress and basic comfort with HTML/CSS for formatting and on-page edits.

Strong Preferences

  • B2B, agency, or professional services experience. You understand how expert-led businesses build credibility and move considered buyers through content.
  • Performance marketing exposure. You understand how content supports demand generation, pipeline, proof, and sales conversations.
  • Sales enablement experience. You’ve created assets that sales teams actually use, including one-pagers, pitch materials, objection-handling content, or vertical-specific content.
  • Case study experience. You know how to identify strong stories, pull useful details from stakeholders, and shape proof into a compelling business narrative.
  • Podcast or multimedia workflow experience. You’ve helped manage podcast production, content repurposing, or multimedia editorial systems.
  • Agency award experience. You’ve researched award opportunities, written submissions, managed deadlines, or supported PR and credibility-building efforts.
  • HubSpot or similar CMS/marketing automation experience.
  • Experience optimizing content for AI-driven discovery platforms like AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini.

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a skillset — not a shortcut. In this role, AI fluency is not optional. You’ll be expected to work at the frontier of AI-enabled content strategy, not just keep pace with it.

You’ll be expected to:

  • Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Midjourney, and other AI platforms to improve how you research, create, edit, repurpose, and distribute content.
  • Build and document AI-assisted content workflows that other team members can follow, adapt, and improve.
  • Create and maintain prompt libraries, content brief templates, editorial review loops, humanization checkpoints, and production frameworks.
  • Experiment with AI tools across writing, research, image generation, summarization, content scoring, search optimization, and distribution.
  • Stay current on how AI platforms surface, cite, summarize, and recommend content — and ensure Level’s content strategy accounts for those channels.
  • Evaluate new tools with a practitioner’s eye, not a vendor’s pitch.
  • Share your prompts, process improvements, use cases, and learnings with the team.
  • Approach AI with an iterative mindset. The first workflow is rarely the best one.
  • AI is not a shortcut. It is infrastructure. In this role, you’ll help build and maintain that infrastructure while protecting the judgment, taste, accuracy, and accountability that great content requires.

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
  • Better Every Day
    We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
  • Driven by Truth
    We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.

Let’s build something together.Télétravail - États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein

Rémunération :

  • 75 000 $ - 95 000 $ USD (candidats basés aux États-Unis)
  • 80 000 $ - 100 000 $ CAD (candidats basés au Canada)

Nous ne cherchons pas une personne qui gère simplement un calendrier de contenu. Nous cherchons une stratège de contenu capable de bâtir le moteur.

Level Agency embauche un ou une stratège de contenu sénior pour bâtir et piloter le système de contenu qui rend Level impossible à ignorer.

Ce n’est pas un rôle où l’on se contente de « rédiger l’article, publier le résumé, mettre l’infolettre à jour ». C’est un rôle pour une personne capable de transformer l’expertise de l’agence en positionnement clair, en leadership éclairé crédible, en contenu utile pour les ventes et en systèmes de production reproductibles qui soutiennent réellement la croissance.

Vous serez responsable de la stratégie derrière la façon dont Level se présente sur le marché : ce que nous disons, pourquoi c’est important, où le contenu est diffusé, comment il soutient le pipeline, et comment nous utilisons l’IA pour produire un travail plus intelligent, plus rapide et de meilleure qualité — sans baisser nos standards.

Vous travaillerez sur nos canaux propriétaires, le contenu web, les études de cas, le contenu d’aide à la vente, les balados, le contenu événementiel et la collaboration avec nos expertes et experts internes. Vous devrez faire preuve d’un excellent jugement éditorial, d’une grande rigueur opérationnelle et d’une vraie aisance avec l’IA — pas seulement de la théorie, pas seulement des essais occasionnels avec ChatGPT.

La réussite dans ce rôle signifie que Level aura un point de vue que les gens veulent suivre, que l’équipe des ventes aura toujours des preuves pertinentes à partager, et que la production de contenu fonctionnera comme un système — pas comme une suite de sprints de dernière minute.

Ce rôle relève de la SVP du marketing et de l’aide à la vente.

Ce rôle n’est pas pour tout le monde.

Nous bâtissons quelque chose de rare : un endroit où la croissance, la vérité et la haute performance vont de pair.

Vous allez vous épanouir ici si :

✅ Vous êtes une excellente rédactrice ou un excellent rédacteur avec un solide instinct éditorial et des standards de qualité élevés.
✅ Vous savez transformer des idées complexes liées au marketing, à la performance et aux affaires en contenu clair et convaincant.
✅ Vous pensez en systèmes : calendriers, flux de travail, briefs, processus d’approbation, plans de réutilisation et logique de distribution.
✅ Vous savez que le contenu n’a de valeur que s’il bâtit la confiance, soutient le pipeline, clarifie le positionnement ou crée de la demande.
✅ Vous êtes réellement à l’aise avec les outils d’IA et motivé(e) à bâtir des flux de travail que d’autres pourront utiliser.
✅ Vous savez collaborer avec les équipes de vente, de stratégie, de comptes, la direction, les clients et les expertes et experts de contenu sans perdre le rythme.
✅ Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’ambiguïté, vous posez de meilleures questions et vous faites avancer le travail de l’idée à la publication.

Et vous risquez de trouver ce rôle difficile si :

❌ Vous voulez recevoir des mandats entièrement définis au lieu de contribuer à façonner la stratégie.
❌ Vous voyez l’IA comme un raccourci plutôt que comme un système pour améliorer la vitesse, la qualité et l’effet de levier.
❌ Vous avez besoin d’intrants parfaits avant de commencer à bâtir.
❌ Vous vous concentrez seulement sur la rédaction, sans penser à la distribution, à l’utilité pour les ventes ou à l’impact d’affaires.
❌ Vous avez de la difficulté à gérer plusieurs chantiers, parties prenantes et échéances en même temps.
❌ Vous protégez le brouillon plus que le résultat.

À propos de Level

Nous sommes une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA — bâtie pour la précision, conçue pour évoluer et guidée par une mentalité scientifique. Chez Level, nous combinons stratégie, médias, création et intelligence machine pour livrer des résultats qui comptent. Chaque fois. À grande échelle.

Nous avons été nommés parmi les meilleurs lieux de travail de Pittsburgh et reconnus comme l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide du classement Inc. 500. Nos clients œuvrent notamment en B2B, en éducation, en santé, en services financiers, en commerce électronique et dans plusieurs autres secteurs.

Votre rôle et votre impact

À titre de stratège de contenu sénior, vous serez responsable de la stratégie, des systèmes et de l’exécution derrière le moteur de contenu de Level. Vous définirez ce qui doit être créé, pourquoi c’est important, comment le contenu soutient les priorités de mise en marché et comment le produire selon des standards élevés.

Vous serez au croisement du positionnement de marque, de l’expertise en marketing de performance, de l’aide à la vente, des flux de travail propulsés par l’IA et de l’exécution éditoriale.

Vous allez :

  • Piloter la stratégie éditoriale : Diriger la stratégie de contenu de Level sur nos canaux propriétaires, y compris le site web, le blogue, le balado, l’infolettre, les médias sociaux et le contenu d’aide à la vente.
  • Bâtir le calendrier de contenu : Développer et maintenir un calendrier de contenu sur 90 jours aligné sur les priorités de mise en marché, les verticales actives, les événements, les conférences et les besoins de l’équipe des ventes.
  • Transformer l’expertise en leadership éclairé : Traduire l’expertise interne de Level en contenu différencié que les praticiens, les acheteurs et les clients trouvent crédible et digne d’être partagé.
  • Créer des systèmes de contenu évolutifs : Bâtir des flux de travail, modèles, briefs, boucles de révision et systèmes de production reproductibles qui rendent la création de contenu plus efficace et plus constante.
  • Diriger les flux de travail de contenu intégrant l’IA : Utiliser des outils d’IA pour la recherche, la rédaction, la réutilisation, la synthèse, l’évaluation du contenu, l’optimisation pour la recherche et la planification de distribution — tout en maintenant le jugement humain et la qualité éditoriale.
  • Définir la stratégie de contenu web : Orienter le contenu des pages verticales, pages de services, pages de destination de campagne et autres actifs web clés, en partenariat avec les équipes de design, de SEO et de recherche IA.
  • Optimiser pour la recherche et la découverte par l’IA : Structurer le contenu afin qu’il performe dans la recherche organique traditionnelle et sur les surfaces de découverte propulsées par l’IA, comme Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity et Gemini.
  • Piloter la stratégie d’études de cas : Gérer le pipeline, les standards, la production et la cadence de publication des études de cas, y compris les récits bâtis selon le format CAISR de Level : Challenge, Analysis, Insight, Strategy, Result.
  • Soutenir l’aide à la vente : Collaborer avec les leaders des ventes et du marketing pour créer des fiches d’une page, des présentations propres à certaines verticales, du contenu de traitement des objections, du positionnement concurrentiel et d’autres actifs qui aident à faire avancer les occasions d’affaires.
  • Coordonner les parties prenantes : Travailler avec les responsables de comptes, les stratèges, les expertes et experts de contenu, les clients, les pigistes, les contractuels et les équipes internes pour publier du contenu exact, approuvé et aligné sur la marque.
  • Réutiliser le contenu avec intention : Transformer les balados, événements, études de cas, expertises internes et apprentissages de campagne en contenu utile sur plusieurs formats et canaux.
  • Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité : Protéger la voix, les standards, l’exactitude et la crédibilité de Level dans tout ce que nous publions.
  • Contribuer au-delà du rôle principal : Selon votre expérience, vous pourriez aussi soutenir les opérations de balado, les soumissions à des prix de l’industrie, la stratégie de contenu événementiel, les résumés de conférences ou le contenu lié aux relations publiques.

Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie.

Exigences

Essentiels

  • 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en contenu. Vous avez créé du contenu dans des environnements professionnels et possédez au moins 2 ans d’expérience dans un rôle stratégique, de contributrice ou contributeur individuel sénior, ou de leadership d’équipe.
  • Solides compétences en rédaction et jugement éditorial. Vous savez transformer des idées complexes, des données de performance, de la stratégie et les commentaires des parties prenantes en récits clairs et convaincants.
  • Expérience en stratégie de contenu. Vous avez déjà pris en charge des plans de contenu, une direction éditoriale, des calendriers, une stratégie de canaux et des priorités de production — pas seulement des mandats individuels.
  • Expérience dans la création de systèmes de contenu. Vous savez mettre en place des flux de travail, modèles, processus d’approbation et pipelines de production reproductibles qui aident les équipes à évoluer.
  • Expérience pratique avec l’IA appliquée au contenu. Vous avez utilisé des outils d’IA dans de vrais flux de travail pour la recherche, la rédaction, la réutilisation, la synthèse, l’évaluation du contenu, l’optimisation pour la recherche ou la conception de processus.
  • Forces en gestion de projet. Vous pouvez gérer plusieurs chantiers en parallèle, fixer des échéances, faire avancer les parties prenantes et assurer le suivi sans qu’on ait à vous relancer.
  • Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes. Vous êtes à l’aise de mener des entrevues et de coordonner avec des membres de la direction, des expertes et experts internes, des responsables de comptes, des équipes de vente, des clients, des pigistes et des contractuels.
  • Expérience en contenu long format. Vous avez produit des actifs comme des études de cas, rapports de recherche, livres blancs, articles éditoriaux, contenu de leadership éclairé ou contenu d’aide à la vente.
  • Aisance avec les entrevues. Vous savez mener des entrevues qualitatives avec des parties prenantes internes et externes, puis transformer des intrants parfois désordonnés en contenu utile.
  • Standards de qualité élevés. Vous repérez les lacunes, incohérences, affirmations floues, structures faibles et formulations qui ne correspondent pas à la marque avant la publication.
  • Habitudes de travail autonomes. Vous êtes organisé(e), proactif(ve) et à l’aise avec les outils de gestion de projet pour garder le travail visible et en mouvement.
  • Familiarité avec WordPress. Vous avez de l’expérience dans la publication ou la modification de contenu web dans WordPress, ainsi qu’une aisance de base avec HTML/CSS pour la mise en forme et les ajustements sur page.

Atouts importants

  • Expérience en B2B, en agence ou en services professionnels. Vous comprenez comment les entreprises fondées sur l’expertise bâtissent leur crédibilité et accompagnent des acheteurs dans des décisions réfléchies.
  • Exposition au marketing de performance. Vous comprenez comment le contenu soutient la génération de demande, le pipeline, les preuves et les conversations de vente.
  • Expérience en aide à la vente. Vous avez créé des actifs que les équipes de vente utilisent réellement, comme des fiches d’une page, du matériel de présentation, du contenu de traitement des objections ou du contenu propre à certaines verticales.
  • Expérience en études de cas. Vous savez repérer les bonnes histoires, extraire les détails utiles auprès des parties prenantes et transformer des preuves en récit d’affaires convaincant.
  • Expérience avec les balados ou les flux de travail multimédias. Vous avez contribué à gérer la production de balados, la réutilisation de contenu ou des systèmes éditoriaux multimédias.
  • Expérience avec les prix d’agence. Vous avez recherché des occasions de prix, rédigé des soumissions, géré des échéances ou soutenu des efforts de relations publiques et de crédibilité.
  • Expérience avec HubSpot ou un CMS/outil d’automatisation marketing semblable.
  • Expérience en optimisation de contenu pour les plateformes de découverte propulsées par l’IA, comme AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity ou Gemini.

Attentes liées à l’IA

Chez Level, l’IA est une compétence — pas un raccourci. Dans ce rôle, l’aisance avec l’IA est essentielle. Vous devrez travailler à l’avant-garde de la stratégie de contenu propulsée par l’IA, pas simplement suivre le rythme.

Vous devrez :

  • Utiliser des outils comme ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Midjourney et d’autres plateformes d’IA pour améliorer votre façon de rechercher, créer, réviser, réutiliser et distribuer le contenu.
  • Bâtir et documenter des flux de travail de contenu assistés par l’IA que d’autres membres de l’équipe pourront suivre, adapter et améliorer.
  • Créer et maintenir des bibliothèques de prompts, des modèles de briefs de contenu, des boucles de révision éditoriale, des points de contrôle d’humanisation et des cadres de production.
  • Expérimenter avec des outils d’IA pour la rédaction, la recherche, la génération d’images, la synthèse, l’évaluation du contenu, l’optimisation pour la recherche et la distribution.
  • Rester à jour sur la façon dont les plateformes d’IA présentent, citent, résument et recommandent le contenu — et vous assurer que la stratégie de contenu de Level tient explicitement compte de ces canaux.
  • Évaluer les nouveaux outils avec un regard de praticien(ne), et non à partir d’un argumentaire de fournisseur.
  • Partager vos prompts, améliorations de processus, cas d’usage et apprentissages avec l’équipe.
  • Aborder l’IA avec une mentalité itérative. Le premier flux de travail est rarement le meilleur.
  • L’IA n’est pas un raccourci. C’est une infrastructure. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à bâtir et maintenir cette infrastructure tout en protégeant le jugement, le goût, l’exactitude et la responsabilité que requiert un excellent contenu.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • No Ego, All In
    Ici, on ne dit pas « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous mettons la main à la pâte quand c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
  • Better Every Day
    Nous voulons recevoir la rétroaction — même quand elle pique. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons à élever la barre.
  • Relentless for Results
    L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Nous nous concentrons sur le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
  • Driven by Truth
    Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, suivons les données et disons aux clients ce qu’ils doivent entendre — pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.

Avantages et bénéfices

Chez Level, nous soutenons nos équipes aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, incluant des congés payés illimités aux États-Unis, des vacances concurrentielles au Canada et des options de congé parental/familial
  • Avantages complets en santé, soutien en santé mentale et assurances invalidité et vie payées par l’entreprise
  • Cotisations de retraite de l’employeur, 401(k) aux États-Unis et contribution REER au Canada
  • Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et occasions d’avancement professionnel

Priorité au télétravail

Ce rôle est ouvert aux résidentes et résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement à distance. Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de commanditer des visas pour le moment.

Level est fondée sur l’inclusion

Nous sommes engagés envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance. Level est fière d’être un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi — nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes.

Prêt(e) à postuler?

Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez le temps de bien le faire.

Ce qui nous importe le plus, c’est votre façon de penser, de bâtir et de créer de l’impact — pas que votre parcours ait été parfaitement linéaire.

The Work:

ICF seeks an experienced Quality Assurance Analyst to support the phased implementation of an enterprise grants management platform built on Salesforce Agentforce Public Sector. The Quality Assurance Analyst will develop test plans, test cases, scripts, and traceability artifacts to validate grants lifecycle workflows, integrations, data migrations, security controls, and accessibility requirements. This role will perform functional, regression, integration, and release testing; document and manage defects through resolution; support automated testing; and coordinate user acceptance testing with business analysts, developers, product owners, and government stakeholders. The Quality Assurance Analyst will help confirm that each release meets acceptance criteria and is ready for secure, reliable production deployment.


Job Location: Remote work is authorized. Must support US Eastern time zone working hours.

*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections. 


What You Will Do:

  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate Salesforce application functionality, workflows, configuration changes, integrations, reports, dashboards, and user experience.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, accessibility, and release validation testing across Salesforce environments, including Integration, Stage, and Production readiness activities.
  • Support testing for major releases, minor releases, hotfixes, modernization activities, and platform-wide Salesforce changes.
  • Validate Salesforce enterprise tools and operational capabilities such as release management portals, ticketing workflows, license tracking, user separation, helpdesk reporting, and other internal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with developers, administrators, business analysts, release engineers, technical architects, and stakeholders to understand requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical design documents, and system workflows.

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, or similar platforms, ensuring timely resolution, retesting, and closure.
  • Support incident response and production issue validation by reproducing defects, validating fixes, supporting root cause analysis, and confirming that hotfixes resolve reported issues without introducing regression risk.
  • Perform integration testing involving APIs, service accounts, connected applications, Salesforce org-to-org, app-to-app, and third-party integrations.
  • Support user acceptance testing by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with business users, documenting outcomes, and validating that delivered functionality meets stakeholder needs.
  • Validate data quality, data integrity, field mappings, reporting outputs, and migration or synchronization results when data changes are introduced.
  • Create and maintain QA documentation, including test plans, test scripts, test evidence, defect reports, traceability matrices, release validation summaries, and quality metrics.
  • Support Quality Control Metrics reporting by tracking testing progress, defect trends, release readiness, escaped defects, retest results, and other quality indicators.
  • Validate compliance with Section 508 requirements for user-facing functionality, reports, portals, dashboards, and documentation where applicable.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, test automation opportunities, regression test libraries, release checklists, and defect management workflows.

  • Support occasional off-hours release validation, hotfix testing, or urgent production issue support as needed.

  • U.S. citizenship is required.

  • Experience supporting a federal grants management, case management, or comparable enterprise platform implementation.
  • Experience with automated testing tools and incorporating regression testing into CI/CD pipelines.

jobs.excerpt: K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit.
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer whose role will be to verify the functionality, performance, and robustness of our custom silicon designs. You will help define the verification approach, contribute to methodology, and work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers. This is a hands-on role with high ownership, deep technical engagement, and the opportunity to shape first-generation silicon.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute verification plans for block-level, subsystem-level, and full-chip environments. Build SystemVerilog/UVM test benches, including agents, monitors, scoreboards, checkers, and coverage models.
  • Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and integrate formal verification where appropriate.
  • Drive constrained-random and directed testing strategies to validate functionality, corner cases, and stress scenarios.
  • Run simulations, triage failures, drive root-cause analysis, and collaborate with RTL designers to resolve issues.
  • Implement and maintain functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, and ensure coverage closure for sign-off.
  • Manage regression testing, simulation farms, and CI pipelines to ensure high test throughput and fast debug iterations.
  • Participate in design reviews, microarchitecture discussions, and influence design-for-verification (DFV) best practices.
  • Work closely with architecture, RTL design, DFT, firmware, physical design, and silicon validation engineers to ensure end-to-end coverage and test.
  • Support silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation through test reuse, diagnostics, and debug analysis.
  • Participate in ASIC team interviews.
  • Contribute to advancement of DV methodologies and improvements.
  • Engage external IP providers and verification partners when needed.

Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
  • Solid understanding of SystemVerilog, digital logic, RTL design, and hardware verification flows.
  • Proficiency with a simulation (VCS, Xcelium, Questa), waveform debug (Verdi, SimVision), coverage tool, and scripting languages (ex: Python, Perl, TCL).
  • Experience with testplanning, UVM-based testbench development, constrained-random testing, functional coverage, and SystemVerilog assertions.
  • Experience with regression management, coverage analysis, revision control (Git), and CI/CD automation.
  • Understanding of several industry-standard interfaces (ex: APB/AHB/AXI).
  • Familiarity with embedded processor-based designs and firmware/bare metal coding (ex: C, C++).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with developing and integrating reference models.
  • Understanding of low power verification.
  • Familiarity with gate-level simulation and analog behavioral models.
  • Involvement in post-silicon validation planning and execution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience in space, telecom, or RF/digital mixed systems is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $250,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, datasets, and automation systems that support cloud cost visibility, attribution, and performance insights.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, datasets, and automation systems that support cloud cost visibility, attribution, and performance insights.

This role will work with large-scale telemetry, usage, and financial data to help Product, Engineering, and Finance stakeholders make informed, cost-aware decisions. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with cloud data engineering, AWS, Snowflake, production pipeline ownership, data quality, and performance and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable end-to-end ELT and ETL pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Build scalable datasets that support cloud cost visibility, attribution, usage analysis, and performance insights.
  • Design and implement data models and ingestion frameworks for large-scale telemetry and usage data.
  • Develop automation and tooling that enable cost-aware decision-making across Product, Engineering, and Finance teams.
  • Optimize data pipelines and systems for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Perform query tuning and improve storage and compute strategies.
  • Build and maintain integrations with REST APIs and other data sources.
  • Implement and support CI/CD processes and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Ensure data quality, validation, auditability, and consistency across end-to-end data workflows.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production pipeline failures, data inconsistencies, and performance issues.
  • Partner with Engineering and Finance stakeholders on cloud cost optimization and usage-based insights.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong data engineering foundation with proven experience building and maintaining end-to-end ELT or ETL pipelines in cloud environments.

* Strong SQL and Python skills.

  • Experience with data workflow and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow, or Dagster.
  • Hands-on experience with the AWS data ecosystem, including AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, and Amazon Aurora.

* Experience with Snowflake.

* Strong data modeling experience.

* Experience processing data at scale.

  • Experience with CI/CD and version control.
  • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform.
  • Experience building or maintaining REST API integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize data pipelines for performance and cost.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with data validation, auditing, and production pipeline support.
  • Enterprise experience strongly preferred.

Nice-to-Have Skills

* Scala experience.

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Engineer certification.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization, tagging strategies, or cost-monitoring systems.
  • Experience working across both AWS and GCP.

* Experience with Datadog.

  • Background in data platform engineering or shared infrastructure engineering.

Required Tools & Platforms

* Python

* SQL

* AWS Glue

* Amazon Athena

* Amazon Aurora

* Snowflake

* dbt, Airflow, or Dagster

* Terraform

* CI/CD tooling

  • Git or another version-control platform

* REST APIs

Location, Time & Engagement

* Remote contract opportunity.

* Candidates must be located in LATAM.

  • Full-time allocation of approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Candidates must be available to work a U.S.-based EST or CST schedule.
  • Contract expected to continue through March 31, 2027.

Manager, SaaS Software Sourcing & Procurement

Keep innovation moving and your career advancing as the Manager of SaaS/AI Application Sourcing & Procurement at GDIT. Your leadership will drive strategic SaaS software negotiations, ensure regulatory compliance, and empower your team to deliver cost savings and process excellence across the SaaS portfolio.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As the Manager of the SaaS Sourcing & Procurement team, you will lead a high-performing group of sourcing specialists focused on end-to-end SaaS lifecycle management—from market research and RFPs through negotiation, ordering, renewals, and supplier performance. You will partner closely with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Technology, Finance, Legal, Security/Compliance, and program teams to secure the right solutions on the right terms for GDIT’s internal operations and customer missions.

You will set clear priorities, standardize execution, and raise the bar on negotiation rigor and FAR-compliant procurement discipline. Your work will enable the SaaS team to make informed decisions, accelerate high-impact initiatives, and maintain strong relationships with critical SaaS providers while managing risk, cost, and contractual obligations.

In this role you will:

  • Lead and develop the SaaS/AI application sourcing team— coaching day-to-day execution, establishing standards for vendor selection, negotiations, and RFPs, and ensuring implementation of category strategy and goal completion.

  • Own complex SaaS negotiations and agreement reviews (EULAs/SLAs/DPAs/Order Forms/Master Agreements), with emphasis on pricing, usage/true-up mechanics, audit rights, data security/privacy, and termination/renewal clauses.

  • Ensure all sourcing execution adheres to GDIT’s internal compliance standards and government contracting requirements, including FAR and other applicable regulations.

  • Run disciplined sourcing processes: market research, competitive benchmarking, total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis, and commercial risk assessments; drive outcomes through negotiation plans.

  • Manage recurring operational responsibilities (pipeline, renewals calendar, dashboards, metrics, ad hoc reporting), ensuring accuracy, insight, and timely delivery.

  • Standardize SaaS procurement processes and artifacts (playbooks, templates, checklists); identify automation and continuous improvement opportunities and lead implementation.

  • Support executive-level engagements with strategic suppliers; prepare leadership-ready briefings and recommendations that distill complex commercial and compliance topics into clear decisions.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree; 4+ years of additional relevant experience may substitute for a degree.

• Experience: 5+ years in procurement/strategic sourcing with a focus on software; proven experience leading sourcing projects or teams. SaaS procurement experience is a plus.

• Government procurement: Required hands-on experience in FAR-compliant environments and government contracting; comfortable with federal rules, clauses, and flowdowns.

• Negotiations: Experience negotiating terms/conditions for software, including pricing constructs, usage/true-up, audit/verification, DPAs/security, and renewal/termination mechanics.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SORTLYSortly is a simple, multi-device inventory management solution.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SORTLY

Sortly is a simple, multi-device inventory management solution. Our visual & intuitive approach to inventory enables thousands of SMBs and teams within iconic corporations, government entities, music bands & sports teams to stay on top of their consumables, assets, and material things. With over 8,000 five-star ratings in the App Store and a net promoter score greater than 55, our impressive growth has primarily been driven by organic sources and word of mouth. We are profitable, financially independent, and primed to scale within our $20B market! We are proudly a distributed and remote-first company since inception with teams across 4 countries.

OUR VALUES

Real - We lead with authenticity, show transparency through being honest and clear, and take accountability by owning our actions and outcomes.

Inspiring - We think big, empower others to achieve their best, and celebrate wins by recognizing large and small contributions.

Smart - We demonstrate First Principles thinking by always asking “why” and seek to understand deeply, embrace growth mindset and drive decisions with data.

Empathetic - We are humble and listen with an open mind, show up mentally and emotionally to make others feel valued, and consider how our actions impact others.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager to join our growing Organic Marketing team. This is a hands-on role for an experienced content marketer, creator, and problem solver. You'll turn strategy into high-quality programs across our blog, email, organic social, and other priority content initiatives.

Search is changing fast. AI-driven discovery is reshaping how buyers find, evaluate, and cite brands. Reporting to the Director of Organic Marketing, you'll help spearhead content marketing at Sortly and build our visibility across traditional SEO, AI-driven search, and owned channels. You'll lead day-to-day content planning and production and manage our agency and freelance partners.

Beyond always-on publishing, you'll help develop more authoritative and differentiated content. That includes proprietary research and benchmark studies, deeper data-rich editorial, competitive content, customer stories, and demand generation assets. You'll turn proprietary data, customer stories, and product messaging into compelling editorial that builds authority and sets Sortly apart. You'll also collaborate closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Data, and other teams on integrated campaigns, product initiatives, and cross-functional priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content Marketing & SEO

  • Execute against Sortly's evolving organic search strategy by developing richer, more authoritative, better-optimized content that performs across both traditional and AI-driven search.
  • Lead editorial planning and production across the blog and priority web content. Manage the editorial calendar and move work from brief through publication while maintaining quality, consistency, and publishing velocity.
  • Draft and shape high-value editorial assets, including deeper data-rich blog content, competitive content, customer stories, and gated demand generation assets such as lead magnets and event content.
  • Partner with our Data team to develop proprietary research and benchmark studies, translating analysis and findings into compelling narratives and finished content.
  • Build and refine AI-assisted workflows across research, outlining, drafting, editing, and optimization to scale production without compromising quality or brand voice.
  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of our agency and freelance relationships, handling assignments, editorial feedback, production timelines, and delivery.
  • Monitor content and channel performance and use the results to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.

Email Marketing

  • Own the weekly Inventory Insider newsletter, including planning, writing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
  • Improve newsletter performance through audience segmentation, testing, and iteration based on engagement and conversion data.
  • Collaborate with Demand Generation and Product Marketing on email content that supports broader campaigns and nurture programs.

Organic Social Media

  • Lead planning, content creation, and day-to-day execution across Sortly's organic social channels, including LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • Test new formats and approaches to improve engagement, reach, and brand visibility with priority audiences.
  • Repurpose editorial, research, customer, and campaign content into platform-native social content.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support company announcements, product launches, and integrated marketing campaigns.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing, preferably for B2B audiences.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills across formats, including blog and editorial, email, social, customer stories, and longer-form assets.
  • Hands-on experience managing content programs across multiple channels, such as blog, email, and organic social.
  • A strong understanding of SEO best practices and familiarity with emerging GEO and AI-search considerations.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve content research, creation, optimization, or production workflows.
  • A demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, data, and subject-matter expertise into clear, compelling content.
  • A proven ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, external partners, and deadlines while maintaining high editorial standards.
  • Experience using content performance data to identify opportunities and improve execution.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS.
  • Bonus points for experience with Construction or Field Services audiences, or with topics such as inventory management and asset tracking.
  • HubSpot and WordPress experience is a plus.

WHY JOIN SORTLY

  • Opportunity to work with a passionate and dedicated team
  • A culture that fosters innovation, growth, and collaboration
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Chance to make a significant impact on the future of inventory management
  • Annual off-site retreats
  • Home office stipend
  • 401k match
  • Yearly learning and development reimbursement

Annual Salary: $100,000 - $130,000

jobs.description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

The Workday Financials Data Conversion Lead will lead the Financials data conversion workstream for a higher education ERP modernization, supporting the migration from PeopleSoft Financials to Workday. This role serves as the primary client point of contact for Financials data conversion and is accountable for the workstream's strategy, scope, schedule, quality, risks, and deliverables. The Lead will direct the work of data conversion developers while remaining hands-on in data analysis, mapping, extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution.

What You Will Do

Workstream leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Financials data conversion workstream, including planning, scope, sequencing, estimates, milestones, dependencies, quality standards, and delivery.
  • Lead and coordinate the work of data conversion developers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables, resolving blockers, and ensuring consistent methods and documentation.
  • Serve as the primary Financials data conversion point of contact for the client, system integrator, functional leads, project management, and other technical workstreams.
  • Provide clear status updates and promptly identify, communicate, and escalate risks, issues, decisions, and cross-workstream dependencies.

Conversion strategy and requirements

  • Lead discovery and requirements sessions with system owners, functional area leads, and business stakeholders to define conversion scope, historical data requirements, priorities, reconciliation criteria, and acceptance standards.
  • Analyze PeopleSoft Financials data structures, schemas, tables, configurations, and business rules and translate them into a practical PeopleSoft-to-Workday conversion approach.
  • Own the Financials conversion strategy, methodology, data mapping framework, iteration plan, cutover approach, and readiness criteria.
  • Partner with Workday functional and technical teams to align source data with Workday business objects, foundational data models, load requirements, and downstream reporting or integration needs.

Hands-on conversion delivery

  • Lead and contribute directly to data profiling, extraction, mapping, transformation, cleansing, and validation activities across in-scope Financials domains.
  • Develop, review, and refine SQL, PeopleTools queries, extraction logic, transformation rules, reconciliation routines, and repeatable conversion scripts.
  • Ensure converted data is accurate, complete, balanced, secure, traceable, and compliant with applicable institutional and financial-control requirements.
  • Coordinate with the system integrator during Workday load cycles, respond quickly to questions, and direct updates to mappings, scripts, and source data as needed.

Testing validation and documentation

  • Plan and oversee mock conversions, unit and system testing, financial reconciliation, defect triage, remediation, and final conversion validation.
  • Define data-quality controls, balancing and reconciliation measures, and acceptance criteria and obtain appropriate business and functional sign-off.
  • Maintain complete documentation of scope, mappings, transformation rules, decisions, procedures, test results, defects, reconciliations, and cutover activities.
  • Partner closely with Financials functional, integration, reporting, security, testing, and change teams to ensure conversion activities align with the overall implementation plan.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of ERP data conversion experience, including experience leading a data conversion workstream or major conversion effort.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with PeopleSoft Financials data structures, tables, extraction methods, and conversion tools across multiple Financials modules.
  • Required experience supporting PeopleSoft-to-Workday data conversions, with a clear understanding of Workday data conversion and load processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and PeopleTools, including Application Designer; working knowledge of Integration Broker is strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of data profiling, mapping, modeling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, validation, and data-quality practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical team members, manage workstream priorities and dependencies, and hold deliverables to defined quality standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client expectations, facilitate decisions, communicate technical concepts clearly, and build trust across technical and functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and issue-resolution skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced implementation environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Workday Financials conversions in a higher education environment.
  • Experience across several PeopleSoft Financials domains, such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Management, Procurement, Projects, Grants, or Commitment Control.
  • Workday or PeopleSoft certification.
  • Experience participating in full-cycle ERP implementations, including mock conversions, cutover, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.
  • Translate and localize text strings (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other written content) from English into Malay, ensuring linguistic accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural appropriateness.
  • Support the delivery of high-quality curated audio data that ensures clear, natural spoken output, accurate representation of linguistic and prosodic details (such as intonation, rhythm, and accent), and professional audio standards.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to develop tasks that improve AI's ability to handle speech modulation, accent variation, noise in real-world recordings, and multilingual audio processing.
  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Native proficiency in Malay with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.
  • Strong auditory perception to identify nuances in speech, accents, pronunciation, intonation, and audio quality across languages.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate and localize text accurately between English and Malay, preserving meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.
  • Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, detail-oriented, and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate audio-related feedback effectively.
  • Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstration of exceptional attention to linguistic nuance, auditory detail, and data quality beyond standard transcription work.
  • Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.
  • Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.
  • Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.
  • Experience working with speech/audio datasets, annotation workflows, or AI training data, including knowledge/experience with training voice models, and an understanding of how data quality impacts model performance.
  • Experience with translation or localization workflows, particularly for software UI, product copy, or conversational AI text.
  • Professional experience in voice work, including voice acting, voice recording, podcasting with a measurable audience (e.g., X following), or similar audio production demonstrating attention to clarity and recording quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in ambiguous audio scenarios and make consistent, defensible annotation decisions.
  • Portfolio (strongly preferred for advanced candidates): Voice samples, annotated transcripts, or audio-related work demonstrating quality, methodology, and attention to detail.
  • Candidates with professional experience in voice, linguistics, speech data, or speech evaluation and research are especially encouraged to apply.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • Tutor roles may be offered as full-time, part-time, or contractor positions, depending on role needs and candidate fit.
  • For contractor positions, hours will vary widely based on project scope and contractor availability, with no fixed commitments required. On average, most projects may require at least 10 hours per week to deliver effectively, though this is not a fixed commitment and depends on the scope of work. Contractors have full flexibility to set their own hours and determine the exact amount of time needed to complete deliverables.

  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.

About the role

  • Lead client engagements that help private equity investors and technology businesses understand, improve and create value from technology.
  • Bring the judgement and communication skills of a trusted consultant: frame the question, lead senior client conversations, synthesise evidence and tell a clear, decision-useful story.
  • Apply genuine technology depth to assess strategy, product and engineering capability, architecture, delivery performance, data, cyber risk, scalability, technical debt and operating model.
  • Translate technical findings into commercial implications for growth, customer outcomes, margin, investment risk, timing, capital requirements and value creation.
  • Develop a recognised functional specialism and use it to bring differentiated insight to clients. Specialisms may include product and engineering, software architecture and cloud platforms, data and AI, cybersecurity, software delivery or technology operating model.
  • Work collaboratively with investment teams, management teams and Crosslake colleagues across technical, commercial, operational and financial workstreams.

Role responsibilities

  • Independently lead complex client engagements from scoping through to high-quality delivery, balancing client service, project management, team leadership and commercial awareness.
  • Build credibility quickly with senior investors, boards and management teams through sound judgement, clear communication and an ability to make complex issues accessible.
  • Deliver concise reports, executive presentations and workshops that connect technology findings to the decisions clients need to make.
  • Lead technical due diligence work that identifies material risks and opportunities, then help clients prioritise practical post-deal value-creation actions.
  • Contribute to broader commercial diligence, investment thesis and value-creation engagements where technology is central to the business case.
  • Develop and apply a functional specialism while maintaining enough breadth to lead integrated client discussions and direct multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support the growth of Crosslake through excellent client relationships, repeat work, thoughtful proposition development and mentoring of colleagues.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in technology consulting, technology due diligence, technology strategy, digital transformation or technology leadership.
  • A track record of leading client-facing workstreams or engagements, including managing senior stakeholders and producing high-quality, decision-ready outputs.
  • Strong technology fundamentals and demonstrable depth in at least one functional specialism, such as product and engineering, architecture and cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, delivery or technology operating model.

  • The ability to move confidently between technical detail and business discussion, identifying the issues that genuinely matter to a client or investment case.

  • Excellent structured thinking, written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a compelling, clear narrative.
  • A collaborative and action-oriented style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the curiosity to learn beyond an initial area of expertise.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and appetite to build client relationships, lead teams and grow into broader commercial and technology value-creation work.

Remote Raven is hiring a Cost Accountant on behalf of a long-established commercial electrical contractor headquartered in Arizona. The company builds complex electrical systems on healthcare, mission-critical/data-center, industrial, and commercial projects across the state and works with major national general contractors. Multiple projects run in parallel; each has its own budget, schedule of values, change-order activity, and life cycle to close out. This role sits inside the accounting team and pairs directly with project management on the money side of each job.

You will monitor job costs, track budgets, analyze variances, prepare work-in-progress schedules, and reconcile project cost detail to the general ledger. You will be part of the monthly job cost review with project managers, and you will flag risks and overruns early so leadership can act on them. The role calls for someone who is confident in construction accounting mechanics — WIP, percentage-of-completion, committed costs, change orders — and who can explain those mechanics in plain language to non-accountants.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Monitoring & Budget Management

  • Collaborate with project managers to develop and maintain detailed project budgets and financial forecasts.
  • Track and analyze all job costs across each project life cycle, including labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractor expenses.
  • Monitor change orders end-to-end and ensure accurate documentation, pricing, and budget adjustments are reflected in the ERP.
  • Maintain accurate records of purchasing, vendor contracts, and committed costs on each active project.

Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis

  • Prepare monthly job cost reports and variance analyses for management review.
  • Participate in monthly job cost meetings with the Project Management team, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.
  • Assist in preparing WIP schedules and contribute to monthly financial statement preparation.
  • Review project billing and revenue recognition to ensure compliance with company policies and contract standards.

General Ledger Reconciliation & Data Accuracy

  • Reconcile project costs with general ledger accounts; ensure data accuracy across all financial systems.
  • Maintain the integrity of project cost data through consistent data entry standards and regular reconciliation reviews.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between project-level cost tracking and GL records.

Audit Support & Internal Controls

  • Support internal and external audits with detailed cost documentation, reconciliations, and organized project records.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve cost tracking methods, accounting processes, and financial controls.
  • Ensure the company’s cost accounting practices remain compliant with contract requirements and accounting standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Project Management as the financial counterpart to project leadership.
  • Communicate financial insights, budget status, and cost concerns clearly to non-financial team members.
  • Proactively flag financial risks, cost overruns, or budget anomalies to accounting leadership and project management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of cost accounting experience, preferably in construction or electrical contracting.
  • Strong understanding of construction job cost accounting, WIP schedules, and percentage-of-completion revenue recognition.
  • Proficiency in a construction accounting platform such as CMIC, Viewpoint Vista, Sage 300 CRE (Timberline), or a comparable system.
  • Advanced Excel skills for financial modeling, variance analysis, and reporting.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving.
  • Clear and effective written English.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Overlap with US Mountain Standard Time business hours (Arizona does not observe DST).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience in electrical contracting, commercial construction, or specialty-trades accounting.
  • CPA or CMA certification (or local equivalent).
  • Experience managing job cost reporting across multiple simultaneous projects.
  • Background supporting monthly close and WIP schedule preparation in construction.

Tools & Software

  • Construction Accounting Platform (primary): CMIC, Viewpoint Vista, Sage 300 CRE (Timberline), or comparable.
  • Microsoft Excel — advanced.
  • General Ledger / ERP modules for construction.
  • Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and video conferencing for remote coordination.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You understand how money moves through a construction project — and you catch cost problems before they become budget problems.
  • Your WIP schedules and job cost reports are accurate and ready for management review without cleanup.
  • Project Managers trust you because you make financial information clear and actionable.
  • You are comfortable being the financial eyes on projects from a distance.
  • You bring discipline and consistency to cost tracking.

Benefits
