jobs.description:
About MedTech World

Launched in 2020, MedTech World began as a bold initiative to position Malta as a bridge connecting startups, investors, service providers, and thought leaders across the Medical and HealthTech space. Five years on, we have grown into a genuinely global platform with operations spanning Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia.

We now run four summits, across four continents, in four quarters. Each event brings together the most important voices in MedTech and HealthTech to move the industry forward, and we are growing fast.

To drive our North American growth, we are looking for a commercially experienced, well-connected, and self-driven sales professional who can open doors, close deals, and work hand-in-hand with our wider team to build something exceptional.

The Role

As Senior Sales and Partnerships Manager, North America, you will be a key commercial driver across the US and Canadian markets. This is a hands-on role built for someone who brings real experience, knows how to operate independently, and is ready to take genuine ownership of a region.

You will be generating pipeline, closing sponsors and partners, and working closely with the CEO and the wider sales and partnerships team. Your work will have a direct and visible impact on the business from day one.

Location:

Remote. Open to candidates across the US and Canada, provided they are eligible to work in their country of residence.

Role Description / What you'll Do.

  • Drive revenue across MedTech World's sponsorship, exhibition, and partnership offerings for the US and Canadian markets, covering all four annual summits.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of sponsors, institutional partners, hospital systems, government bodies, and corporate exhibitors from within the North American MedTech and HealthTech ecosystem.
  • Lead the full sales cycle independently, from prospecting and outreach through to proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop tailored commercial proposals that match sponsor and partner objectives to MedTech World's event portfolio.
  • Represent MedTech World at industry events, conferences, and networking forums across North America to build brand presence and generate leads.
  • Work closely with the partnerships and marketing teams to ensure a seamless experience for sponsors and partners before, during, and after each event.
  • Provide regular pipeline reports, revenue forecasts, and market intelligence to the leadership team.
  • Identify and pursue new commercial opportunities across the region, including health system innovation arms, venture funds, accelerators, trade associations, and federal and state government bodies.

What You Will Bring

Proven track record in senior sales or business development within the events, MedTech, HealthTech, or life sciences sectors.

A strong existing network across the US and Canadian MedTech, HealthTech, or healthcare innovation ecosystem that you can activate from day one.

The ability to work independently without day-to-day direction, while remaining a strong and collaborative team player.

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

Comfort operating across multiple time zones and markets simultaneously.

Willingness to travel across North America and internationally for events and client meetings.

Experience with CRM platforms and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You Are:

  • Commercially sharp, with a proven instinct for identifying opportunities, building pipeline, and closing deals without needing direction.
  • A natural relationship builder, someone who genuinely enjoys the process of earning trust with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and partners over time.
  • A confident and credible communicator, comfortable representing MedTech World in rooms with C-suite executives, investors, hospital leaders, and government bodies.
  • Proactive and self-directed, you spot commercial opportunities before they are pointed out and move on them quickly.
  • Energized by the MedTech and HealthTech space, whether through prior experience or a genuine passion for where healthcare and innovation meet.
  • Comfortable with variety and pace, no two weeks look the same across four summits, four continents, and a fast-moving team.
  • Ambitious, you want to grow into a VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer role as MedTech World scales, and you see this as the platform to get there.
  • A background in MedTech, HealthTech, life sciences, events, or B2B sales within a high-growth environment is a strong advantage. That said, a strong existing network, commercial instinct, and the drive to build something matter more than any single credential.
  • This role is not the right fit if you are looking for a structured corporate sales environment with long approval chains, prefer inbound-only pipeline, or are not comfortable working autonomously across multiple markets simultaneously.

What Success Looks Like?

  • The North American market is a consistent and growing revenue contributor across all four MedTech World summits, with a strong pipeline of sponsors, partners, and exhibitors closing quarter on quarter.
  • Key relationships across the US and Canadian MedTech, HealthTech, investor, and institutional ecosystem are owned and deepened, with MedTech World recognised as the go-to platform for the region.
  • The CEO and leadership team have full visibility across North American pipeline, forecasts, and deal progress without needing to chase updates.
  • Sponsors and partners secured through North America are returning year on year, with satisfaction and renewal rates that reflect a high-quality commercial relationship.
  • You have built trust, expanded your scope, and are on a clear path toward VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer as MedTech World scales.

Growth Opportunity:

This role is intentionally designed as a launchpad. High performers will be considered for progression into a VP of Sales or Chief Commercial Officer position as MedTech World continues to scale globally. You will earn real commercial ownership quickly, expanding your scope across markets, summits, and revenue lines alongside the business.

Ready to help shape healthcare?

If you are driven by impact, excited by international travel, and ready to take your commercial career to another level, we would love to meet you.

Apply now and help bring the MedTech World vision to life across North America.

jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity We are looking for a Senior AI Systems Engineer with deep C++expertiseto help build the next generation of AI-enabled product and platform capabilities.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior AI Systems Engineer with deep C++expertiseto help build the next generation of AI-enabled product and platform capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of large-scale systems engineering, applied AI, andproductionsoftware architecture. You will design and build the native infrastructure, service integration layers, evaluation systems, and reliability mechanisms that allow AI-powered features tooperatesafely, predictably, and efficiently inside complex software products.

This is not a research-only role and not a prompt-engineering role. This is a hands-on principal engineering role for someone who can move between architecture, production code, AI system design, technical strategy, and cross-team leadership.

The ideal candidate is a strong C++ engineer first, with practical AI fluency: someone who understands how modern AI systems behave, where they fail, how to integrate them into production workflows, and how to design systems that make AI useful, reliable, observable, and secure.

WhatYou’llDo

AI-Native Systems Architecture

  • Design and build native C++ infrastructure that connects complex product codebases to AI-powered services, agents, and model-backed workflows.

  • Define clean execution interfaces, schemas, validation layers, and error-handling contracts for AI-driven actions.

  • Create reliable bridges between product capabilities, AI orchestration systems, and backend services.

  • Ensure AI-initiated actionsbehavesafely, predictably, and consistently within existing product workflows.

  • Guidelong-term architecture decisions through ADRs, design documents, technical reviews, and cross-functional alignment.

C++ Platform and Integration Engineering

  • Build high-quality C++ components for performance-sensitive, cross-platform environments.

  • Own critical client-side infrastructure such as service connectivity, session lifecycle, authentication, TLS, reconnection, concurrency, and async execution.

  • Design APIs and abstractions that are maintainable, testable, and scalable across multiple product surfaces.

  • Improvecodehealth through modernization, refactoring, better testing, and stronger engineering patterns.

  • Balance performance, memory safety, reliability, backward compatibility, and developer experience in a mature codebase.

Applied AI Reliability and Evaluation

  • Design systems that make AI features measurable,debuggable, andproduction-ready.

  • Build evaluation frameworks for AI workflows, including automated task execution, output validation, regression testing, scoring, and human review loops.

  • Define guardrails for AI-driven actions, including safety checks, capability boundaries, fallback paths, and failure handling.

  • Create privacy-conscious tracing, observability, and diagnostics for model-backed systems.

  • Partner with product, data science, security, legal, and AI governance teams to ensure AI capabilities meet quality, safety, and compliance expectations.

Technical Leadership

  • Set engineering direction in ambiguous and fast-moving technical areas.

  • Influence architecture across native clients, backend AI services, orchestration layers, and product experience teams.

  • Help teams adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and review.

WhatYou’llBring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant depth in C++.

  • Strong experience building ormaintaininglarge, mature, performance-sensitive codebases.

  • Expertisein modern C++ design, memory management, concurrency, API design, debugging, and systems-level performance.

  • Experience building cross-platform software across Windows, macOS, Linux, or similar environments.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI, LLMs, agents, or model-backed systems into production or production-adjacent software.

  • Practical understanding of AI system failure modes, including hallucination, tool-calling errors, incomplete context, multi-turn drift, nondeterminism, and unreliable outputs.

  • Experience designing reliable interfaces between AI systems and deterministic software systems.

  • Strong systems architecture skills, including tradeoff analysis, technical strategy, and architecture documentation.

  • Experience with testing at scale, including unit tests, integration tests, CI validation, regression testing, and quality gates.

  • Ability to lead through influence across engineering, product, design, platform, security, and data science teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to both engineering and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with frontier model APIs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar systems.

  • Experience designingtool/function-calling interfaces, agentic workflows, or AI orchestration systems.

  • Experience building AI evaluation frameworks, automated scoring systems, or human-in-the-loop quality review.

  • Familiarity with JSON-RPC,gRPC,WebSockets, REST, or similar service protocols.

  • Experience with observability and tracing for AI systems or distributed systems.

  • Experience with privacy-aware telemetry, data retention, secure client/service communication, or enterprise compliance requirements.

  • Familiarity with sandboxing, safety boundaries, permissions, or policy enforcement for AI-initiated actions.

  • Experience modernizing legacy C++ systems or improving developer productivity in large engineering organizations.

  • Background in creative tools, productivity applications, developer tools, enterprise software, or complex desktop applications.

What Makes This Role Special

  • You will help define how AI becomes a reliable part of complex production software systems.

  • You will work at the intersection of C++ systems engineering, applied AI, platform architecture, and product-scale impact.

  • You will shape infrastructure that enables AI-powered experiences across multiple teams and product surfaces.

  • You will influence both technical strategy and day-to-day engineering execution.

  • You will help raise the bar for how teams build, evaluate, secure, andoperateAI systems in production.

About the Team

This team builds foundational AI systems and native infrastructure for product engineering teams. We partner across client engineering, backend AI services, platform teams, product, data science, security, privacy, and release engineering.

We focus on durable architecture, production-quality implementation, measurable reliability, and practical AI adoption. Our goal is to make AI-powered software safer, faster, more capable, and easier for engineering teams to build and ship.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a commercially and operationally driven Grid Interconnection & Power Delivery Manager to join our Global Data Centers team.


In this role, your primary objective is to secure access to power for our expanding data center portfolio. As the commercial and process orchestrator for our grid connections, you will focus on negotiating grid access agreements with transmission or distribution system operators, translating utility contracts into clear businessimpacts, and driving the end-to-end timeline to ensure internal teams and project managers execute perfectly.


What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

  • Determine the Pathway to Power for new sites: Know the system connection process for target markets, the responsible parties and the technical criteria for meeting new site needs. This includes a general understanding of system upgrade processes, power redundancy practices, system voltages and components necessary to deliver power.
  • Commercial Negotiation & Translation: Lead the negotiation of grid connection agreements (ESAs) with local utilities. You will translate these complex utility contracts and grid constraints into clear operational and commercial realities for IMDC projects and our end customers. This includes validating the technical aspects of power design and delivery to the site, including upstream system resources.
  • Process Orchestration: Own the master timeline for power delivery. You will coordinate "who does what and when," ensuring that local Project Managers for new and existing data center locations hit critical verification, submission, and operational milestones at exactly the right moment.
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Deeply understand the ongoing requirements of our grid access contracts. You will manage the lifetime of the contract, ensuring we meet utilization thresholds, mitigate commercial risk, and maintain compliance long after the initial agreement is signed.
  • Cross-Functional & 3rd Party Leadership: Act as the central node between our external technical consultants, utilities, sales teams, and construction teams. You will ensure technical data is seamlessly handed off and applied to the commercial strategy.
  • Risk & Timeline Alignment: Actively monitor utility requirements against reality. You will track critical thresholds (such as underutilization clauses or customer ramp-up timelines) to ensure our capacity commitments align with actual customer deployment.

What You'll Bring (Skills & Qualifications)

  • Technical Understanding: Knowledge of electrical system components and voltages sufficient to ensure contracts deliver power aligned to the needs of our new facilities.
  • Commercial & Operational Rigor: You are a meticulous process manager and a strongcommercial negotiator. You know how to hold cross-functional teams and external utilities accountable to strict timelines.
  • Cross-Functional Teamwork: You are highly comfortable and effective at working across different teams. You build solid relationships naturally and can bridge the communication gaps between technical engineers, commercial sales teams, and external utility partners
  • Industry & Utility Expertise: Demonstrable experience in energy procurement, utility relations, or infrastructure project management for energy-intensive consumers. You must have a track record of negotiating directly with utilities or system operators.
  • Contractual Fluency: You must be able to read a complex grid connection contract and immediately understand what it means for the project's construction timeline and the customer's ramp-up schedule.
  • Location: Must be based in the US.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business, electrical engineering, project management, or an energy-related discipline.

What We Offer (Benefits)

  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the experience.
  • Flexible work options to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

ABOUT IMPLENTIO

Implentio is building the intelligence layer for modern ecommerce operations.

We help DTC and ecommerce brands recover lost money and eliminate operational waste across their parcel and 3PL networks through software, data, and deep operational expertise. Our platform identifies billing errors, uncovers inefficiencies, and transforms messy operational data into clear, high-impact decisions.

Behind the technology is a team that has spent years operating inside high-growth ecommerce and logistics environments. We know how complex these systems are because we have run them ourselves.

Implentio is backed by leading venture investors and led by a founding team with a track record of building and scaling successful companies. We are building a focused, high-caliber team that values clear thinking, moves quickly, and takes real ownership of outcomes.

If you are excited about building software that solves real operational problems for some of the fastest-growing ecommerce brands, we would love to meet you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer, AI & Automation to help build the intelligent systems at the core of our products.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of applied AI, product engineering, and real-world operational data.

You will design and ship LLM-powered features, build automation that replaces manual workflows, and integrate AI into how we detect billing errors, optimize carrier selection, and surface insights for customers.

You will work across the full stack, including Python backend services, React frontend, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure, with AI woven into each layer.

Experience in logistics, fulfillment, 3PL, or ecommerce is a plus.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and ship AI products. Design, develop, and deliver agentic features end-to-end, including chat-based interfaces, agent workflow experiences, and internal copilots that serve real users in production.
  • Leverage agentic coding workflows. Use modern agentic coding tools daily, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar assistants, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high code quality and engineering standards.
  • Design agent systems. Architect agent internals, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, memory and state management, retrieval pipelines, permissions models, and failure recovery strategies.
  • Own evals and quality. Build and maintain agent evaluation infrastructure, including regression suites, scenario-based tests, golden traces, and both offline and online metrics, so you always know whether your agent got better or worse.
  • Implement observability. Instrument agents with production-grade observability, including distributed tracing, prompt and version tracking, tool-call telemetry, and cost and latency monitoring.
  • Own production readiness. Take responsibility for the full lifecycle, including rollout plans, QA, guardrails, incident response, and continuous improvement of deployed agents.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Proficiency in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, with experience in modern web stacks and startup-pace delivery.
  • Proven full-stack engineering ability. You have shipped production software end-to-end, not just prototypes or demos.
  • Shipped LLM-powered features to production. You have owned at least 1 to 2 agentic features or products from design, build, deployment, and operation.
  • Familiarity with agentic coding best practices. You understand task decomposition, agent delegation, prompt hygiene, iterative loops, and how to review and steer agentic outputs effectively.
  • Practical experience with agent evals and tracing.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals. Testing, debugging, performance optimization, and reliability are second nature to you.
  • Familiarity with agent tooling ecosystems, including prompt and version stores, eval harnesses, and tracing and telemetry platforms such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Datadog, Honeycomb, or similar, is a plus.
  • Experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, indexing strategies, chunking approaches, and retrieval evaluation, is a plus.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • You build a strong understanding of our products, workflows, data, and operational constraints quickly.
  • You ship improvements that make the product smarter, more scalable, and more useful in production.
  • You apply AI in ways that are practical and durable, not gimmicky.
  • You become a trusted partner to product and operations by solving messy real-world problems.
  • You raise the quality of the systems you touch, including code, data models, reliability, and deployment.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You dig into how things work, ask good questions, and do not stop at the surface.
  • You follow through and ship. Work moves because you move it.
  • You make sound decisions and practical tradeoffs without needing perfect information.
  • You care about quality and think through edge cases, testing, and production behavior.
  • You collaborate well across functions and focus on building what works.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyAt Rezilient, we're redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before.
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Rezilient, we're redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we're building a healthcare experience that's as convenient as it is comprehensive. We are a Series B company, which means the work is real, the pace is fast, and the design decisions you make now become the patterns we scale on.

About the Role

Rezilient is seeking a Senior UX Designer to help build a member app people love coming back to. As we extend care beyond the clinic, you'll shape how members understand their health, connect with their care team, and take useful next steps between visits.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role spanning research, interaction and visual design, prototyping, and iteration after launch. Your initial focus will be the member-facing mobile experience. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Growth to create a coherent experience across the app and the care it connects members to. Care-team workflow improvements will be prioritized alongside member-facing work, rather than treated as a separate, unlimited mandate.

AI will be an important part of what you design, but not the answer to every problem. You'll help determine when AI makes an interaction more useful and when a simpler approach is better. Where AI is involved, you'll design for transparency, user control, appropriate human review, and recovery when something goes wrong.

Our ideal candidate brings deep consumer mobile experience, strong interaction and visual design skills, and a record of improving products after launch. You care about the details of the shipped experience, learn directly from users, and can explain how your work helped people accomplish something that matters to them.

What You'll Design

  • The member mobile experience: Onboarding, access to care, navigation, communication, and between-visit engagement that feel coherent, useful, and easy to return to.
  • Health and wearable data experiences: Clear ways for members to connect devices, understand relevant health information, and identify useful next steps without being overwhelmed by data.
  • Member-facing AI experiences: Assistance with intake, care navigation, education, and follow-up, with clear boundaries and a straightforward handoff to a person when needed.
  • Connections to the care team: Member-to-care-team handoffs and supporting workflows that keep the digital experience connected to how care is delivered.
  • Efficient clinical workflows: Intuitive experiences for medics, providers, and care navigators across visit preparation, encounters, documentation, orders, and referrals, designed to reduce repetitive work and context switching so care teams can focus on members.
  • Care-team coordination: Clear task queues, messaging, and handoffs that make ownership, priority, and next steps visible across virtual and CloudClinic care, helping teams move work forward without losing clinical context.
  • Innovative AI-assisted care delivery: New ways to summarize relevant information, draft documentation, and support follow-up, designed and tested with care teams, with appropriate clinician review, easy correction, and clear accountability.
  • Trust, control, and recovery: Consent and permission flows, review and correction, understandable explanations, and recovery when information is incomplete or a system is wrong, slow, or unavailable.
  • Reusable mobile patterns: Accessible components and interaction patterns, including loading, empty, error, and success states, that maintain a consistent quality bar as the product grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end member experience design: Take priority journeys from discovery and workflow mapping through prototypes, production-ready designs, implementation review, and post-launch iteration.
  • Partner in product discovery: Work closely with the Product Manager and mobile engineering lead to define problems, explore alternatives, and make informed tradeoffs before committing to a solution.
  • Deliver a high standard of craft: Create polished interaction and visual designs with clear information hierarchy, thoughtful content, and platform-appropriate mobile patterns. Partner with Engineering through design QA so the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar.
  • Learn directly from users: Run practical interviews, concept tests, and usability sessions with members and, where relevant, medics, providers, and care navigators. Combine those findings with product data to challenge assumptions and guide iteration.
  • Accelerate product and design cycles with AI: Rethink traditional research, synthesis, prototyping, and validation workflows using AI to test more ideas, reach evidence-backed decisions faster, and shorten the path from problem to shipped experience. Demonstrate measurable improvements in cycle time while preserving research integrity, privacy, and design quality.
  • Build realistic prototypes: Use Figma and approved prototyping tools to test interactions before implementation. For AI-powered flows, explore representative model outputs and failure cases rather than relying only on idealized mockups.
  • Develop reusable design foundations: Define and document components, patterns, and guidance with Engineering so quality and consistency scale beyond individual features.
  • Connect design to member outcomes: Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate onboarding success, task completion, comprehension, satisfaction, and meaningful repeat engagement. Use AI acceptance, correction, and override behavior as additional diagnostic signals, not substitutes for a useful member experience.
  • Design responsibly: Work with Clinical Operations, Quality, and Compliance to translate agreed safety expectations into clear review, consent, escalation, and recovery flows. Use approved tools and appropriately protected or synthetic data for research and prototyping.
  • Support focused delivery: Participate in planning, backlog refinement, and delivery rituals, keeping design work well-scoped and aligned with product priorities. Establish practical design review and learning habits without adding unnecessary process.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Senior-level design experience: 5+ years in UX, product design, or interaction design in a high-growth, technology-enabled environment, with a record of taking work from an unclear problem through launch and iteration.
  • Deep consumer mobile experience: Experience designing and shipping a consumer health, wellness, or fitness app used by a substantial active user base. You can explain the audience, scale, your contribution, and what changed as the product grew.
  • Strong interaction and visual design: A portfolio showing excellent craft and shipped mobile experiences, with a clear account of the problem, research, tradeoffs, and results. Anonymized examples and directional results are welcome when work is confidential.
  • Research and evaluation skills: Experience learning directly from users and combining qualitative findings with product data to make and test design decisions.
  • Mobile and accessibility fundamentals: Familiarity with iOS and Android interaction patterns and the ability to design for people with different abilities, levels of health literacy, and comfort with technology.
  • Prototyping and systems skills: Strong proficiency in Figma, including component-based design, interactive prototyping, design systems, and clear communication of behavior and intent to engineers.
  • Sound AI design judgment: An understanding of uncertainty, disclosure, review and correction, permissions, and human handoff. You can reason about failure cases and avoid creating unwarranted trust in an automated response.
  • Thoughtful use of AI tools: Fluency with AI-enabled design, research, and productivity tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where direct human research and review remain necessary.
  • Cross-functional ownership: Proven ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering on a small team where priorities evolve and designers are expected to remain hands-on.
  • Systems thinking and communication: The ability to simplify complex journeys, explain design rationale, facilitate tradeoff discussions, and incorporate clinical, technical, and business feedback without losing sight of member needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Shipped AI-powered features: Experience bringing AI interactions to real users, including evaluating quality, handling errors, and learning after release.
  • High-trust products: Experience in care delivery or another regulated environment where privacy, clarity, and safety influence design decisions.
  • Sustained engagement: Experience helping people build useful habits or follow through on health goals without relying on unnecessary notifications or manipulative patterns.
  • Connected health experiences: Work with wearable or device data, personalized health information, or experiences spanning an app and a human care team.
  • Clinical workflow familiarity: Experience with documentation, referrals, care-team tasks, or patient-provider messaging, and familiarity with clinical data standards such as FHIR or HL7.
  • Early-stage design practice: Experience establishing practical design foundations and research habits on a small team while continuing to deliver hands-on product work.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

DevSecOps Engineer will own how software ships and how our cloud infrastructure stays secure — from pipeline to production.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end ownership role. Will design and operate our Azure CI/CD pipelines, codify our infrastructure and security policies, and drive remediation of security findings across the environment. Will work directly with application engineers and leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform all functions.

CI/CD & Release Engineering (Azure DevOps) 20%

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines) for application and infrastructure deployments
  • Implement multi-stage release workflows with environment promotion (dev → staging → production), approval gates, and automated rollback
  • Establish branch policies, PR validation builds, and quality gates (test coverage, build health)
  • Own deployment reliability: zero-downtime deployment patterns (blue/green, canary), release cadence, and deployment metrics (lead time, change failure rate, MTTR)
  • Manage build agents, artifact feeds, and container registries (ACR)

2. Infrastructure as Code (20%)

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to integrate security into development workflows without reducing delivery velocity.
  • Develop secure coding guidance, reusable security patterns, and self-service security capabilities.
  • Support security champion programs and security awareness initiatives for technical teams.
  • Author and maintain all cloud infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or Bicep — no click-ops in production
  • Build reusable IaC modules for common patterns (networking, app services, databases, key vaults)
  • Implement state management, drift detection, and plan/apply review workflows integrated into pipelines
  • Manage environment parity and configuration across dev, staging, and production
  • Drive cost visibility and right-sizing through tagging standards and IaC-enforced resource policies

3. Policy as Code & Governance 3 (25%)

  • Define and enforce guardrails using Azure Policy (built-in and custom definitions) across subscriptions and management groups
  • Implement policy-as-code workflows so governance changes go through version control and CI, not the portal
  • Enforce standards automatically: allowed regions and SKUs, mandatory encryption, network restrictions, required tags, diagnostic settings
  • Integrate compliance scanning into pipelines (e.g., Checkov, tfsec, PSRule) so non-compliant infrastructure fails before deployment
  • Automate collection and reporting of security control evidence to support compliance and audit requirements.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and technical control mappings across applicable regulatory frameworks.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence of control enforcement to support SOC 2 / PCI DSS compliance efforts

4. Security Operations & Remediation (25%)

  • Facilitate threat modeling exercises for applications, cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure platforms.
  • Identify security design risks early in the software development lifecycle and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Design and implement secure network architectures including segmentation, private networking, web application firewalls (WAF), and cloud-native security controls.
  • Monitor and remediate network exposure risks and cloud security misconfigurations.
  • Support secure connectivity models including VPN, private endpoints, service meshes, and zero-trust networking architectures.
  • Own vulnerability management end to end: scanning (SAST, dependency/SCA, container image, DAST), triage, severity-based remediation SLAs, and tracking to closure
  • Remediate infrastructure-level findings directly (misconfigurations, patching, network exposure, identity over-permissioning); route application-code findings to engineering teams with clear severity, context, and deadlines
  • Administer secrets management (Azure Key Vault) — no secrets in code, pipelines, or configuration files
  • Implement and tune Microsoft Defender for Cloud and security monitoring/alerting; lead initial response and containment for security incidents
  • Manage identity and access: Entra ID, RBAC least-privilege reviews, service principals/managed identities, PIM for elevated access
  • Harden the network layer: NSGs, private endpoints, WAF, segmentation between environments

5. Feature Delivery Enablement (10%)

  • Implement feature flag infrastructure (e.g., Azure App Configuration / LaunchDarkly) to decouple deployment from release
  • Support progressive rollouts, A/B exposure controls, and kill switches for safe feature launches
  • Partner with application engineers to make shipping fast and safe — your job is to remove friction, not add gates
  • Support feature flag platforms and progressive delivery capabilities to enable secure, controlled feature releases.
  • Implement kill-switch and rollback mechanisms to reduce deployment risk.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

B.S. or Major in Computer Science

Required Licensure, Certification, etc.:

  • Preferred: AZ-400, AZ-500, or equivalent

Work Experience:

  • 5+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles, with at least 2 years of hands-on security ownership (DevSecOps, AppSec, or CloudSec)

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Expert with Azure DevOps: YAML pipelines, release management, branch policies, artifact management
  • Production experience with Terraform or Bicep (both a plus), including module design and state management

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.

Ministry

University of Massachusetts Global is a private, nonprofit affiliate of the University of Massachusetts, created to help working adults change their lives through flexible, high-quality education built for real life. ABOUT THE ROLE

The Financial Aid Advisor processes financial aid applications and determines financial aid eligibility. The position is responsible for maintaining and updating student financial aid records. This position reviews applications for completeness, verifies data, and ensures compliance with federal, state, and university guidelines.


Job Description

TYPE OF SUPERVISION:

Receive general supervision from the Assistant Director of Financial Aid Operations.

  • General Supervision — indicates that the incumbent performs a variety of duties; some of which may be complex duties within established policy guidelines; and receives occasional supervision.

POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Processing Financial Aid Requests

  • Review financial aid applications and related documents to confirm completeness, accuracy, and eligibility based on established federal, state, and university guidelines
  • Verify student information and resolve basic discrepancies by collecting additional documentation or confirming data in the financial aid system
  • Processes institutional scholarship awards, tuition discounts, partnerships, and other aid programs as directed, ensuring correct entry into student accounts
  • Input and update student data in financial aid software to process awards and adjustments for federal, state institutional and external assistance programs
  • Reconciles financial aid and admissions records to confirm student status before aid is processed or adjusted. Authorizes payment of financial aid awards to student accounts
  • Maintain accurate, well-organized electronic and paper files, including clear notes on financial aid activities and student communications
  • Confirm that all required documentation and federal verification codes are cleared before aid is finalized or funds are disbursed

Student Service Support

  • Provides guidance and updates to student services staff on routine financial aid procedures and student documentation requirements
  • Assist with sharing information about changes in financial aid systems, forms, and processes to ensure consistency across the team
  • Collaborate with the student services and other staff to help resolve student questions and concerns related to financial aid or billing

Compliance

  • Applies and enforces established financial aid policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable federal and state laws, regulations, and university requirements.
  • Identifies and reports potential policy, procedural, or compliance concerns to the appropriate leader to support ongoing compliance with federal, state, and university financial-aid requirements
  • Maintains student files and program records for compliance with audit and program reviews.

Other

  • Assists with annual reviews and updates to financial aid forms to ensure compliance in awarding financial aid funds
  • Participate in financial aid software update testing, record reviews, and other assigned projects
  • Perform other duties, as assigned

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, CERTIFICATION AND/OR LICENSES:

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working in a financial aid and student services environment

  • Knowledge of federal and state financial aid regulations, along with basic office procedures and recordkeeping practices.
  • Skill in reviewing and applying eligibility criteria using established guidelines and calculations.

  • Ability to use computer systems and financial aid software to enter, review, and update student information.

The Lifecycle Marketing Manager turns lifecycle strategy into scalable, measurable customer engagement campaigns for Avid's direct-to-consumer subscription business. This role owns assigned programs from planning through execution, launch, measurement, and optimization, bringing together cross-functional partners and ensuring work is delivered accurately and on time.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on lifecycle or CRM marketer with strong program management, campaign operations, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership skills. You can turn a business objective into a clear engagement plan, keep work moving, and use results to improve what comes next.


This is an individual contributor role. The Lifecycle Marketing Manager owns campaign development start to finish and the program management of their assigned campaigns, not people management.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lifecycle Strategy & Campaign Ownership

  • Own end-to-end lifecycle programs from business brief and strategy through execution, launch, measurement, optimization, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Turn business and customer objectives into campaign plans covering audiences, messaging, channels, dependencies, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Manage multiple campaigns at once, identify risks and blockers to keep work moving to launch.
  • Own programs across prospect conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, renewal, win-back, and expansion.

Campaign Execution, Audience & Quality

  • Own campaign execution across email (using Knak), in-app messaging, onsite experiences, and other lifecycle channels, including campaign setup and execution in Braze.
  • Define segmentation, eligibility, personalization, and suppression requirements; partner with Data to validate logic, data availability, and reporting.
  • Own campaign QA and readiness, including personalization, dynamic content, offers and pricing, suppression, links, landing pages, test sends, rendering, and launch checks.
  • Monitor campaigns after launch and act quickly on issues affecting customer experience or business performance.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Define KPIs and measurement plans with Data and Analytics, and use Braze, Looker Reports, Google Analytics, Salesforce, Amplitude, and other available sources to assess performance.
  • Turn campaign results and customer behavior into clear insights, business implications, and recommendations, not just reporting.
  • Plan and manage A/B and other controlled tests, document learnings, and apply results to future campaigns.

Cross Functional Leadership & Process Improvements

  • Lead cross-functional team meetings for assigned campaigns, driving alignment, decisions, and next steps across partner teams.
  • Lead day-to-day coordination across Product Marketing, Market Solutions, Content, eCommerce, Digital Operations, Creative Services, Growth, Data, and Engineering.
  • Create clear briefs, requirements, timelines, and decision points; define lifecycle requirements and drive technical needs through Engineering and Product Technology teams.
  • Work with the Growth team to establish improvements to the customer journeys across acquisition and lifecycle engagement campaigns.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Lifecycle / CRM Marketer: 3+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, subscription, digital marketing, or a related discipline, with demonstrated program ownership.
  • Strong Program Owner: Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking an objective from idea to launch while managing dependencies and deadlines.

jobs.excerpt: Lifecycle & Email Marketing ManagerFresh Prints' email channel is our oldest and highest-potential channel — and the one we've leveraged the least.
jobs.description:
Lifecycle & Email Marketing Manager

Fresh Prints' email channel is our oldest and highest-potential channel — and the one we've leveraged the least. We've built a strong technical foundation, but we're missing the layer that actually makes email work: content. Emails that land at the right moment, in the right way, and create real value for the people on our list.

We're looking for someone who is first and foremost a great marketer — someone who understands what makes an email get opened, get read, and drive a click. You'll own both our campaign email and our full lifecycle program, and you'll extend that same craft into SMS as we build it into a real channel.

This isn't a role where you inherit a machine and keep it running. You're building the content engine on top of the plumbing we already have. If you've been waiting for a channel with this much upside and this little baggage, this is it.

This role is about:

  • Owning every word that goes out — subject lines, body, CTAs — across email and SMS
  • Turning a solid technical setup into a channel people actually look forward to hearing from
  • Building lifecycle flows that feel like a conversation, not a drip someone got trapped in
  • Writing for a college-age audience in a voice that feels made for them, not blasted at them
  • Bringing a real point of view on performance — not just reading the numbers, but knowing what they're telling you to do next

What You'll Own

Campaign Email & SMS Content

  • Own email and SMS conceptualization — final say on subject lines, preview text, headers, body, and CTAs across all of Fresh Prints' major marketing moments
  • Work with our brand and creative teams on design and copy so every send feels on-brand
  • Develop a campaign content calendar that ladders into the broader marketing calendar, so email and SMS amplify the right message at the right time
  • Own A/B testing for subject lines, content approaches, and CTAs — with the discipline to learn from the results and apply them
  • Write messages that resonate with a college-age audience: content that feels like it's actually written for them, not generic marketing

Lifecycle Program (Email & SMS)

  • Own the strategy and content for Fresh Prints' lifecycle flows: welcome series for new subscribers, post-purchase nurture, cart and browse abandonment, re-engagement, and win-back — across email and SMS
  • Audit the existing lifecycle program, identify gaps, underperforming flows, and moments in the customer journey where we're leaving engagement on the table
  • Own segmentation: define the audiences and journey logic that decide who gets what, when
  • Write and test improved lifecycle content, and build flows that feel like a conversation with the customer, not a sequence they got dropped into for checking a box

Deliverability & Performance

  • Monitor deliverability and engagement metrics — open rates, click-through rates, unsubscribe rates, spam complaints, bounce rates — and maintain a healthy sender reputation
  • Follow email and SMS deliverability best practices: list hygiene, warm-up protocols, segmentation for engaged vs. unengaged audiences, suppression management, and compliance
  • Report on performance on a regular cadence — what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing based on the data
  • Bring a point of view: not just "open rate was 28%," but "here's what that tells us about the subject-line approach, and here's what I'm testing next"

Who You Are

  • You're a strong marketer, and you know it. Your subject lines get opened. Your body copy gets read. Your CTAs get clicked. You have a feel for what makes someone actually engage with a message rather than glance at it before archiving.
  • You understand lifecycle marketing at a real level — you know the difference between a nurture message and a conversion message, and you write them differently.
  • You're fluent in email (and increasingly SMS) as a channel: you know what deliverability means, you care about list health, and you can look at an open rate and know whether it's a subject-line problem or a segmentation problem.
  • You own your own output. Nobody has to check your sends before they go — you hold the standard yourself, and it stings when something ships with a mistake.
  • You work well with technical partners, brand, and creative, and you can translate what Fresh Prints' audience cares about into messaging that lands.

The Sales Manager will join our high-performance Global Sales and Marketing team, renowned for its excellence and success. The manager will be tasked with spearheading the sales strategies and activities for ILSC, Greystone and ELS in Chile, Argentina or Uruguay. The sales role entails orchestrating comprehensive plans to drive enrollment into our language and higher education programs. We are seeking an adept communicator with a proven track record in collaborating with agencies, schools, and universities to foster student enrollment to ILSC, ELS, Greystone College and Greystone Institute. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of charisma, ethical conduct, and a results-driven mindset, while harboring a passion for international education. The manager will be a personable and persuasive communicator, results-oriented, highly ethical, a great team player, who is seeking an opportunity to grow with a world-leading global organization in international education.

This full-time sales role offers a competitive salary package, covering 37.5 hours of work per week. However, there may be occasions when the manager will need to work additional hours per week to fulfill project deadlines and tasks, including exhibiting at fairs and/or while travelling within the region on behalf of the company. As a remote sales position, candidates should be located in Santiago, Chile or Buenos Aires, Argentina, though Chile is preferred.

Job Duties: 

The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate closely with the Regional Sales Director and sales team members to ensure the attainment of enrollment targets. This objective will be realized through increasing sales from our current agent partners and onboarding new agents with significant growth potential.
  • Support the Regional Sales Director in crafting sales projections and budgets, aiding in strategic planning for sales initiatives and resource allocation.

Drive the promotion of all ILSC Education Group brands through a multifaceted approach:

  • Presentation skills: Utilize effective presentation techniques to showcase the value propositions of ILSC Education Group to potential partners and clients.
  • Agent workshops and fairs: Participate in workshops and fairs to engage with students to increase sales.
  • Pricing strategies: Develop and implement competitive pricing strategies that resonate with the target market, ensuring optimal balance between affordability and profitability.
  • Training of agents: Provide comprehensive training programs for agents to equip them with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively promote and sell all ILSC Education Group programs, thereby maximizing enrollment opportunities.

  • Willingness and ability to travel.

About ePromos
ePromos Promotional Products, LLC, has been a leading industry distributor in the promotional space for over 20 years! Our award-winning website combined with our sales strategy, service capabilities and enterprise level solutions consistently set us apart.

As a remote-first company, ePromos embraces flexibility, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team is composed of passionate professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven culture where ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged. Our values are strong with a deep-rooted emphasis on giving back as part of our ePromos Cares mission.

At ePromos, we don’t just sell products—we help build brands. Join us and be part of a company that’s redefining the promotional marketing space through strategic thinking, bold creativity, and a people-first approach.

BASIC FUNCTION SUMMARY:

The Corporate Trainer is responsible for designing, delivering, and evaluating practical learning programs and resources that strengthen employee capability, operational consistency, data integrity, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration. This role supports Sales, Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, and other business functions as needed.

The Corporate Trainer translates company standards, systems, workflows, and standard operating procedures into practical learning experiences for new and existing employees. Our Corporate Trainer will partner with managers, functional leaders, and subject-matter experts to identify training needs, develop learning content, facilitate instruction, and evaluate learning effectiveness. The role will maintain accessible, engaging training materials and learning resources within appropriate platforms, reflecting the value of organized, practical, and user-friendly internal content.

The following duties are not intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties required for this position. The job description is a summary of the major duties and responsibilities. This role may not be required to perform all duties listed and may be expected to perform additional duties as requested.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Duties, Skills, Responsibilities, and Expectations:

Training & Development

  • Lead and coordinate the company’s day-to-day training and development efforts by partnering with functional leaders and subject-matter experts to identify training needs, skill gaps, and knowledge gaps.
  • Develop and facilitate instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and on-the-job training for new and existing employees.
  • Create role-based onboarding plans, training pathways, refresher training, job aids, process guides, knowledge checks, and assessments tailored to different roles and audiences.

Training Content & Business Processes

  • Develop, organize, maintain, and deliver training content across key company systems, processes, and business functions.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts to translate company processes and SOPs into clear, practical, and effective learning resources.
  • Training areas may include brand standards, data standards, sourcing, order processing, NetSuite, security, sales processes, company-wide processes, Jira, Confluence, and cross-functional workflows.

Training Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate training sessions, workshops, coaching opportunities, process reviews, and assessments while monitoring participation, completion, knowledge checks, feedback, and other applicable training metrics.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness using employee and manager feedback, operational metrics, quality findings, and recurring process issues. Identify opportunities to improve training content, learning delivery, process understanding, and knowledge retention.

Employee & HR Support

  • Serve as a member of the HR team and provide day-to-day support to employees and managers on general HR training questions, processes, and resources.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for routine HR training inquiries, provide guidance within established HR processes, and direct employees to the appropriate HR resource when additional support or expertise is needed.
  • Support HR tickets and employee requests through timely follow-up, documentation, and resolution.

Employee Experience & Culture

  • Support employee engagement, culture, and employee experience initiatives in partnership with the HR team. Assist with communications, employee programs, recognition initiatives, events, and other activities designed to strengthen employee connection and engagement.
  • Help ensure employees have access to clear, consistent, and easy-to-understand information about company programs, processes, and resources.

HR Administration & Compliance

  • Support the HR team with maintaining accurate employee records, HR documentation, and required files. Assist with HR reporting, audits, compliance activities, and other administrative processes as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate discretion when handling sensitive employee, payroll, benefits, and company information.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with managers, functional leaders, subject-matter experts, and employees across the organization.
  • Partner with departments to understand business needs, translate operational knowledge into effective training, and promote consistent understanding and execution of company processes and expectations.
Special Projects & HR Support
  • Participate in HR projects and organizational initiatives that support employee development, process improvement, compliance, culture, and the overall employee experience.
  • Take on additional HR, training, and organizational projects as needed based on company priorities and evolving business needs.

SUCCESS MEASURES:
Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvements in training effectiveness, employee readiness, process adoption, and knowledge accessibility, including:

  • Training programs are delivered on schedule with strong participation and completion rates for assigned audiences.

  • New hires and employees transitioning into new responsibilities demonstrate improved readiness and proficiency within expected timeframes.

  • Employees demonstrate understanding of key processes, systems, and expectations through knowledge checks, assessments, demonstrations, or other appropriate measures.

  • Participant and manager feedback reflects that training is practical, relevant, accessible, and applicable to day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Training contributes to improved adoption and consistent use of company systems, workflows, SOPs, and required processes.

  • Training initiatives contribute to reductions in recurring errors, data-quality issues, process gaps, and avoidable rework where training is identified as a contributing factor.

  • Training materials, job aids, and resources are current, organized, searchable, and maintained in the appropriate knowledge-management platform.

  • Managers and subject-matter experts actively engage with the Trainer to identify needs, develop content, reinforce learning, and evaluate effectiveness.

  • Training programs are regularly reviewed and adjusted based on learner feedback, manager input, business metrics, process changes, and identified knowledge gaps.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Learning and Development, Human Resources, Business, Communications, Organizational Development, or a related field;
  • 3+ years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, operations training, sales enablement, HR, supply chain, or a related business function.
  • Experience supporting both customer-facing and operational teams in a fast-paced business environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and facilitate engaging adult-learning programs for diverse employee populations.
  • Strong working knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning methodologies, assessment development, and training evaluation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, job aids, and knowledge-management resources.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, presentation tools, and virtual training platforms.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, written communication, organizational, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to translate detailed systems, process, and policy information into clear and practical learning content.
  • Ability to build credibility and productive partnerships with individual contributors, managers, executives, and subject-matter experts.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Position is fully remote to the US only
  • Ability to accommodate multiple time zones with primary ET (EST/EDT)
  • Dedicated workspace and high-speed internet
  • Frequent video conference/email/chat

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Maintaining a stationary position for up to 80% of the workday
  • Consistently operate a computer and other productivity equipment, including keyboard, webcam, and document scanner
  • Clarity of vision of 30” or less
  • Ability to perceive sound in the capacity of oral communication
  • Exertion of up to 10 lbs. of force as related to the lifting or moving of objects
The base salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000 per year. Compensation for this role will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, and competencies. The Company will meet minimum wage or the minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county, and state requirements.

About the Role as a Lead Domain Engineering Specialist:

The ideal candidate will be naturally collaborative, articulate, extremely organized, have a solid technical understanding of Veeam products, and motivated by maximizing customer success and outcomes. Soft skills combined with technical skills are key in this role. You will partner with Customer Success Engineers (CSEs) and Account Executives (AEs) to drive customer outcomes across security-related products and use cases within the Veeam Data Platform (VDP). You’ll lead readiness checks, data modeling, and risk conversations with CISO/CIO stakeholders, while monitoring telemetry and maturity against the Veeam Data Resilience Maturity Model (DRMM) to optimize posture and identify expansion opportunities.  

What You’ll Do

  • Engage customers on security-related products, architectures, and risk topics across the Veeam Data Platform (VDP).
  • Run readiness checks and lead data modeling to validate solution design and accelerate decisions.
  • Monitor attack surfaces and vulnerabilities (including DRMM scoring), track telemetry or recurring inspection signals, report trends, and capture potential health checks.
  • Validate designs to de-risk adoption and accelerate time to value.
  • Identify and articulate expansion opportunities; review consumption trends and schedule checkpoint reviews (with or without AE coordination).
  • Engage CISO/CIO stakeholders for risk, status, and opportunity discussions; synthesize inputs from account health and CSE-led QBRs.
  • Support AEs on security- and AI-driven expansion motions; influence roadmap priorities with CSE counterparts.
  • Operate as a pooled resource covering Enterprise and Commercial-Named accounts (generally $100K+ ARR), typically at a 1 Security Success Engineer to 6–8 CSE coverage ratio.
  • Note: Not the primary owner for Onboarding motions nor directly responsible for Renewals

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering or architecting cybersecurity, data security, or AI/ML-driven platforms (e.g., Security Engineer/Architect, Cloud Solution Architect, MLOps/ML Engineer, AI Security Engineer).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent); AI security or governance-related certifications (e.g., AI/ML, privacy, or data governance) are strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise in data security and governance, including DSPM and DLP, with demonstrated experience securing data across cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Hands-on experience with AI security, governance, or emerging AI platforms, including Securiti AI or similar solutions (e.g., AI-SPM, data privacy automation, model governance, or AI risk management frameworks).
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML architectures and model lifecycles, including training data pipelines, model deployment, inference controls, and associated security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial inputs).
  • Experience with AI/data observability, telemetry, and monitoring across both traditional systems and AI-driven workloads.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage CISO/CIO/CDO stakeholders on AI risk, data governance, resilience, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with solution design, POCs, and maturity modeling (experience with DRMM or data/AI trust maturity models is a plus).
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and regulatory landscapes (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO standards) and applying them to enterprise architectures
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex AI/security concepts into actionable business outcomes.
  • VMCE certification (can be completed after joining).

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle's acquiring and payment-processing stack — the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient.

This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks
  • Own critical money-movement flows end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling
  • Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)
  • Operate within PCI DSS scope — tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable
  • Instrument and monitor payment health: authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement
  • Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation — within Sezzle's security and data-handling policies
  • Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

  • 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems
  • Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs
  • Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes
  • Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication — you're comfortable making AI a core part of how you work and can show how it's improved your output
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with payments acquiring ecosystem like; Adyen, Stripe, Marqeta, Fiserv, etc.
  • Exposure to PCI DSS, 3DS/SCA, network tokenization, or payments compliance
  • SQL-based RDBMS through an ORM
  • Observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic) for production instrumentation and alerting
  • DevOps / CI/CD pipeline experience; containerized microservices on Kubernetes / AWS
  • A track record of shipping commercial payment APIs and prioritizing based on stakeholder/customer feedback

AI at Sezzle

Sezzle runs an AI-first product and engineering culture — we start projects in Claude and expect engineers to use AI to move faster and think more rigorously. In a payments environment, we do this responsibly: AI tools accelerate how we design, build, and document, but cardholder data, credentials, and secrets never leave our secured environment. We're looking for someone who treats AI fluency and secure-by-default engineering as two sides of the same skill.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
