jobs.description:
About Us

Are you looking to make a meaningful impact through your work? Join us at the Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE). We are an SEC-registered national securities exchange designed to promote fair and orderly markets, as well as help long-term focused companies get the credit they deserve. We are an innovative business ecosystem dedicated to reimagining the role of capital markets for a more equitable and sustainable future.

At LTSE, we work with companies to identify long-term investors that will value their efforts to prioritize sustainable, long-term growth. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to leverage your diverse background and skills toward a compelling mission that delivers tangible results. By supporting businesses in creating multi-stakeholder value, we generate a positive ripple effect that benefits communities, employees, and beyond.

Founded by Eric Ries, a visionary entrepreneur and creator of the Lean Startup methodology, LTSE offers a unique and rewarding environment where you can contribute to building a better future for all. Apply today.

The Role

As Head of Business Development, Listings, you’ll help shape the growth of LTSE by connecting companies with a public market built around long-term value creation. You’ll engage directly with CEOs, C-suite leaders, and Boards of Directors, building trusted relationships and helping them see how an LTSE listing can advance their strategic ambitions. You’ll help translate a differentiated vision for the public markets into a compelling business case, and guide prospective clients from an initial conversation to a listing decision.

You’ll have room to shape the business development strategy and take a hands-on role in bringing it to life: opening doors, building pipelines, and navigating complex sales cycles. Working within a small, collaborative team, your ideas, relationships, and execution will directly influence LTSE’s growth. If you bring entrepreneurial drive, strong commercial judgment, and the patience and persistence to earn trust at the highest levels, this role offers the opportunity to build something meaningful and see the impact of your work on the world.

You’ll thrive in this role if you combine the credibility to earn trust in the boardroom with the entrepreneurial drive to open doors, the consultative skill to connect LTSE’s mission to a company’s strategic priorities, and the discipline and persistence to turn complex conversations into listing commitments.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a targeted business development business plan for publicly listed companies, prioritizing prospects whose strategic objectives align with LTSE’s value proposition and building a qualified pipeline of listing opportunities.
  • Establish and deepen relationships with CEOs, C-suite leaders, Boards of Directors, and other key decision-makers, uncovering business priorities, addressing objections, and securing clear next steps that advance listing decisions.
  • Own a disciplined and transparent pipeline process, maintaining accurate prospect information, defined milestones, actionable account plans, and realistic forecasts to support accountability and effective resource allocation.
  • Convert new and existing relationships into listing commitments by developing tailored business cases, navigating multiple stakeholders, and coordinating internal expertise throughout the sales process.
  • Partner with Marketing to sharpen prospect targeting, strengthen LTSE’s visibility and credibility with prospective issuers, and develop messaging, materials, and campaigns that support measurable business development outcomes.
  • Systematically share prospect feedback, competitive insights, and barriers to adoption with the LTSE team to inform positioning, products, services, and commercial priorities.
  • Oversee prospect research efforts to ensure comprehensive, accurate, and timely insights that support pipeline development and prospect engagement.

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible experience in business development, institutional sales, equity capital markets, or a related field, including demonstrated success originating and closing complex opportunities with senior corporate decision-makers.
  • Experience managing extended sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, with clear evidence of personally building pipeline and converting relationships into measurable commercial results.
  • Financial services or capital markets experience preferred, particularly experience working with public companies, corporate leadership teams, boards, or their advisors on strategic decisions.
  • Established network of relevant corporate leaders and advisors.
  • Experience building or expanding a business development function within a small or growing organization is preferred.

LTSE's Compensation Philosophy

The target salary range for this role is $250,000 - $350,000.

Base compensation is part of a total rewards package including stock options and benefits, and may include additional performance incentives. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using multiple databases including Pave, Radford, McLagan, and other peersets, to ensure competitive and fair pay.

To determine the compensation for the role, we use a data-driven, blended rate approach to ensure we are paying competitively among our peers by benchmarking to companies of similar size and stage, and hire at the 50th percentile (midpoint) of the salary range.

Benefits

Some benefits may only be available for full-time employees. Please check with your recruiter to find out which benefits you are eligible for.

  • Drive Innovation. Make an impact working with a mission-driven company that shares your desire to create a new kind of public market.
  • Meet Great People. Work with skilled, committed, and supportive teammates, that have a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Achieve Balance. Enjoy the LTSE commitment to a sustainable remote-first work environment, including a flexible vacation policy.
  • Prioritize Health. Take charge of your health with rich medical, dental, vision, and EAP benefits. 100% of employee costs are sponsored by LTSE and there is a small, fixed employee contribution for dependent costs.
  • Focus on Family. All new parents receive up to 4 months of caregiver leave including 8 weeks of full salary continuation, all while keeping your full company-sponsored benefits for up to the full 4 months.
  • Foster Holistic Wellness and Growth. Receive reimbursements for up to $2000 worth of physical fitness, mental health and wellness, family care, pet care, and learning and development purchases and/or charitable giving annually with our Lifestyle Spending Accounts.
  • Get Set Up for Success. Launch quickly with your company provided laptop, cell phone reimbursement, and $500 home-office stipend.
  • Invest in Savings. Enroll in our 401k program offered through Human Interest, and other benefit programs offered through Gusto.
  • Take Ownership. Full-time employees receive LTSE equity options in both of our entities, with a generous exercise period for those who reach a 2-year milestone.

LTSE offers remote employment to candidates who reside in select states.

LTSE is committed to championing a performance based culture to advance the LTSE mission. This requires the highest level of employee engagement with a broad diversity of perspective, background and capability to accelerate mission actualization and impact. We believe that inclusion is a team effort, and every team member is expected to participate in building a welcoming and representative culture.

LTSE is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran, genetic information, marital status or any other legally protected status.We enthusiastically work to make our application and interview processes accessible for candidates with disabilities.

Primary care clinicians have repeatedly awarded Elation "Best in KLAS" in our category, a recognition that reflects our clinician-first approach to design. Reporting up through our Chief Product Officer, you'll work within our frontend platform team to collaborate with everyone from the designers and engineers within Elation to the physicians who rely on our product every day, delivering care to more than 25 million patients.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 7+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle's acquiring and payment-processing stack — the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient.

This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks
  • Own critical money-movement flows end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling
  • Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)
  • Operate within PCI DSS scope — tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable
  • Instrument and monitor payment health: authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement
  • Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation — within Sezzle's security and data-handling policies
  • Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

  • 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems
  • Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs
  • Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes
  • Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions. One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance. Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team. And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals. By fulfilling our three core missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals.

We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software. As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company.

In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone. You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity.

This is a demanding and rewarding role. It is a fast-paced and challenging environment. While our company is growing sustainably, we still have a lot of building and improving to do. And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries. We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership.   • Willingness and ability to take on any task - no matter how small or big - with a focus on quality
  • Resourceful and proactive in an environment that is constantly evolving
  • Driven by purpose and by winning with a team-first attitude
  • Located in Germany

Bonus Points For:

Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things:

Throughout our interview process, you will receive feedback, and usually directly in the interview. As you move through the interview process, make sure you listen to the feedback you receive and figure out how to incorporate the advice in the next step of the interview.
Compensation & Rewards
In Germany, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is EUR 58,000 - EUR 62,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Heritage Werks Group (HWG) powers the world’s most iconic brands by empowering institutional knowledge. Through Heritage Werks and NetX, we combine nearly two decades of archival expertise with enterprise technology to help organizations preserve, organize, govern, and activate institutional knowledge as a lasting business asset.

Our multidisciplinary team of AI innovators, technologists, scientists, engineers, historians, and archivists helps organizations transform trusted knowledge into business value through archival expertise, enterprise technology, and AI.

What We Are Looking For

Heritage Werks Group is seeking an experienced enterprise AI strategic alliances consultant to use established relationships to create specific client opportunities, joint pursuits, pilots, commercial proposals, and ultimately revenue for Authority AI.

This fractional consulting engagement is intended for an established alliance leader with active relationships across major consulting firms, systems integrators, and related enterprise-technology organizations.

The primary objective is to develop one-to-many distribution channels through partners that can introduce, recommend, implement, and/or resell Authority AI across multiple clients.

This is a hands-on engagement, not a strategy-only advisory role. The consultant must personally activate an existing network, secure qualified introductions, participate in partner conversations, identify specific opportunities within each partner's existing client portfolio, and help Heritage Werks Group pursue those accounts jointly.

Engagement Details

  • Reporting relationship with Heritage Werks Group executive leadership.
  • Weekly pipeline and progress reviews.
  • Potential extension based on partner engagement, qualified pipeline, revenue results, and ongoing business needs.
  • As an independent contractor, this engagement is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefits.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of the Heritage Werks Group enterprise AI offering, target customers, priority use cases, and commercial model.
  • Help refine a clear partner-facing value proposition and packaged use cases.
  • Identify and prioritize consulting firms, systems integrators, relevant practices, and senior decision-makers.
  • Personally activate existing relationships to secure qualified introductions and meetings.
  • Position the offering with alliance leaders, practice leaders, industry leaders, and other appropriate decision-makers.
  • Participate in partner conversations, discovery meetings, and product demonstrations.
  • Identify specific opportunities within each partner's existing client portfolio and help Heritage Werks Group pursue those accounts jointly.
  • Help advance joint pursuits, named-account opportunities, pilots, and commercial proposals.
  • Advise Heritage Werks Group on the incentives, services opportunities, and commercial structures needed to motivate partners.
  • Maintain a documented partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline containing named-account opportunities, next steps, estimated values, and probabilities.
  • Participate in weekly pipeline and progress reviews with Heritage Werks Group leadership.
  • Recommend which relationships and opportunities should be expanded or continued after the initial engagement.

Initial 90-Day Focus

During the initial engagement, the consultant will:

Days 1–15: Position and Prioritize

  • Learn Authority AI and its priority use cases.
  • Refine the partner-facing value proposition.
  • Identify and prioritize target firms, practices, and decision-makers.
  • Begin outreach through established relationships.

Days 16–45: Open Doors

  • Secure qualified partner and channel meetings.
  • Introduce Heritage Werks Group leadership to relevant contacts.
  • Participate in discovery meetings and product demonstrations.
  • Identify specific joint-client opportunities within partner portfolios.

Days 46–90: Build Pipeline

  • Convert the strongest partner relationships into named-account pursuits.
  • Develop pilot opportunities and commercial proposals.
  • Advance joint opportunities with partners.
  • Build a measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline.

  • Develop a clear and compelling partner-facing offering.
  • Secure approximately 10 qualified partner or channel meetings.
  • Generate meaningful partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities.
  • Advance at least three pilot or commercial proposals.
  • Maintain a measurable pipeline with documented next steps and estimated values.
  • A goal of securing one or two wins.
  • Create a practical plan for developing a repeatable partner channel.

Requirements

Qualifications

The ideal consultant will have:

• At least 15 years of experience in enterprise-technology sales, strategic alliances, channel development, or partner-led growth.

  • A demonstrated record of generating measurable pipeline or revenue through consulting firms, systems integrators, cloud providers, or reseller ecosystems.

Job Title: Senior Director, Portfolio and Project Management Lead

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

The position contributes to the overall partnership program strategy and driving its vision and mission. Leveraging deep therapeutic and functional area expertise, the Portfolio and Program Management Lead is accountable for the lifecycle management of drug development and commercialization in the partnership program. The Lead provides leadership for global product development strategies within the partnership program, establishes clear processes for team management and communication, drives strategic team decision-making and delivery of team goals and objectives. Lead process improvement initiatives and optimize team efficiency, quality, and performance, collaborate within and outside the partnership program teams to deliver on commitments to the organization and to patients.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain project plans, schedules, and lead team planning session including develop team charter, define project scope, and ensure global cross-functional alignment.
  • Support the partnership program leadership on developing goals and operational KPIs.
  • Plan, track, and manage project milestones, goals, KPIs, project budget, dependencies, and critical path.
  • Implement good project and risk management practices.
  • Liaise with internal and external collaborators to deliver high quality work product, presentations, etc.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives, e.g., headcount and budget planning, budget change control, program management dashboards and reports, risk management, etc., and continuous identify any opportunities for improvement.
  • Assume the responsibilities and leadership of independently providing alliance management for drug development partners and assure smooth external collaboration.
  • Consult with Advisory Committee for relevant topics and incorporate the ideas into strategy and execution if appropriate.
  • Track project status, goals, operational KPIs, and enforce quality KPIs.
  • Ensure appropriate systems and technologies deployed in the partnership program and well interfaced with Global R&D.
  • Champions a global mindset and approach to foster collaboration and consistency across the organization.
  • Organize and coordinate core team meetings and facilitate the meetings to drive efficient discussion, alignment and decision making.
  • Understand competitors’ movements and market intelligence and be able to translate the insight and acumen into developing strategies.
  • Participate company-wise standard discussion, finalization, and implementation.
  • Manage the governance process for the partnership program.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A (individual contributor role; no direct reports).

Computer Skills: Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite

Other Qualifications:

  • Solid knowledge and expertise of managing scaled and complex global portfolio and programs
  • Good understanding of worldwide clinical trial expertise and best practices
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain positive work relationships to effectively interface at all levels across the organization
  • PMP certification a plus
  • Experience in Oncology/Hematology drug development is preferred
  • Fluent in written and verbal English.
  • Proven ability to make sound judgement and decisions. Possess the ability to quickly assess problems/situations and provide effective resolution/solution
  • Detail-oriented without losing sight of the big picture

Travel: Up to 20%. Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Education Required:

Master’s degree (PhD preferred) with 10+ years’ experience in drug development or commercial within academia, consulting, pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. 5+ years in leadership roles in a multicultural & international (global) portfolio environment a plus.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About the Role

As our Growth Lead for Client Engagement & Retention you'll be both a strategic owner and hands-on operator responsible for building one of Prosper's most important unowned growth levers.

As we expand to four products and surpass $70M ARR, there is significant opportunity to improve how clients move through their journey with Prosper: from first engagement through scheduling, assessment to therapy transition, therapy retention, and reactivation. You'll bring structure to this opportunity by identifying the biggest growth opportunities, developing the strategy and systems to address them, and building an engine that supports clients throughout their entire lifecycle and scales with the business.

This is a unique opportunity at the intersection of strategy, growth, analytics, and marketing. You'll report to the Head of Growth Marketing, working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Clinical Operations to understand where clients are getting stuck in their journey with Prosper. Then, you’ll size each opportunity, determine the highest-impact interventions, and action those insights into measurable improvements.

You'll be Prosper's first dedicated Client Engagement & Retention hire and the strategic owner of the function. You'll have autonomy to define the strategic roadmap, establish the operating model, build the underlying systems, and ultimately determine how Engagement & Retention evolves as a core growth function.

You'll thrive in this role if you're equal parts strategist and operator: someone who can take an ambiguous growth problem, structure it from first principles, get into the data, develop a clear hypothesis, and then roll up your sleeves to build and test the solution.

You Will

  • Own the client journey: Define how we engage clients across the full journey: from lead-to-schedule through onboarding, retention, and cross-product hand-offs. Identify the highest-impact opportunities and translate them into a clear roadmap and operating plan. Then, make them happen.
  • Identify and size growth opportunities: Use client behavior, funnel data, and qualitative insights to identify where we're losing clients or leaving growth on the table. Size the opportunity, diagnose the underlying barriers, and determine the right intervention - whether that's a lifecycle campaign, funnel change, product improvement, or operational solution. You'll partner with Engineering, Product, and Clinical Operations on cross-functional solutions and directly build marketing-led interventions yourself.
  • Build a rigorous experimentation engine: Develop hypotheses, prioritize tests, define success metrics, and establish a repeatable testing framework. Turn learnings into scalable improvements across the client journey.
  • Build the lifecycle marketing infrastructure, hands on: Own the systems, segmentation, triggers, journeys, dashboards, and operating rhythms required to make lifecycle marketing a reliable growth engine. You'll be hands-on in platforms like , but the focus is on building a scalable engine that delivers the best, most cohesive client experiment vs. simply executing campaigns.
  • Create and optimize client communications: Develop thoughtful messaging across email, SMS, and future lifecycle channels. Use customer psychology, experimentation, and performance data to continuously improve engagement and conversion.
  • Build the function: Establish the processes, metrics, documentation, and ways of working that allow Client Engagement & Retention to improve and scale as Prosper grows. Over time, build the team and capabilities needed to support the function.

About You

  • 5–8 years of experience in strategy, consulting, growth marketing, product, business operations, and/or another highly analytic operating role. You’ve worked at a high growth consumer start-up. You may have started in consulting or investment banking and are now a product marketer, growth product manager, or other highly analytical + customer oriented strategic operator.
  • Structured strategic + iterative problem solver. You build structure to make experimentation fast and repeatable. You can take an ambiguous growth question, structure it, identify the key drivers, and determine where to focus.
  • You are analytically rigorous: You're comfortable working with funnel and customer data, sizing opportunities, building models or analyses, and translating insights into actionable decisions. You can turn a sea of data into a single, clear insight or client segment.
  • You crave ownership. You are ready to build a function from scratch, setting the strategic direction, owning the outcomes end-to-end, identifying the right inputs and levers to achieve our goals. You are ready to own everything from the long term strategy to the cross-functional problem/solution diagnosis to the execution of a single email.
  • Hands on Learner: You’re willing to roll up your sleeves and learn how to operate in , establish trigger logic, do your own copywriting, and build a continuous experimentation engine.
  • You are customer-obsessed: You always put the client first, understanding their POV, and prioritizing their needs across their entire lifecycle with Prosper. You will do whatever it takes to understand our clients better - whether it’s calling them yourself, running scrappy surveys, or scouring Reddit.
  • Mission-driven. You’re excited by the chance to make meaningful, category-defining work that improves access to care.

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.title: Operations Manager in Remote E-Commerce Agentur (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsDu möchtest die operativen Systeme einer wachsenden Agentur verantworten und Prozesse bauen, die auch ohne dich funktionieren?
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest die operativen Systeme einer wachsenden Agentur verantworten und Prozesse bauen, die auch ohne dich funktionieren? Operations ist bei EVOLVE der Hebel, der das ganze Team schneller macht. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass Ziele, Prozesse und Automationen im Alltag perfekt ineinandergreifen.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Im wöchentlichen Check-in fällt dir auf, dass drei Quartalsprojekte seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status, sondern schaust dir den Prozess dahinter an. Gemeinsam mit dem Teamlead gehst du den Ablauf durch: Die Zahlen liegen verteilt an 3 unterschiedlichen Orten und müssten jeden Montag von Hand zusammengetragen werden. Kein Wunder, dass es nicht passiert.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. Es entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen, die Zahlen laufen automatisiert in ein Dashboard. Umgesetzt mit unserem Prozess-Team.

Im Reporting an die Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch. Einen Tag später nimmst du dir schon den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Abläufe von selbst auffallen.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote seit Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Operations bei EVOLVE

Nur Prozesse, die nachgehalten werden, haben Wirkung. Diese Rolle lebt deshalb vom Tagesgeschäft und von Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit. Genau darin liegt ihr Hebel.

  • Ziele bis in den Alltag. Jahres- und Quartalsziele werden zu Maßnahmen, Meilensteinen und Check-ins, die wirklich stattfinden

  • Automation statt Handarbeit. Was zweimal manuell passiert, läuft danach über Make, n8n oder Claude

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

  • Das EVOLVE OS hält all das zusammen. Ziele, Prozesse, Automationen und KI sind bei uns kein Flickenteppich, sondern ein System hinter unserer Dienstleistung. Du sorgst dafür, dass es im Alltag funktioniert und laufend besser wird

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Ziele operativ machen: Du übersetzt Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar

  • Operative Abläufe: Du steuerst die Abläufe innerhalb der Agentur, bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen bis Onboarding

  • Automationen: Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Du setzt selbst um oder mit Unterstützung unseres Teams

  • Datenanalyse: Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten dort, wo sie gebraucht werden, und betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag mit Check-ins und Remindern

  • Bottlenecks: Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du arbeitest mit den Teamleads aller sechs Fachbereiche auf Augenhöhe, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Für die technische Umsetzung von Automationen steht dir unser AI- und Prozess-Team zur Seite. Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

  • Du kennst Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana und verstehst Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Teamleads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie Claude und ChatGPT. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur um Texte zu erstellen

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, weil wir vollständig remote arbeiten

Der Rahmen

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR. Es geht um gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Head of Operations.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, menschlich und fachlich.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Wie lange das dauert: Wir legen Wert auf einen schnellen Bewerbungsprozess. Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Prozessen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst die Abläufe unserer sechs Fachbereiche kennen und übernimmst das Zielsystem im Alltag mit Check-ins, Remindern und Dashboards.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest Prozesse und Automationen in deinen Bereichen eigenständig. Dazu kommt die operative Steuerung der Finance- und People-Ops-Abläufe.

Langfristig. Fachlaufbahn mit Schwerpunkt Systeme und Automation oder Führungslaufbahn in Richtung Head of Operations, sobald Zielsystem, Prozesslandschaft und KPI-Landschaft stehen. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

At NVIDIA Lightspeed Studios we are passionate about pushing the limits of technology, and we're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team! We help shape the future of games by combining the best AI and graphics technology NVIDIA has to offer with the most advanced games and tools in the industry. In this role, you'll help take new, unannounced projects powered by state-of-the-art AI models from research to real-time, interactive gaming experiences. If you're passionate about bringing generative AI to games, we'd love to hear from you!


Some existing projects we've been working on:

  • RTX Remix is an open-source modding platform for remastering classic games with full path tracing, DLSS 4.5, and generative AI tools that turn low-resolution textures into physically based materials. Newer features like RTX Remix Logic and Advanced Particle VFX let modders add dynamic, gameplay-driven effects:
  • Zorah is our neural rendering tech demo for the GeForce RTX 50 Series launch at CES 2025. It features massive, fully path-traced scenes in Unreal Engine 5, powered by RTX Neural Shaders, RTX Mega Geometry, and DLSS 4:
  • Project R2X is a vision-enabled AI avatar for RTX PCs that can see the screen, assist with apps, and summarize documents. It is rendered with RTX Neural Faces and animated by a diffusion-based Audio2Face-3D model:
  • NVIDIA AI for Gaming brings conversational, autonomous game characters to life with small on-device models for speech, intelligence, and animation. It powers AI teammates in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, AI citizens in inZOI, and an in-game advisor in Total War: PHARAOH:

What you'll be doing:

  • Build and ship software for upcoming, not-yet-announced projects that bring world models and video diffusion models to real-time gaming, from prototype to release.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models, including data curation and adapting models to game-specific content and controls.
  • Optimize models and inference for latency, token throughput, and quality, using techniques such as distillation, quantization, and reduced-step sampling on RTX devices and in the cloud.
  • Profile and remove bottlenecks across the stack, from model architecture to GPU kernels.
  • Integrate models into Unreal Engine, Unity, and custom engines, so they run efficiently alongside rendering.
  • Lead technical decisions, mentor other engineers, and collaborate with NVIDIA Research, rendering, and art teams.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work shipping AI, deep learning, or machine learning systems.
  • Expert-level C++ and Python.
  • Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning deep learning models with PyTorch or a similar framework, including distributed training.
  • Experience in one or more of these areas: video generation, world models, diffusion or flow-matching models, transformers, or neural rendering.
  • Experience optimizing GPU inference with CUDA, TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton.
  • A track record of turning complex prototypes into shipped products, and clear communication across research, engineering, and art.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience with interactive, action-conditioned, or real-time world models or video generation.
  • Experience developing custom CUDA or Triton kernels.
  • Experience with game engine development or real-time rendering pipelines.
  • Open-source contributions (such as Diffusers, FastVideo, vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM), publications, or patents.

If you're motivated to join the Lightspeed Studios Engineering team, please submit your resume and a cover letter explaining your proven experience and why you'd be a phenomenal fit for NVIDIA Lightspeed. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Position Overview

  • Hands-on Snowflake engineering: Design, build, optimize, and operate Snowflake data models, pipelines, stored procedures, and high-volume data processing patterns.
  • MDM/Reltio enablement: Partner with MDM and Product teams to support HCO Master data ingestion, outbound extracts, cross-reference data, golden record consumption, survivorship outputs, and downstream publishing patterns.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Work with Product, Engineering, MDM, Data Science, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to align data solutions to enterprise priorities.
  • Modern ELT execution: Use dbt or similar ELT tooling to develop reliable, maintainable, testable, and observable data pipelines.
  • Cost and performance ownership: Drive Snowflake performance tuning, warehouse sizing, workload management, cost tracking, and cost optimization practices.

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy, Consolidation, and Integration

  • Partner with Data Science leadership to rationalize and consolidate the enterprise data landscape across products, platforms, and acquired capabilities.
  • Define reusable data integration patterns for batch, micro-batch, near-real-time, and application-to-application data exchange.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business data needs, source-system realities, and enterprise application integration requirements.
  • Design scalable patterns for ingesting, transforming, mastering, and publishing data across operational and analytical use cases.
  • Help establish standards for data contracts, schema evolution, data quality, lineage, and data ownership.

MDM / Reltio Data Engineering Enablement

  • Design and build data pipelines that load source data into Reltio MDM and extract mastered outputs from Reltio for downstream Snowflake, analytics, AI, and operational use cases.
  • Partner with MDM configuration and Product Management teams to translate HCO mastering requirements into data pipeline, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and publishing patterns.
  • Work with Reltio APIs, exports, crosswalks/XREFs, event-based integration patterns, and bulk load/extract mechanisms as needed to support inbound and outbound data flows.
  • Engineer integration patterns for HCO Master data, including party/entity, address, identifier, hierarchy, relationship, match/merge, survivorship, and golden record outputs.
  • Support source ingestion and reference data integration involving datasets such as HIN, DEA, NPI, NCPDP, 340B/PHS, channel outlet data, customer/account data, and other life sciences master/reference sources.
  • Develop validation and reconciliation processes to compare source data, Reltio mastered data, Snowflake curated data, and downstream consumption layers.
  • Help operationalize MDM outputs for business-facing data products, semantic models, reporting tables, APIs, and AI-ready datasets.

Snowflake Platform Engineering and Optimization

  • Design Snowflake database, schema, table, view, and semantic-layer patterns that support performance, governance, and maintainability.
  • Optimize Snowflake workloads using clustering, micro-partition awareness, warehouse sizing, query profiling, caching behavior, and workload isolation.
  • Implement Snowflake cost tracking and optimization practices, including warehouse utilization monitoring, inefficient query identification, and cost allocation by workload, team, or use case.
  • Build scalable SQL and Snowflake stored procedure logic for large-volume data processing and analytical workloads.
  • Apply secure Snowflake design patterns including RBAC, masking, access isolation, auditing, and environment separation.

ETL/ELT, dbt, Python, and Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable ELT pipelines using dbt or comparable modern data transformation tooling.
  • Develop Python-based automation for API integration, file processing, metadata management, validation, orchestration support, and operational tooling.
  • Develop modular, tested, and reusable transformation models for raw, curated, mastered, and business-ready data layers.
  • Implement automated data quality checks, source freshness checks, reconciliation, logging, and exception-handling patterns.
  • Build orchestration-ready pipelines that support dependency management, restartability, incremental loads, and operational monitoring.
  • Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on CI/CD, deployment automation, environment promotion, and operational runbooks for data pipelines.

Data Modeling and Big Data Processing

  • Spearhead logical and physical data modeling efforts for enterprise analytical, operational, MDM, and AI-ready datasets.
  • Design models that balance normalization, dimensional modeling, medallion/lakehouse concepts, and application-specific consumption needs.
  • Create denormalized reporting and semantic-model-ready structures that simplify business consumption and reduce ambiguity for AI/LLM use cases.
  • Process and optimize large data volumes in Snowflake using efficient SQL, PL/SQL-style procedural logic, Snowflake Scripting, and performance-aware design.
  • Create reusable patterns for historical tracking, snapshots, audit columns, data versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure data models support downstream BI, AI/ML, semantic models, data apps, MDM Explorer/Entity 360 use cases, and enterprise reporting.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, database engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform development in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including architecture, performance tuning, security design, cost optimization, and cost tracking.
  • Thorough understanding of Snowflake design patterns for analytical workloads, high-volume data processing, data sharing, and multi-environment deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools; dbt experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL-style development experience, including complex transformations, stored procedures, performance tuning, and large-scale data processing.
  • Python experience for data automation, API integration, file handling, data validation, metadata processing, or operational tooling.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise data models, curated data layers, semantic layers, and reusable data products.
  • Experience with data integration patterns across enterprise applications, APIs, files, cloud storage, operational systems, MDM platforms, and analytical platforms.
  • Working understanding of Master Data Management concepts such as golden records, crosswalks/XREFs, match/merge, survivorship, hierarchies, entity relationships, stewardship, and data quality.
  • Experience partnering with MDM, Product, or business teams to translate mastering requirements into source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, validations, and downstream data consumption patterns.
  • Ability to work directly with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, explain design tradeoffs, and drive alignment.
  • Experience implementing data quality, lineage, auditability, observability, and operational monitoring within data pipelines.
  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on senior individual contributor who can also influence strategy and engineering standards.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Reltio MDM, including inbound data loads, outbound exports, Reltio APIs, crosswalks, match/merge outputs, survivorship outputs, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Experience in life sciences, healthcare, pharma commercialization, HCO/HCP mastering, patient data, channel data, customer master, or commercial data platforms.
  • Experience with life sciences reference and commercial datasets such as HIN, DEA, NPI, NCPDP, 340B/PHS, 844, 852, 867, chargebacks, gross-to-net, government pricing, PBR, or UBR.
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Dagster, dbt Cloud jobs, cloud-native schedulers, or similar tools.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and storage patterns, especially Azure or AWS object storage integrated with Snowflake.
  • Exposure to AI-ready data architecture, feature stores, ML datasets, semantic models, or AI/ML pipeline enablement.
  • Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, Git-based development, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

jobs.description:
About Digital Promise Global

Digital Promise is a global nonprofit working to expand opportunity for every learner. We work with educators, researchers, technology leaders, and communities to design, investigate, and scale innovations that support learners. Our vision is that every person engages in powerful learning experiences that lead to a life of well-being, fulfillment, and economic mobility. For more information, visit the Digital Promise website and follow Digital Promise for updates.

About the Position

Digital Promise is seeking a Director, Edtech R&D for the Edtech R&D team. Our work brings together diverse educators, researchers, and product developers to co-design, implement, and advance more effective and equitable EdTech resources.

The Director of Edtech R&D leads strategic initiatives that bridge the gap between developers, educators, and researchers to build evidence-based tools and implementation guidance for K-12 learning technologies. The director will lead projects that ground product development in educational research, utilize meaningful measures to understand impact on learner outcomes, and champion a collaborative co-design process alongside multidisciplinary teams of subject matter experts and end-users. The Director drives the vision and strategy for emerging technologies work for the Edtech R&D team at Digital Promise and coordinates internally and externally with partners to facilitate the development of innovative K12 learning technologies to improve the learning experiences of those historically and systematically excluded in traditional educational systems. The Director of Edtech R&D reports to the Deputy Director of EdTech R&D and manages a team of project directors and managers.

Responsibilities

  • Direct Edtech Product R&D Projects: Lead the Edtech R&D team’s projects to center education research, evidence, and historically and systematically excluded learners throughout design and development. This includes leading the team’s strategy for the research and development of emerging EdTech products and product features, ensuring timely delivery, resource allocation, and effective communication.
  • Support Edtech Partnerships: Leverage and cultivate cross-team collaborations across Digital Promise, as well as external relationships with other organizations, product developers, research institutions, policymakers, education agencies, and industry experts to develop partnerships and strategy for EdTech-related innovations and initiatives.
  • Design and execute research: Collaborate with colleagues across the organization to develop proposals, analysis plans, and high-quality research products using a diverse range of data sets and quantitative research methods.
  • Lead and Facilitate Edtech R&D Strategy: Identify and disseminate capacity building tools and strategies that enable EdTech teams to design with evidence, design for excluded populations, design for learner variability, scale and sustain their products, and ultimately improve educational outcomes.
  • Synthesize Learnings Across Projects: Collaborate with research and practice functional teams to leverage findings across projects, identify themes and synthesize findings to iteratively inform product development strategy and goals for the EdTech industry, philanthropic organizations, and investors.
  • Lead Cross-functional Edtech Initiatives: Develop and lead cross-functional partnerships across research institutions, product developers, and educators to design, implement, and test impactful learning solutions.
  • Budget Management: Collaborate with the Operations team on project operations and budgeting, to include expense and revenue management and knowledge management.
  • Monitor Evolving Innovations in Edtech and Emerging Technologies: Stay current with the latest trends, research, and advancements in educational technology and emerging fields, analyzing their potential impact on education and recommending actionable strategies to support EdTech R&D.
  • Commitment to equity in education outcomes and diversity, equity, and inclusion: deep commitment to eliminating opportunity and achievement gaps for historically and systematically excluded learners, with a strong understanding of the challenges those communities face and demonstrated experience leading the design of inclusive EdTech solutions developed for and with diverse participants

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in learning analytics, learning sciences, experimental research, or mixed methods research.
  • At least 5 years of experience leading and managing research and development projects, preferably in the education sector.
  • At least 5 years of experience effectively supporting teams in the development of solutions (e.g., programs, curriculum, tools, etc...).
  • Demonstrated experience and knowledge in developing, implementing and facilitating project management process, human-centered design, technical and non-technical solution design and development.
  • Ability to execute on high-value and high-visibility deliverables (tools, reports, presentations) for internal and external audiences, with attention to detail and excellence.
  • Proven ability to translate complex research into policy-relevant insights and advocacy strategies.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the education sector, marketplace of education solutions and new methods and models for researching and designing education programs and products.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication and writing skills.
  • Experience managing teams and direct reports to support collaboration, growth, and impact.
  • Experience developing and managing partnerships and multi-stakeholder projects, including program design, evaluation, and funder reporting, with a demonstrated ability to deliver large-scale outputs on time and on budget while managing multiple external stakeholders across sectors.
  • Demonstrated commitment to personal reflection on equity-centered ways of being, mindsets, and ways of working. A commitment to advocating for equity in education and an understanding of communicating to and with diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage competing tasks, deadlines, requirements, and decisions.

At Digital Promise, we also seek candidates with:

  • A strong commitment to working toward Digital Promise’s mission and impact goals
  • An interest in redesigning learning systems to better serve those who are historically and systemically excluded
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional team members to ensure information is shared, projects are completed on time, and goals are reached.

Working Conditions

Digital Promise Global is a hybrid organization. The position is primarily working in a remote environment. Employees are expected to travel at least 4 times a year for in-person meetings and the annual staff retreat. Additional travel may be required based on role and responsibilities.

Physical/Sensory Demands:Fast-paced working environment. Extensive computer usage and online engagement & communication. Must be willing to build inclusive relationships and collaborate with employees at all levels within the organization and external partners.

Compensation

We consider candidate experience and location when determining where a candidate may fall within that range. Digital Promise Global offers a competitive total rewards package including coverage of 85% of health insurance premiums for employee coverage and 75% of health insurance premiums for dependent and family coverage, 15 vacation days, 12 sick days, 3% 401k employer contribution, 3% employer 401k match, and a flexible work environment.

The full-time salary range for the position is based on geographical regions, with exact salary depending on relevant experience.

California:$145,640-a4163,845

National:$119,160-$134,055

To Apply

Please apply and submit your resume, cover letter, and salary requirements. Applicants are encouraged to submit their materials as soon as possible. Submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis until the search is successful.

Digital Promise is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applications without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex/gender, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, marital or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Our AI-enabled solutions help enable faster study startups, smarter site selection, cleaner data, greater transparency and streamlined regulatory compliance.


We are seeking a Senior Manager, Applied AI to provide technical and delivery leadership for a growing portfolio of artificial intelligence capabilities supporting internal business teams across our organization.


Working at the intersection of AI strategy, product delivery and technical execution, this leader will translate business needs into practical, secure and scalable AI capabilities spanning generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning and intelligent workflows. The role requires strong technical depth and hands-on engagement with AI architecture, engineering, data and platform decisions, while leading and developing a multidisciplinary team and providing end-to-end accountability across multiple AI initiatives.


A key focus will be evolving AI delivery from individual solutions toward a scalable, reusable technical operating model—driving reuse of AI components, services, platforms and architectural patterns; strengthening evaluation, observability and governance practices; improving engineering, development and deployment standards; and ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value, reliability and responsible use.


What you'll do:

  • Lead a portfolio of applied AI initiatives from opportunity definition and prioritization through technical design, development, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement, establishing clear technical roadmaps, delivery plans, measures of success and resource priorities across the portfolio.
  • Provide technical and delivery leadership across generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, translating business opportunities and workflow challenges into scalable capabilities and making or guiding key decisions across solution architecture, model and platform selection, data and knowledge architecture, orchestration, evaluation and production engineering.
  • Lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary technical teams, including AI engineers and data scientists, providing technical direction and mentorship while establishing clear ownership and accountability and allocating resources based on business value, technical complexity, risk, dependencies and capacity.
  • Drive reusable enterprise AI capabilities, including platforms, components, services, APIs and architectural patterns, to accelerate delivery, establish consistent engineering practices, reduce future solution costs and prevent unnecessary duplication across teams and technology investments.
  • Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-grade AI solutions leveraging large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, orchestration frameworks, machine learning and emerging technologies, with deep engagement across solution architecture, data integration, knowledge and semantic layers, model and platform selection, AI/ML engineering, security considerations and production deployment.
  • Establish and continuously improve robust AI evaluation and operational practices, including technical testing, model and application evaluation, monitoring, observability, performance measurement, reliability engineering and continuous improvement to ensure solutions remain accurate, reliable, secure and fit for purpose in production.
  • Embed governance and responsible AI practices throughout the AI solution lifecycle, incorporating appropriate data protection, security, privacy, validation and enterprise compliance requirements into architecture, engineering, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.

Director - Business Development

About PSPSync

PSPSync Limited is a dynamic and growing provider of Patient Support Program (PSP) services, delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions that simplify access to therapies for patients across Canada. We partner closely with healthcare providers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to deliver patient-centric programs that improve outcomes while maintaining the highest standards of privacy, security, and compliance.

About the Role

PSPSync is seeking a strategic, results-oriented Director, Business Development to lead revenue growth, new client acquisition and strategic partnerships with pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers across Canada.
This is a hands-on commercial role built on three pillars: winning RFPs, proactive client outreach and market research that tells us where to compete next. You will own the full pursuit cycle, from identifying an opportunity in the Canadian drug pipeline to leading the bid defense and handing a signed program to our Operations team. As PSPSync grows, you will also build and mentor the business development and proposal team.

Key Responsibilities

RFPs and Proposals

  • Lead the end-to-end RFI and RFP process, including bid/no-bid decisions, timelines, compliance matrices and final submissions.
    • Bring together Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Finance and IT/Data to build compelling, compliant responses.
    • Develop business cases, financial models, pricing and commercial proposals that are competitive and profitable.
    • Craft win themes that showcase SyncSight™, our centralized and decentralized PSP models and our bilingual national reach.
    • Prepare and lead client presentations, capability demos and bid defense meetings.
    • Build and maintain a proposal content library, templates and past-performance case studies; run win/loss debriefs to improve win rates.
    Client Outreach and Relationships
    • Identify and pursue new pharmaceutical and biotech clients, with a focus on specialty, biosimilars and newly launching therapies entering the Canadian market.
    • Build executive industry relationships with Market Access, Patient Services, Brand and Commercial leaders, as well as other relevant industry stakeholders.
    • Develop and execute account plans and outreach campaigns; represent PSPSync at industry events and conferences.
    • Grow existing accounts by expanding into RWE support, copay cards, pharmacovigilance and new indications.
    • Lead contract negotiations with support from Legal and Finance.
    • Manage the pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce; ensure smooth handoff to Operations at program launch.
    • Ensure every client interaction reflects PSPSync's standard for quality and partnership.
    Market Research and Competitive Intelligence
    • Track the Canadian drug pipeline, including published manufacturer pipelines, Health Canada approvals, CDA-AMC reviews, pCPA negotiations and provincial listings, to spot PSP opportunities early.
    • Monitor the competitive landscape among Canadian PSP providers and specialty pharmacy networks; maintain competitor profiles and pricing insights.
    • Analyze trends in patient support, market access, biosimilars, digital health and privacy regulation to shape service offerings.
    • Share insights with leadership to shape our services, positioning and go-to-market plans.
    Strategy, Team and Performance
    • Create and deliver the annual business development strategy, with clear revenue and market growth targets.
    • Manage the business development budget, sales forecasts and pipeline metrics in Salesforce.
    • Monitor sales performance and client engagement analytics, and report results to the executive team.
    • Partner closely with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology to deliver on what we promise.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Health Sciences or Life Sciences, or equivalent professional experience.
    • 5+ years in sales or business development within the Canadian healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, with a consistent record of exceeding revenue targets.
    • Direct experience selling Patient Support Programs, hub services, specialty pharmacy or commercialization services to manufacturers.
    • A proven track record of leading complex RFP responses and winning multi-year contracts.
    • Deep understanding of the Canadian market access landscape: Health Canada, CADA, CDA-AM, pCPA, public and private payers, and specialty drug distribution.
    • Experience managing complex sales cycles and enterprise clients.
    • Strong financial acumen, including pricing, forecasting, budgeting, building business cases and ROI analysis.
    • Exceptional writing, presentation and negotiation skills, with the executive presence to influence senior healthcare leaders.
    • Working knowledge of CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and proposal management practices.

Preferred

• MBA or related Master’s degree.

  • Established relationships with Canadian pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers.
    • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance and Canadian privacy requirements (PIPEDA, PHIPA).
    • Experience building and leading a business development or proposal team.
    • Bilingual in English and French is a bonus.
    • APMP (Association of Proposal Management Professionals) certification.

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary of 120-150K CAD, bonus eligibility, and RRSP matching
    • Flexibility: Remote and hybrid work options.
    • Time off: Generous vacation time and paid sick leave.
    • Health and wellness: Comprehensive benefits package

Impact: A leadership seat in a founder-led, growing company that helps Canadian patients access the therapies they need.

Please note: The Company does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position. This job posting relates to an existing vacancy.

Salary: $120,000 - $150,000
