You’ll serve as the first dedicated people hire, working closely with leadership to own the end-to-end recruitment funnel while also helping implement lightweight HR processes related to onboarding, compliance, and employee engagement. You’ll act as a key culture-builder within the organization, owning recruitment operations across our offices located in Waterloo, and playing a critical role in identifying, sourcing, and closing top talent through both inbound and outbound channels.

Why BusPlanner?

BusPlanner is the leading provider of student transportation management software in Canada. Our platform is used by hundreds of the largest school boards and consortia from coast to coast (Toronto District School Board, York Region District School Board, Peel Region School Board, and many others), helping optimize bus routes, manage planning and operations, and streamline communication between school transportation teams and families.

We are a proud Canadian company with deep expertise in K–12 education and a proven track record of supporting the unique needs of Canadian school districts. We are scaling rapidly and investing in growing our team to better serve our clients from British Columbia to Newfoundland.

BusPlanner’s leadership team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have significant experience in building and growing multiple successful software businesses including: (i) FieldEdge, a leading provider of software for the field services market which the team grew more than 5x and sold to a mega-cap private equity fund, and (ii) AutoLeap, a leader in the auto repair software market that has raised more than $50 million from some of the most reputable VC firms in Silicon Valley.

This is a rare opportunity to join a purpose-driven team at the heart of Canada’s education technology ecosystem.

Requirements

As a successful People & Talent Acquisition Director, you will:

  • Act as the primary recruiting leader, owning the full-cycle hiring process across all functions at BusPlanner.
  • Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, creating job descriptions, proactively sourcing top talent via LinkedIn and other platforms, conducting candidate screens, coordinating interviews, and managing offer letters.
  • Identify, engage, and close top-tier candidates through outbound and inbound strategies.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand talent needs and develop sourcing strategies that deliver results quickly.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future needs.
  • Own and improve core recruiting processes to enhance candidate experience and time-to-hire.
  • Support lightweight HR operations including onboarding, performance processes, and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate employee data in our HRIS (Workable).
  • Assist with basic HR functions such as documentation, engagement coordination, and internal communication.

You Should Apply If:

  • You are entrepreneurial and resourceful — you take initiative, adapt quickly, and enjoy solving complex challenges.
  • You are a hunter when it comes to talent — you love identifying, engaging, and winning over exceptional candidates.
  • You are process-minded — you're comfortable implementing repeatable recruiting systems.
  • You are flexible and collaborative — you're willing to take on tasks outside your job description to help the team move forward.
  • You are people-oriented — you value strong team relationships and want to help others succeed.
  • You are organized and responsive — you balance recruiting urgency and candidate experience with ease.
  • You are a confident communicator — you’re comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders, in person or virtually.

You Should Not Apply If:

  • You are not interested in proactively recruiting talent via outbound channels.
  • You are not interested in rolling up your sleeves and having a “just-get-it-done” mindset.
  • Looking for a typical 9-5 where every day looks the same.
  • You prefer highly structured environments with rigid processes and step-by-step instructions.
  • You are uncomfortable juggling both strategic and hands-on HR responsibilities in the same role.
  • You are looking for a job where you can stay behind the scenes — this role involves direct interaction with leadership and team members.
  • You are not comfortable taking ownership, following up proactively, or working with some ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in HR, people operations, or talent roles, ideally within SaaS, startups, or early-stage companies.
  • Experience working in environments where HR functions had to be built or redefined from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with Canadian and U.S. labor laws and employee lifecycle best practices.
  • Ability to manage a large and varied portfolio of HR responsibilities, including proactive and reactive support.

jobs.title: Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAbout StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Proactive Threat team is responsible for identifying vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across Stripe's systems, applications, networks, and cloud infrastructure — before adversaries do. We operate as a hybrid offensive function: conducting penetration testing, emulating real-world threat actors through red team operations, and partnering closely with our defensive security teams to validate detection capabilities and improve Stripe's overall security posture.

We are builders first. Our team develops custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive capabilities and enable repeatable, high-fidelity assessments. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer.

The team is distributed across the United States, primarily operating in Eastern and Pacific time zones, and collaborates regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe — including teams in Europe and Asia.

What you'll do

As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you will simulate the tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) of real-world adversaries to uncover security risks across Stripe's products and infrastructure. You'll conduct hands-on penetration testing, lead red team engagements, and collaborate with blue team counterparts to validate and improve detection and response capabilities. Your work will directly influence how Stripe builds, ships, and secures financial infrastructure used by millions of businesses worldwide.

Beyond assessments, you'll design and build offensive tooling and automation that amplifies the team's impact. You'll leverage threat intelligence to prioritize testing efforts, contribute to incident investigations when needed, and act as a subject-matter expert for security initiatives across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive penetration tests across web applications, APIs, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), mobile applications, and internal infrastructure
  • Plan and execute red team engagements that emulate the TTPs of cyber and criminal threat actors targeting financial services, including initial access, lateral movement, persistence, and data exfiltration scenarios
  • Perform assumed-breach and objective-based assessments to test detection and response capabilities in coordination with defensive teams
  • Partner with detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response teams to validate security controls, identify coverage gaps, and improve detection fidelity
  • Contribute adversary tradecraft insights to inform detection rule development, threat hunting hypotheses, and incident response playbooks
  • Support incident investigations by providing offensive expertise, log analysis, and root cause analysis when required
  • Design, develop, and maintain custom offensive tools, scripts, and automation frameworks to enhance assessment efficiency and coverage
  • Build internal platforms and workflows that enable scalable, repeatable offensive operations
  • Contribute to internal security tooling repositories and champion engineering best practices within the team
  • Automate repetitive testing tasks, payload generation, and reporting workflows using modern development practices
  • Produce clear, actionable reports that communicate technical findings, business risk, and remediation guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Act as a subject-matter expert and primary point of contact for stakeholder teams engaged in offensive security programs and Stripe-wide security initiatives
  • Lead offensive security projects end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing
  • Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques; share research internally and contribute to the broader security community

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a related field
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience building tools, automation, or custom exploits
  • Deep knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and common vulnerability classes (injection, auth flaws, business logic, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud-native attack techniques and misconfigurations
  • Proficiency with offensive tooling such as Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver, BloodHound, or similar frameworks
  • Familiarity with adversary tradecraft and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, including TTPs for initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and exfiltration
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, risk-based recommendations
  • Ability to think like an adversary — creative, persistent, and able to holistically assess risk in complex environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience conducting offensive security in fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated environments
  • Background in vulnerability research, exploit development, or CVE discovery
  • Experience collaborating with threat intelligence, detection engineering, or incident response teams (purple team operations)
  • Familiarity with big data and log analysis tools (Splunk, Databricks, PySpark, osquery, etc.) for threat hunting or investigative support
  • Proficiency with AI/LLM-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience applying them to offensive security workflows
  • Interest or experience in agentic automation — using LLMs or autonomous agents to augment reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, or exploitation workflows
  • Experience testing AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications for security weaknesses (prompt injection, training data extraction, model manipulation, etc.)
  • Contributions to open-source security tools, published research, blog posts, or conference presentations
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, OSED, CRTO, CPTS, PNPT, GXPN, or cloud security certifications

Location

This role is remote within the United States. While you are welcome to visit Stripe offices for team meetings, on-sites, and events, our expectation is that you would regularly work from home. The team primarily coordinates across Eastern and Pacific time zones, with regular collaboration with stakeholders in Europe and Asia.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $170,400 – $255,700. This range may span multiple career levels and will be refined during the interview process based on experience, qualifications, and location.

Additional benefits include:

  • Equity participation in Stripe's growth
  • 401(k) plan with matching contributions from day one
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Wellness stipends
  • Annual budget for training, certifications, and conference attendance

jobs.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

THE OPPORTUNITY

Identity Fusion (IDF) partners with some of the world’s largest enterprises, yet size never defines our approach, every client receives the white-glove treatment of a Fortune 50 powerhouse. As a fast-growing organization with boundless opportunity, Identity Fusion is seeking an experienced Account Executive to personally originate, develop, and close enterprise opportunities across North America. This high-impact, individual contributor role demands ownership of pipeline generation, executive engagement, strategic pursuits, and revenue attainment, all while carrying a sales quota and driving growth in a dynamic, high-energy environment.

This is not a traditional sales position. The successful candidate will be expected to remain actively engaged in the market, develop opportunities through personal relationships and disciplined outbound activity, and lead complex sales pursuits from initial qualification through contract execution.

Identity Fusion is entering an important period of growth as enterprise demand for identity security, Identity and Access Management, managed services, and modern cybersecurity solutions continues to expand. This role offers the opportunity to be at the center of that growth by opening doors, building trusted executive relationships, and converting market opportunity into measurable revenue.

The Account Executive will sell Identity Fusion’s consulting services, managed services, and strategic software partnerships. The individual will also develop productive relationships with technology vendors, channel partners, advisory firms, and other organizations capable of generating immediate and meaningful sales opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a proven enterprise sales professional who understands that major opportunities are rarely won from behind a desk. They are developed through credibility, persistence, executive access, industry knowledge, and the ability to connect a customer’s business problem to a practical solution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Sales and Revenue Generation

  • Personally originate, qualify, develop, and close enterprise sales opportunities across North America.
  • Carry and consistently achieve or exceed an individual sales quota tied to bookings, revenue, and pipeline objectives.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline through personal networking, targeted outbound activity, referrals, industry relationships, executive introductions, conferences, and partner-generated opportunities.
  • Lead strategic pursuits from initial discovery and qualification through solution development, proposal, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Maintain direct ownership of the company’s largest and most strategic opportunities until additional sales resources are hired and appropriately transitioned.
  • Sell Identity Fusion’s full portfolio of consulting services, implementation services, advisory services, managed services, and software partner solutions.
  • Develop account strategies that address customer business objectives, security priorities, regulatory pressures, operational risks, and identity modernization requirements.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, forecasting, and customer activity information within the company’s CRM platform.

Executive and Customer Relationships

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, Chief Risk Officers, IAM leaders, cybersecurity executives, procurement leaders, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Serve as a credible business advisor who can translate identity and cybersecurity challenges into business, operational, financial, and risk-management outcomes.
  • Engage executive sponsors throughout the sales process and maintain strong relationships after contract execution.
  • Expand existing customer relationships by identifying additional consulting, implementation, managed service, and software opportunities.
  • Work closely with delivery and customer leadership to ensure account growth is built upon customer value, successful outcomes, and long-term trust.
  • Represent Identity Fusion at customer meetings, executive briefings, industry conferences, partner events, and other strategic market activities.

Strategic Pursuits and Solution Development

  • Lead complex enterprise pursuits involving multiple stakeholders, technical requirements, procurement processes, partner relationships, and extended sales cycles.
  • Coordinate with solution architects, delivery leaders, vendor partners, and executive management to develop compelling and achievable customer solutions.
  • Support the development of proposals, statements of work, pricing strategies, executive presentations, and contract negotiations.
  • Understand customer buying processes, funding cycles, decision criteria, competitive alternatives, and organizational priorities.
  • Maintain momentum throughout lengthy sales cycles and establish clear next steps, decision points, and mutual action plans.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive information, and customer feedback to the CRO and executive leadership team.

Channel and Partner Development

  • Develop relationships with technology vendors, advisory firms, integrators, resellers, cloud providers, and strategic alliance partners that can produce immediate sales opportunities.
  • Create joint account plans and coordinated pursuit strategies with selected partners.
  • Identify opportunities where Identity Fusion can support vendor implementation, modernization, migration, advisory, or managed service requirements.
  • Develop referral relationships with organizations and individuals that have access to enterprise IAM and cybersecurity decision-makers.
  • Ensure partner relationships are measured by qualified opportunities and revenue contribution rather than activity alone.

Market Presence and Business Development

  • Establish a visible and credible presence within the identity security, IAM, cybersecurity, and digital transformation markets.
  • Participate in industry conferences, customer events, executive forums, webinars, and networking activities.
  • Use professional relationships, market knowledge, and thought leadership to initiate conversations with prospective customers.
  • Travel as necessary for customer meetings, conferences, partner sessions, and strategic pursuits.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to support targeted campaigns, executive outreach, events, content, and account-based marketing initiatives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Five or more years of successful enterprise sales experience within cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, technology consulting, managed services, or related markets.
  • A demonstrated record of personally originating and closing complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience carrying and achieving a significant individual sales quota.
  • Established relationships with enterprise CIOs, CISOs, IAM executives, cybersecurity leaders, technology vendors, and industry partners.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise sales cycles, consultative selling, value-based selling, and solution-oriented sales methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through direct networking, outbound activity, referrals, partners, and executive relationships.
  • Experience selling professional services, consulting services, implementation services, managed services, or enterprise software solutions.
  • Ability to lead opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, lengthy decision cycles, formal procurement processes, and complex contractual requirements.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-development skills.
  • Experience developing proposals, pricing strategies, account plans, pursuit strategies, and revenue forecasts.
  • Ability to operate independently, maintain disciplined sales activity, and remain accountable for measurable revenue results.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for customer meetings, conferences, partner events, and strategic pursuits.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience selling Identity and Access Management, identity governance, customer identity, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, identity orchestration, or identity security solutions.
  • Experience selling a combination of consulting services, managed services, and software partner solutions.
  • Existing relationships within enterprise IAM, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare, insurance, government, critical infrastructure, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience working with software vendors, cloud providers, systems integrators, MSSPs, VARs, and strategic alliance partners.
  • Experience supporting vendor-led implementation opportunities and jointly pursuing enterprise accounts.
  • Familiarity with identity modernization, Zero Trust, cloud security, regulatory compliance, cyber-risk reduction, and enterprise transformation programs.
  • Prior experience working directly with a CRO, CEO, or senior executive leadership team in a growth-oriented organization.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The Sales Executive will be evaluated primarily on measurable sales performance, including:

  • Individual quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generation
  • New enterprise customers
  • Expansion revenue from existing accounts
  • Strategic opportunities originated and closed
  • Partner-generated opportunities and revenue
  • Forecast accuracy and sales discipline

Success in this role will be defined by revenue produced, relationships established, opportunities advanced, and customers won.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION

The compensation package includes a base salary and an performance-based commission structure aligned with individual sales results. The final compensation package will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, industry relationships, demonstrated sales performance, and overall fit for the role.

Additional incentives may include annual performance bonuses, management-by-objective participation, equity grants, and other company-sponsored reward programs.

BENEFITS - WHY IDENTITY FUSION?

Identity Fusion offers competitive compensation, high earning potential, a flexible remote work environment, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, paid holidays, and flexible paid time off.

The Account Executive will work directly with executive leadership and have a meaningful role in shaping the company’s growth across North America. This is an opportunity for a proven sales professional to take ownership of significant enterprise opportunities, represent a respected identity security organization, and build a substantial book of business in one of cybersecurity’s most important markets.

ABOUT IDENTITY FUSION

Identity Fusion delivers next-level security through industry-leading solutions in areas such as IAM, CIAM, Agentic AI protection, IGA, PAM, SSO, and MFA. We help enterprises secure identities, control access, and eliminate risk, enabling seamless, modern security strategies in an ever-changing digital world.

Join us in building the future of identity security.

Salary: 100,000 + Commission

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - RPG
jobs.excerpt: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.
jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Lead Product Manager on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
  • Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
  • Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
  • Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
  • Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
  • Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
  • Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
  • Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG, with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

Product & RPG expertise

  • Product experience on live F2P mobile games, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
  • Strong fluency in RPG mechanics and meta systems: progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
  • Ideally, you’ve taken a title from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

LiveOps & Execution

  • Deep LiveOps experience, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
  • Strong track record owning features end-to-end: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of what a live team can realistically ship and maintain, balancing ambition with feasibility.

Leadership & Ways of working

  • Strong cross-functional leadership, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
  • A strategist and builder: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
  • Thrives in lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
  • Humility: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: The OrganizationWhat if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose?
jobs.description:
The Organization

What if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose? Wayfinder, a division of Lemnis, was founded at the Stanford d.school to answer this question. Our goal is to double our impact each year for the coming years. Our vision is to become the preeminent future-readiness curriculum company in the world — leading the global movement of purpose, meaning, and belonging-based education worldwide.

Wayfinder joined the Lemnis Collective as a nonprofit division in 2026. As a public charity, Lemnis is dedicated to the concept of the unlimited learner. Their mission is to create more accessible, flexible, learner-centered systems that help young people navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future. Wayfinder and Lemnis share that vision, especially when it comes to supporting learners in underserved communities and the institutions that serve them.

Wayfinder is the third organization to join the Lemnis Collective. The Collective brings mission-aligned organizations (both for-profit assets and nonprofits with earned revenue) under the Lemnis umbrella through mergers and acquisitions. Lemnis provides long-term, mission-driven investment, stability, freedom from the pressure of constant fundraising, and operational and strategic support, so organizations like Wayfinder can stay focused on our mission, impact, growth, and innovation.

What We Value

You’ll be joining a team of incredibly motivated and dedicated staff members committed to living our organization's values. We work collaboratively across teams, and we feel and act like a purpose-driven organization. To the best of our abilities, each person’s role aligns with their own sense of purpose, which feeds into Wayfinder’s larger sense of purpose.

Read this article about our workplace culture in Conscious Company.

We value equal access, inclusive community, and belonging, and these values are represented in our product, our team, and our school partners.

Product: We develop our learning tools using human-centered design principles. We work with grade-level experts to ensure our curriculum is developmentally appropriate and engaging at all levels. Every Wayfinder lesson is supported by relevant research, prototyped in classrooms, and vetted by teachers over rounds of feedback and iteration. We use Universal Design for Learning principles to give every student an equal opportunity to succeed.

Team: Our team is composed of people from all different backgrounds and walks of life. We intentionally recruit, hire, and work with people of all identities + experiences. We focus on belonging: being connected, accepted, and valued by the people around us.

School Partners: We intentionally target a wide array of educational partners, from traditional to non-traditional, that work with a range of students from different socioeconomic groups. We’ve taught our curriculum in high-need schools in the Bronx, independent schools in Silicon Valley, and after-school programs in San Antonio.

The Role

At Wayfinder, we believe every student deserves to develop belonging, purpose, and future-ready skills. Our web platform is where that happens every day for students, educators, and school communities, and we're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape what it becomes next.


You'll own the design of a set of features, from the first conversation with an educator to the final handoff to engineering. That means spending real time with the people who use our product. You'll talk with teachers, school leaders, and Wayfinder staff, watch how they work, and bring what you learn back to the team. Then you'll turn it into experiences that feel simple, thoughtful, and genuinely useful.


This role is for someone who's energized by understanding people's problems, loves collaborating to solve them, and is excited about the ways AI is changing both how we design and what we can build. You'll report to our Principal Product Designer and join a small team where your work has a direct, visible impact.


We strongly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented populations in tech - such as women, People of Color, People with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ people, etc - to apply!


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design of a set of features, from discovery and research through concepting, prototyping, and handoff.

  • Lead research for your features: plan and run interviews, usability studies, and conversations with educators and students, and use product analytics to fill in the picture.

  • Get out and talk to people. Build relationships with current partners, listen closely, and bring their needs, frustrations, and ideas into the design process.

  • Share what you learn clearly and often, through written summaries, presentations, and prototypes that help the team make good decisions.

  • Translate concepts and technical requirements into sketches, user flows, prototypes, and handoff-ready files that balance a great user experience with business goals.

  • Design interfaces that are intuitive and accessible to all learners, aligned with our brand guidelines, design system, and patterns.

  • Design AI-enabled features that make work easier for educators and learning more meaningful for students, and use AI tools to speed up and strengthen your own design process.

  • Work closely with educators, designers, and engineers from discovery to delivery.

  • Turn your designs into build-ready specs and tickets so engineering can move quickly and confidently.

  • Contribute to the maintenance and growth of our component library.



Requirements

Essential experience

  • 5+ years of experience in UI and UX design, with a portfolio of case studies that shows your process as well as your results.

  • A track record of leading design research, such as interviews, usability studies, and engagement with partners or customers, and turning findings into clear design decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills. You're comfortable leading a conversation with a teacher, presenting to stakeholders, and explaining your thinking in writing, sketches, and prototypes.

  • Experience designing accessible products and a working knowledge of accessibility standards (such as WCAG).

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your design workflow, and curiosity about designing AI-enabled experiences.

  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with Adobe tools.

  • Experience collaborating with designers and engineers to create coherent, intuitive user experiences.

  • The ability to own your work independently, manage your own priorities in a fast-moving environment, and welcome feedback as part of doing your best work.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a bias toward action.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.


Preferred experience

  • Experience designing PreK-12 edtech products, especially in Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS), college and career readiness (CCR), or durable skill development.

  • Experience designing AI-enabled features or workflows.

  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-moving environment.

  • An undergraduate degree or equivalent experience in product design, interaction design, human-computer interaction, software engineering, or a related field.

Benefits

    We offer a competitive package that is based on location and experience. We also offer the following benefits:

  • + 403b: We care about your ability to save for your future.

  • + Family Focus: Parental leave and flexibility for families.

  • + Time Off: Unlimited PTO policy to encourage people to get out and see the world.

  • + Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision policies + a monthly wellness stipend.

  • + Goodies: Whatever hardware and software you need to get the job done.

  • + Team Fun: Regularly scheduled events, annual retreat, and celebrations.

  • + Learning: Learning & Development Opportunities to grow your skills and career.

  • + Great team: Working with fun, hard-working, kind people committed to making a difference!

  • + Flexible culture: We are results-focused and entirely remote.

  • + And much more! Lots of other perks make this company an incredible place to work.

Location

Remote work. Wayfinders’ regular operating hours are Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The daily work schedule may vary depending on the crew in which you are working.



Next Steps, If Interested

If you are interested, please fill out the job application here.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

EEO Statement

At Wayfinder, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Wayfinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Pay Transparency

Wayfinder compensation is based on various factors including but not limited to job location, a candidate's education, training, experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value analysis including seniority and merit systems, as well as internal pay alignment. Annual salary is just one component of Wayfinder’s total compensation package. Additionally, Wayfinder provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, a monthly stipend, office buildout stipend, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Compensation ranges may differ based on contract value but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. An applicant's salary history will not be used in determining compensation.

Reasonable Accommodations

Wayfinder is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact HR at .

jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on business leader to operate and scale a B2B SaaS business unit serving the clinical trial space. This role combines full P&L ownership with responsibility for operational excellence, customer delivery, organizational effectiveness, and AI-driven transformation.

The successful candidate is an operator first. They have built and improved systems, streamlined organizations, implemented automation, and driven measurable business outcomes. They are comfortable moving between executive-level decision-making and detailed operational execution.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Finance to improve business performance while building a more scalable, AI-enabled operating model.

What You'll Own

Business Performance

  • Own business unit financial performance, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs, and profitability.
  • Develop and execute operating plans that balance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
  • Refine performance metrics and accountability across functions.

AI & Operational Transformation

  • Lead the adoption of AI and automation across customer-facing and internal workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, reduce organizational complexity, and increase productivity. • Champion an AI-first mindset across teams.
  • Establish measurable targets for productivity gains and operational leverage.

Customer Delivery & Operations

  • Improve delivery quality, utilization, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Build repeatable processes that reduce dependency on individual contributors.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data, process redesign, and technology.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Align Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Operations around common business goals.
  • Translate strategic priorities into operational execution.
  • Remove bottlenecks and improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Lead business reviews and operating cadences.

Team Development

  • Build high-accountability teams focused on outcomes.
  • Coach managers and develop future leaders.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, continuous improvement, and experimentation.

What Success Looks Like

Within 12 months, this leader will have:

  • Increased organizational productivity through AI and automation initiatives.
  • Simplified operating processes and reduced complexity across the business.
  • Improved gross margin and operating efficiency.
  • Increased customer retention and delivery effectiveness.
  • Established a scalable operating model capable of supporting future growth.
  • Built a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

This posting is for an existing, open vacancy. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants during our hiring process; final decisions are reviewed by our hiring team.

— — —

Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un leader d'affaires opérationnel pour gérer et faire croître une unité d'affaires SaaS B2B au service du domaine des essais cliniques. Ce poste combine la pleine responsabilité du compte de résultats (P&L) avec la responsabilité de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la prestation aux clients, de l'efficacité organisationnelle et de la transformation axée sur l'IA.

Le candidat retenu est avant tout un opérateur. Il a conçu et amélioré des systèmes, rationalisé des organisations, mis en œuvre l'automatisation et généré des résultats d'affaires mesurables. Il est à l'aise pour passer de la prise de décision au niveau de la direction à l'exécution opérationnelle détaillée.

Ce leader travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Services professionnels, Réussite client et Finances afin d'améliorer la performance de l'entreprise tout en bâtissant un modèle d'exploitation plus évolutif et activé par l'IA.

Vos responsabilités

Performance de l'entreprise

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la performance financière de l'unité d'affaires, y compris les revenus, la marge brute, les coûts d'exploitation et la rentabilité.
  • Élaborer et exécuter des plans d'exploitation qui équilibrent les résultats pour les clients et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Affiner les indicateurs de performance et la responsabilisation à l'échelle des fonctions.

IA et transformation opérationnelle

  • Diriger l'adoption de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans les flux de travail destinés aux clients et internes.
  • Repérer les occasions d'éliminer les processus manuels, de réduire la complexité organisationnelle et d'accroître la productivité.
  • Promouvoir une approche axée sur l'IA au sein des équipes.
  • Établir des cibles mesurables de gains de productivité et de levier opérationnel.

Prestation aux clients et opérations

  • Améliorer la qualité de la prestation, le taux d'utilisation, l'évolutivité et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
  • Bâtir des processus reproductibles qui réduisent la dépendance envers les contributeurs individuels.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce aux données, à la refonte des processus et à la technologie.

Leadership interfonctionnel

  • Aligner les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Réussite client, Services professionnels et Opérations sur des objectifs d'affaires communs.
  • Traduire les priorités stratégiques en exécution opérationnelle.
  • Éliminer les obstacles et améliorer l'efficacité organisationnelle.
  • Diriger les revues d'affaires et les cadences d'exploitation.

Développement de l'équipe

  • Bâtir des équipes à haut niveau de responsabilisation, axées sur les résultats.
  • Encadrer les gestionnaires et former les futurs leaders.
  • Cultiver une culture d'appropriation, de transparence, d'amélioration continue et d'expérimentation.

À quoi ressemble la réussite

Au cours des 12 premiers mois, ce leader aura :

  • Accru la productivité organisationnelle grâce aux initiatives d'IA et d'automatisation.
  • Simplifié les processus d'exploitation et réduit la complexité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
  • Amélioré la marge brute et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Accru la fidélisation de la clientèle et l'efficacité de la prestation.
  • Établi un modèle d'exploitation évolutif capable de soutenir la croissance future.
  • Bâti une culture de responsabilisation, d'appropriation et d'amélioration continue.

Cette offre concerne un poste vacant actuellement à pourvoir. Nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider au tri, à l'évaluation et/ou à la sélection des candidatures dans le cadre de notre processus d'embauche; les décisions finales sont examinées par notre équipe de recrutement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 8+ years of leadership experience in software or SaaS businesses.
  • Proven experience leading operational functions such as Professional Services, Customer Operations, Customer Success, Operations, Business Operations, IT, Delivery, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ownership of budgets, business performance metrics, or P&L responsibilities.
  • Experience implementing automation, systems improvements, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Track record of driving measurable productivity improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across technical and business teams.

Preferred

  • Experience in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare technology, regulatory software, or adjacent industries.
  • Experience in private-equity-backed software companies.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, and data-driven operating models.

— — —

Exigences

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en leadership dans des entreprises de logiciels ou de SaaS.
  • Expérience confirmée de la direction de fonctions opérationnelles telles que les services professionnels, les opérations clients, les opérations de réussite client, les opérations d'affaires, les TI, la livraison ou des fonctions semblables.
  • Responsabilité démontrée de budgets, d'indicateurs de performance d'affaires ou d'un compte de résultats (P&L).
  • Expérience de la mise en œuvre de l'automatisation, d'améliorations de systèmes ou de flux de travail activés par l'IA.
  • Bilan probant en matière d'amélioration mesurable de la productivité et de l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et financières.
  • Expérience de la direction d'initiatives interfonctionnelles au sein d'équipes techniques et d'affaires.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans les sciences de la vie, la recherche clinique, les technologies de la santé, les logiciels réglementaires ou des secteurs connexes.
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises de logiciels détenues par des sociétés de capital-investissement.
  • Connaissance des outils d'IA modernes, des plateformes d'automatisation des flux de travail et des modèles d'exploitation axés sur les données.

ABOUT THE TEAM / À PROPOS DE L'ÉQUIPE

About Anju Software

Anju Software delivers end-to-end solutions for the life sciences industry, supporting clinical trials, medical affairs, and scientific data management with precision, compliance, and operational rigor. Our products help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently.

Anju is part of Valsoft Corporation, a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. Valsoft invests with a long-term mindset, empowering each company to operate autonomously while benefiting from shared capital and operational expertise.

We are entering a new phase of growth, focused on embedding AI deeply into our systems and workflows. We are excited to add talent who will help lead our transformation into a truly agentic, automation-driven organization that redefines how work gets done in life sciences.

Anju Software, part of Valsoft Corporation, is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

À propos d'Anju Software

Anju Software offre des solutions de bout en bout pour l'industrie des sciences de la vie, soutenant les essais cliniques, les affaires médicales et la gestion des données scientifiques avec précision, conformité et rigueur opérationnelle. Nos produits aident les entreprises pharmaceutiques, de biotechnologie et de dispositifs médicaux à mettre leurs thérapies sur le marché plus rapidement et plus efficacement.

Anju fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un acquéreur et exploitant mondial d'entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux. Valsoft investit dans une perspective à long terme, permettant à chaque entreprise de fonctionner de façon autonome tout en bénéficiant de capitaux et d'une expertise opérationnelle partagés.

Nous entamons une nouvelle phase de croissance, axée sur l'intégration profonde de l'IA dans nos systèmes et nos flux de travail. Nous sommes ravis d'accueillir des talents qui contribueront à mener notre transformation vers une organisation véritablement agentique et axée sur l'automatisation, qui redéfinit la façon dont le travail s'accomplit dans les sciences de la vie.

Anju Software, une société du groupe Valsoft Corporation, souscrit au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi et s'engage à maintenir un effectif diversifié et inclusif. Des mesures d'adaptation sont offertes sur demande aux candidats participant à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection. jobs.description:
Symplicity & Orbis Communications creates innovative technology solutions for post-secondary institutions. Our technology helps universities and higher education institutions improve the student experience and strengthen connections between students, employers, community members, and educational institutions.

We are committed to creating a collaborative and supportive workplace culture that balances a challenging and rewarding work environment with employee wellbeing, professional development, community involvement, and team engagement.

About the Role

The Client Success Manager will partner with clients throughout the customer lifecycle, helping them maximize the value of their Symplicity and Orbis solutions, achieve their business goals, and continuously improve the way they use our technology.

You will act as a trusted advisor, product expert, and strategic partner to our clients. This includes understanding their business needs, facilitating discovery sessions, supporting implementations and onboarding, identifying opportunities for product adoption and expansion, and helping clients resolve challenges.

The role requires someone who can confidently work across different teams, communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and translate customer feedback and business requirements into actionable solutions for our Product, Development, Support, and Account Management teams.

Success in this role means our clients are engaged, confident, and using our solutions effectively and innovatively.

Location: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada
Work Model: Remote or Hybrid – employees may choose to work remotely or from our Hamilton office
Travel: Occasional travel within Canada and the US for client meetings, training, conferences, and other business needs

Key Responsibilities

    • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients throughout the customer lifecycle.
    • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients define goals, establish key performance indicators, and achieve measurable outcomes using Symplicity and Orbis solutions.
    • Support clients with onboarding, implementation, adoption, and optimization of new and existing products and services.
    • Facilitate discovery workshops and client meetings to understand business challenges, workflows, goals, and project requirements.
    • Translate client business requirements into clear and actionable recommendations, mapping solution capabilities to client needs.
    • Provide guidance and frontline support to help clients resolve product questions, challenges, and workflow issues.
    • Help clients understand and adopt new product features, functionality, and best practices.
    • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and help clients understand how technology and data can improve their workflows.
    • Work closely with Product, Development, Support, Implementation, and other internal teams to communicate customer feedback, ideas, questions, and requirements.
    • Identify opportunities to improve product usability, functionality, adoption, and overall customer experience.
    • Proactively identify at-risk clients and develop strategies to improve engagement, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
    • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing client base and collaborate with Account Executives to support these opportunities.
    • Develop and maintain client success stories, case studies, references, and other customer advocacy initiatives.
    • Encourage customer engagement and feedback through webinars, roadshows, training sessions, community initiatives, and feedback sessions.
    • Contribute to the creation and ongoing improvement of knowledge bases, customer resources, training materials, and support documentation.
    • Participate in building a customer community where clients can share knowledge, best practices, ideas, and experiences.
    • Work with the Billing team to help resolve billing, invoice, and sales quote-related issues when required.
    • Maintain clear and proactive communication with clients and internal stakeholders.
    • Manage priorities effectively, work independently, and continuously look for ways to improve processes and customer outcomes.
    • Travel periodically for client meetings, onsite training, conferences, and other business activities.
    • Perform other duties as assigned based on business and client needs.

What We're Looking For

    • Bachelor's degree, college diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
    • Experience working in Customer Success, Client Management, Account Management, Product Support, Implementation, Onboarding, or a similar customer-facing role.
    • Experience working in a software or SaaS environment is highly desirable.
    • Experience working with post-secondary institutions, universities, colleges, or the higher education sector is considered a strong asset.
    • Strong digital literacy and willingness to learn new technologies and software platforms.
    • Ability to understand data, workflows, and technology and how they impact business and customer processes.
    • Ability to understand and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical and creative approach to solving customer challenges.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.
    • Customer-focused mindset with a genuine interest in helping clients achieve their goals.
    • Highly organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities.
    • Flexible and collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams.
    • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and meeting deadlines.
    • Willingness to travel periodically for client meetings, training, and conferences.
    • Experience with databases, data analysis, SaaS platforms, or other technology solutions is an advantage.

Language Requirements

    • English
    • French

      • The successful candidate will support our French-first customers and must be comfortable communicating professionally in both English and French.

Why Join Us?

    At Symplicity & Orbis Communications, you will join a team that is passionate about improving technology and services within higher education.
    We encourage our employees to continuously develop their skills, contribute to their communities, and prioritize their wellbeing. Our culture combines a collaborative and supportive environment with opportunities to work on meaningful technology solutions used by post-secondary institutions.
    Employees have the flexibility to work remotely or from our Hamilton, Ontario office, depending on their location and preferences, while maintaining opportunities for in-person collaboration and team engagement.

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

Supply Chain Intelligence – Full Stack Engineer

Position Overview

This individual combines deep frontend expertise with strategic product ownership to design, build, and deploy the user facing “apparatus” that surfaces AI‑generated insights to supply chain users. In addition to hands‑on development, you will make key architectural decisions, mentor junior developers, and partner with AI and AIOps engineers to deliver end‑to‑end, production‑grade solutions that meet Lockheed Martin’s performance, security, and usability standards.

Key Responsibilities

You will lead the end to end UI/UX delivery for supply chain intelligence portals, dashboards, chat assistant widgets, and workflow tools that consume generative AI outputs. You will define and enforce frontend standards for framework selection, component libraries, accessibility, and responsive design that become the team’s reference architecture. You will collaborate on API contracts with AI Engineers, translating model endpoints into clean versioned REST or GraphQL services and ensuring consistent error handling and latency targets. You will package and ship complete solutions by creating Docker OCI images, Helm charts, or serverless bundles that the AIOps Engineer can deploy to production environments. You will own quality gates including unit and integration test coverage, CI pipelines, static analysis tooling, and automated UI testing. You will mentor and coach junior developers through code reviews, pair programming sessions, and regular knowledge sharing workshops on modern web technologies and best practices. You will drive performance optimization and monitor frontend health such as error rates and user experience metrics in collaboration with the AIOps Engineer. You will maintain documentation of UI component libraries, design system guidelines, deployment recipes, and troubleshooting playbooks in the team knowledge base. You will partner with stakeholders including category managers, sourcing analysts, and buyers to gather UI/UX requirements, validate prototypes, and iterate quickly based on feedback. You will stay current on supply chain domain trends to embed relevant visualizations and interaction patterns.

Why Join Us?

Direct impact: Your interfaces will enable AI insights to be acted on across the global supply chain, improving decision speed and accuracy.

Leadership influence: Shape frontend standards and mentor the next generation of developers while collaborating with senior AI and AIOps engineers.

Career growth: Continuous exposure to emerging research, mentorship from senior technical leaders, and opportunities to influence enterprise AI strategy.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human Computer Interaction, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of professional experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) and server side Node.js Express development.
  • Proven ability to design data rich, accessible interfaces; experience with CSS in JS, design systems, and visualization libraries such as D3.js, Plotly, or Chart.js.
  • Hands on experience containerizing web applications with Docker and authoring Helm charts or serverless deployment bundles for enterprise environments.
  • Strong background building automated test suites (Jest, Cypress, Playwright) and integrating them into CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
  • Demonstrated experience leading frontend development efforts, making architectural decisions, and communicating technical concepts to non technical stakeholders.
  • Proven experience leading wire‑framing sessions with business stakeholders, translating their needs into low‑fidelity designs that guide UI development and set clear acceptance criteria.
  • Strategic thinking combined with a hands on delivery mindset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication for stakeholder engagement.

Desired Skills

  • Experience building UI layers for AI‑driven products such as chat assistants or agentic systems (e.g., autonomous‑agent interfaces).
  • Knowledge of procurement domain concepts such as spend analytics, supplier risk scoring, and contract lifecycle management.
  • History of coaching junior engineers, conducting thorough code reviews, and fostering a collaborative development culture.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $150800.00 - $280000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $135700.00 - $251900.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $120600.00 - $224000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $108600.00 - $201600.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.
