jobs.excerpt: As an integral member of the Enterprise Quality Assurance management team the Lead Quality Systems Administrator oversees the development, implementation and maintenance of the Enterprise quality system at the assigned divisions, with the guidance and support from the Quality Assurance Directors and VPs.
jobs.description:
As an integral member of the Enterprise Quality Assurance management team the Lead Quality Systems Administrator oversees the development, implementation and maintenance of the Enterprise quality system at the assigned divisions, with the guidance and support from the Quality Assurance Directors and VPs. The QA Manager provides day-to-day direction, support and leadership to the QA associates and ensures that the team has adequate resources to meet its responsibilities. Additionally, this role provides QA input and advice to the management teams of the assigned business units (i.e., programs and/or departments) and assures the business units remain compliant with established procedures, client contractual agreements, EQA policies and procedures, and applicable regulations and guidelines by scheduling routine program/department audits and process/system audits to ensure client contractual agreements and EQA standards are met. This position is expected to interact directly with clients/sponsors, vendors and regulatory inspectors. The Lead Quality Systems Administrator should be highly proficient in eQMS technical configuration, understanding development processes, and maintaining infrastructure hygiene (i.e. ensuring eQMS subscription has adequate storage space and projecting future needs). The Lead Admin will also be responsible for managing up to 3 additional administrators with varying levels of experience, monitoring their performance, and ensuring completion of assigned administration duties. Where junior resources are added to the team, the Lead Admin is expected to provide education, training, and guidance in developing their skillset. Will act as the final level of escalation for complex technical issues impacting service availability. Work with project managers to coordinate and plan project tasks and resources. Lead Administrator, QMS should be highly proficient in eQMS technical configuration, understanding development processes, and maintaining infrastructure hygiene.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee Quality Systems administration team, ensuring timely completion of assigned duties
  • Manage queue of requests from eQMS userbase through ServiceNow ticketing, tracking metrics, and reporting on overall current state of eQMS development
  • Creation of presentation materials, demonstrating timelines for assigned projects, milestones, and delivery of value
  • Host and coordinate external audits by sponsors/clients and/or regulatory agencies.
  • Coordinate collation of responses and corrective actions from external audits with relevant program and/or departments to ensure timely resolution of observations and issuance of responses.
  • Leverage QMS Engineering experience to drive development around best practices and optimal system performance.
  • Works closely with IT / QA to manage risk, verification, quality, and validation plans.
  • Maintain accurate records of internal and external audit files, including schedules, audit plans, audit evidence and audit reports. Assist in the archiving of QA documents.
  • Implement Quality Assurance procedures as per internal requirements and/or client contractual requirements;
  • Organize, schedule and conduct internal audits for the various programs and/or departments (as assigned by the Director, QA) to ensure client requirements (e.g., procedural steps, operational reports and AE reporting, etc.) are met and company policies and procedures are complied with;
  • Ensure program/department audits and internal process/system audits are scheduled in advance and reflected in the QA audit calendar;
  • Analyze and evaluate available data and prepare or review written reports of audit findings and observations;
  • Keep QA management up to date on findings and status of corrective/preventive actions;
  • Manage the CAPA process for the assigned programs/departments by ensuring that non-conformance and other reportable events as well as CAPA reports are recorded, followed-up, tracked and trended;
  • Conducts periodic Quality Management Review (QMR) meetings with Patient Support Program Management Teams and related functional areas to review key quality metrics, discuss trends/issues and coordinate quality improvement initiatives.
  • Implement continual process improvements related to assigned program/departmental processes and/or internal processes as required;
  • Manage the controlled documents (Policies, SOPs, WIs and Forms) request, review and issuance work flow by actively liaising with each program/department management as assigned, and coordinating with the respective programs/department managers or designates to ensure the controlled documents are generated and finalized in a timely manner;
  • Understand program/project roadmap and key milestones regarding criticality, downstream impact if dates are missed and determine alternative/mitigating actions.
  • Provide timely, concise communications to functional and executive leadership regarding project status and pending issues.
  • Build consensus among multiple functional and technical leads relative to project audit scope, task execution, staffing and issue resolution.
  • Recommend corrective actions to program/department leadership when project deliverables deviate from the work plan with the assistance of team members.
  • Interact with project sponsors, stakeholders, vendors and various project members to ensure that specified business needs are met; assists in the post-implementation analysis to ensure that requirements are fulfilled.
  • Serve as a resource to internal stakeholders for the interpretation and application of regulations and applicable guidelines;
  • In coordination with the Director, Quality Assurance, prepare QA budget and manage departmental expenses;
  • Work with the rest of the QA management team in the development/revision and implementation of QA policies and procedures as required;
  • Understand and apply company Confidentiality and Privacy Agreements
  • The Quality Assurance Manager may also be assigned other duties and tasks as required from time to time by the Director, Quality Assurance.
  • Travels up to 20% of the time.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in a scientific, healthcare or pharmaceutical field, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 7 years experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (or similar), preferably in a quality assurance or quality control function.
  • Minimum of 5 years experience in hosting external audits and management of multiple projects (planning, implementation, management and monitoring) including budget, resource planning, Key Performance Indicators, etc.;
  • Industry certification in Quality or Clinical Research (e.g., CQA, RQAP-GxP, CCRC, CCRA, CCRP, etc.) is an asset.
  • Responsible and accountable for success/delivery of quality needs for QMS system
  • Responsible for managing 1-3 QMS engineer resources in delivery of high-quality business/customer service and consultancy to QA departments
  • Experience coaching junior/entry-level resources, ability to create development plans, and foster growth and QA knowledge in reports
  • Experience in executive reporting and developing product roadmaps to communicate QMS growth strategy
  • Quality or quality parallel professionals with 5-7 years experience, with extensive experience in a QMS System (i.e. MasterControl, TrackWise, Veeva)
  • Extensive knowledge of GxP, GDP, GMP, ISO 9001 and related Quality Standards

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Strong knowledge in quality assurance principles and quality management, including design and operation of effective quality and regulatory compliance programs;
  • Advanced knowledge of root cause analysis and CAPA investigations;
  • Ability to develop and implement customized Quality Assurance procedures specified by internal/external industry specification;
  • Advanced analytical, conceptual and problem solving skills to evaluate business; problems and apply knowledge to identify appropriate solutions;
  • Well-developed leadership, analytical, and decision making skills, with an aptitude to appropriately apply scientific, regulatory and administrative knowledge to accomplish department and company goals.
  • Superior skills in planning, organization and managing multiple priorities yet being flexible, adaptable and able to respond to changing needs.
  • Proven conflict management skills with the ability to provide leadership to others in response to situations and to escalate more critical decisions when relevant.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, work well in an interdependent team environment, and promote positive, respectful professional relationships. Proficient in writing reports containing technical information;
  • Effective presentation skills and experienced in the development of training courses and materials.
  • Proven ability to organize time, set priorities and multi-task in order to meet various competing work deadlines;
  • Strong attention to details and data analysis skills;
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment;

About SwiftComply

SwiftComply is an award-winning early-stage technology company with a mission to protect human health and the environment with an all-in-one cloud-based software that empowers local governments to easily manage their water, wastewater, and stormwater compliance programs.

We were founded in 2016 by our founder and CEO, Mick O’Dwyer. As a water & wastewater engineer at Dublin City Council (Ireland), Mick saw first hand how manual, paper-based and inefficient compliance programs can be. He created SwiftComply to fix this problem with modern, collaborative technology.

Today, SwiftComply supports over 400+ utilities that deliver water service to 50+ million citizens - and we’re expanding the team to make an even bigger impact!

About the role

SwiftComply is looking for a motivated and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to lead and manage relationships with a select portfolio of our customers. This role requires a proactive and relationship-driven individual who can balance strategic planning with hands-on account management. The CSM is responsible for driving retention and revenue growth, through cross-selling additional programs, while building relationships at every level of our customers' organizations and collaborating with internal teams to deliver exceptional results.

What you'll do
Strategic Account Leadership and Revenue Growth
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio of accounts, fostering strong, long-term relationships.
  • Develop account plans that map each customer's regulatory programs and departments, pinpointing where SwiftComply can deliver additional value.
  • Cross-sell: Proactively uncover opportunities to expand customers into additional SwiftComply programs and introduce them to the Sales team for closure.
  • Upsell: Grow existing accounts through higher-tier packages, conversions from SaaS to Usage or added functionality and services within the programs customers already use.
  • Own the renewal process for your portfolio, securing on-time renewals and minimizing churn.
  • Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline in HubSpot, accurately forecasting renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Executive engagement: Build relationships beyond day-to-day users with senior stakeholders, such as utility directors, public works leadership, and city or county executives, to secure executive sponsorship and influence strategic and budget decisions.
  • Conduct regular account reviews with both operational and senior stakeholders to assess performance, align on goals, and uncover growth opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.

Services Sales and Project Handoffs

  • Identify opportunities to offer professional services, such as tailored training, managed services, or program optimizations, based on customer needs.
  • Collaborate with the Services Team to scope, price, and present service offerings to customers.
  • Facilitate the sales process for service projects and ensure a smooth handoff to the Services Team for execution.
  • Maintain oversight of active projects to ensure alignment with customer expectations and successful delivery.

Customer Success and Advocacy

  • Advocate for customer needs by gathering and sharing insights with internal teams, including product and support.
  • Identify opportunities for case studies and customer success stories to highlight the impact of SwiftComply solutions.
  • Ensure timely resolution of escalated issues, working closely with support and product teams.

Data-Driven Insights and Reporting

  • Analyze account performance and identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, renewal schedules, and account plans using tools like HubSpot and .
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline in HubSpot, accurately forecasting renewal and upsell revenue and tracking cross-sell opportunities sourced for Sales.
  • Contribute to internal discussions and workshops to refine customer success strategies.

Collaboration and Cross-Functional Support

  • Work closely with product, support, services, and marketing teams to align on customer objectives and ensure smooth implementation of initiatives.
  • Provide structured feedback to internal teams to inform product development and process improvements.
  • Participate in workshops to develop and refine account strategies, including health scores and account plans.

Process Optimization and Improvement

  • Document best practices, workflows, and customer insights to support team growth and knowledge sharing.
  • Leverage CRM and other tools to optimize account management activities.
Who you are

Essential:

  • Proven experience in account management, customer success, or a related role (3+ years), preferably in SaaS or compliance industries.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with customers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve revenue and retention targets through strategic account management.
  • Experience identifying and selling professional services and managing handoffs to delivery teams.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in using CRM tools like HubSpot for tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in GovTech or SaaS serving public-sector customers, such as municipalities, utilities, or government agencies.
  • Familiarity with water or wastewater compliance programs or similar regulatory industries.
  • Experience in developing and executing account strategies, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Knowledge of customer health metrics and customer lifecycle management.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Strong commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving value.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to align customer needs with business goals and develop long-term strategies.
  • Collaboration: Skilled at working across teams to drive outcomes and improve processes.
  • Problem-Solving: Analytical and resourceful in addressing challenges and identifying opportunities.
  • Adaptability: Flexible and proactive in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

Compensation

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

Bring your full self to work.

SwiftComply strives to create an environment for all to participate, be authentic, and feel valued.

  • DevOps & Best Practices: Champion CI/CD for data (DataOps) using Azure DevOps/GitHub, ensuring code modularity, version control, and comprehensive documentation.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Data Warehousing, BI, and Cloud Data Engineering.
  • Proven track record of designing end-to-end data solutions on Microsoft Azure.

The Azure Stack - Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure SQL DB, and Synapse Analytics, ADF, Fabric ecosystem

Data Modeling & Visualization

Programming & Infrastructure

jobs.description:
Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on Blueland.com and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.
In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”
Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the New York Times, Fast Company, TechCrunch, VOGUE, Wall Street Journal, Inc., and more.

About the Role

    We are seeking an analytical, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Supply Chain Manager to play a key role in supporting Blueland’s growing Marketplace business, with a significant focus on Amazon. This role will be responsible for ensuring we have the right inventory, in the right place, at the right time to support Marketplace demand while balancing service levels, inventory health, and working capital.

    The Supply Chain Manager will own supply and inventory planning for the Marketplace channel, translating demand forecasts into actionable production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans. This person will report to the Director of Supply Chain and work closely with our Marketplace team, contract manufacturers, packaging suppliers, and broader Operations team to proactively identify supply risks and ensure inventory is available to support both base business and key promotional events.

    A critical component of this role will be leveraging deep Amazon experience to manage the unique planning requirements of the channel, including inventory positioning, replenishment, promotional planning, and maintaining healthy inventory levels across Amazon’s network.

Responsibilities

  • Own supply and inventory planning for Blueland’s Marketplace channel, primarily Amazon, ensuring inventory is positioned appropriately to support sales, promotions, and growth.
  • Translate demand forecasts into monthly and weekly production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans.
  • Develop manufacturing plans with contract manufacturers, taking into consideration demand requirements, production capacity, lead times, MOQs, material and availability.
  • Partner closely with the Marketplace team to incorporate Amazon-specific requirements, promotional events, Prime Day, seasonal peaks, launches, and other demand drivers into supply plans.
  • Monitor Amazon inventory levels, weeks of supply, inbound inventory, sell-through, and replenishment needs to proactively identify potential out-of-stocks or excess inventory.
  • Develop inventory allocation and replenishment strategies across Amazon and Blueland’s warehouse network to maintain appropriate service levels while balancing working capital objectives.
  • Manage production priorities and communicate forecasts, purchase requirements, and changing business needs to contract manufacturing partners.
  • Partner with packaging suppliers to forecast material requirements, place or coordinate purchase orders, and ensure packaging availability supports manufacturing plans.
  • Monitor raw material, packaging, work-in-process, and finished goods availability to identify potential constraints before they impact production or customer availability.
  • Manage PO issuance and track inbound materials and finished goods, proactively escalating and mitigating delays.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Marketplace, Finance, Logistics, and Operations teams as part of the Sales & Operations Planning process.
  • Support new product launches, transitions, promotions, and discontinuations by developing supply plans and identifying inventory risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Analyze forecast changes, inventory trends, production performance, and supplier constraints to recommend adjustments to the supply plan.
  • Maintain accurate planning parameters, item data, lead times, MOQs, and other supply planning inputs within Blueland’s systems.
  • Drive continuous improvement across supply planning processes, tools, reporting, and supplier collaboration.
  • Coordinate with co-packing vendors on build needs for pre-kitted marketplace inventory, sharing monthly priorities and forecasts while monitoring component inventory levels.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct Amazon supply chain, inventory planning, or replenishment experience, with a strong understanding of the operational requirements of the Amazon channel.
  • 5+ years of Supply Chain, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, or related experience, ideally within CPG or a fast-growing omnichannel consumer brand.
  • Experience translating demand forecasts into production and inventory plans.
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and/or external manufacturing partners to manage production schedules, capacity, and inventory requirements.
  • Experience planning packaging or raw material requirements and working with external suppliers.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management concepts, including safety stock, lead times, service levels, inventory turns, and weeks/days of supply.
  • Proven ability to identify supply and inventory risks and develop mitigation plans.
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized with the ability to manage large amounts of data while maintaining accuracy.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and adjusting plans as demand, production capacity, and business priorities change.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex planning information into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets and Excel required.
  • Experience with NetSuite and supply/demand planning systems preferred.

Salary

    The salary range for this position is $110,000-115,000 per year.
We prioritize our planet and our people. In addition to salary compensation, we offer various other benefits to ensure our team members can be their best self, both in and outside of work. Benefits for full time roles include: health benefits, stock options, generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid civic engagement days, paid parental leave, 401k (employee contribution), professional development stipends, remote work reimbursements, various discounts to like-minded companies and more.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

What You'll Do
As Senior Financial Analyst with Imagine Pediatrics, you will sit at the intersection of core FP&A and strategic finance. This role is hands-on and highly visible, with broad exposure across clinical operations, strategy, actuarial, data, BD/growth, and senior leadership. You will own the analytical engine that keeps our financial planning accurate and timely, while also rolling up your sleeves on the harder strategic questions: capital allocation, value-based contract economics, ROI analyses, and the financial architecture of a growing risk-bearing entity. Primary functions for this role will include:

  • Supporting core financial planning processes, including annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and department-level planning, partnering directly with business owners to pressure-test assumptions, align on targets, and manage ongoing performance against plan
  • Owning the bottoms-up operational and financial forecast model, maintaining it as a living tool that reflects current business realities
  • Preparing and presenting monthly financial performance packages for executive leadership, including variance analysis, trend commentary, and forward-looking implications
  • Partnering closely with accounting during month-end close to ensure accuracy and transparency in financial reporting
  • Delivering clear, accurate, and timely responses to ad-hoc financial questions, tailoring insights for the audience
  • Building scalable finance infrastructure, including repeatable reporting processes, clean model architecture, and documented assumptions
  • Building financial models to evaluate new market entry, partnership structures, contract economics, and capital deployment decisions
  • Developing and maintaining analytical frameworks to analyze unit economics and performance across markets and patient segments, surfacing insights on risk, performance, and investment priorities
  • Contributing to board, investor, and senior leadership materials by developing supporting analysis and helping shape a clear financial narrative
  • Developing scenario analyses and sensitivity models that help leadership evaluate tradeoffs, anticipate risks, and make decisions under uncertainty
  • Monitoring financial and operational performance against expectations, identifying emerging risks and opportunities and translating insights into clear recommendations

What You Bring & How You Qualify
First and foremost, you're passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with special health care needs gets the care and support they deserve. Things change quickly in a start-up environment; you accept that and update and pressure-test your assumptions rather than defending old ones. In this role, you will need:

  • 3–6+ years of experience in corporate FP&A, financial consulting, investment banking, private equity, or a high-growth operator finance role (healthcare experience is a meaningful plus, particularly in value-based care, managed care, or risk-bearing entities)
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • Strong Excel modeling and PowerPoint skills
  • Ability to mentor analyst colleagues
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity — not every question has a clean answer; you can make reasonable assumptions, document them transparently, and move forward
  • Strong problem solver who can translate analytical output into plain-language conclusions for a non-finance audience
  • Strong attention to detail — you take pride in work that is accurate and well-supported and understand that credibility in finance is built on getting the numbers right
  • Intellectually curious — you don't just answer the question asked but want to understand the "why" behind the numbers and connect financial insights to what's happening in the business

What We Offer (Benefits + Perks)

The role offers a base salary range of $90,000 - $120,000 in addition to annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

We provide these additional benefits and perks:

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company-funded HSA
  • 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one
  • Employer-paid short and long-term disability
  • Life insurance at 1x annual salary
  • 20 days PTO + 10 Company Holidays & 2 Floating Holidays
  • Paid new parent leave
  • Additional benefits to be detailed in offer

What We Live By

We’re guided by our five core values:

Our Values:

  • Children First. We put the best interests of children above all. We know that the right decision is always the one that creates more safe days at home for the children we serve today and in the future.
  • Earn Trust. We listen first, speak second. We build lasting relationships by creating shared understanding and consistently following through on our commitments.
  • Innovate Today. We believe that small improvements lead to big impact. We stay curious by asking questions and leveraging new ideas to learn and scale.
  • Embrace Humanity. We lead with empathy and authenticity, presuming competence and good intentions. When we stumble, we use the opportunity to grow and understand how we can improve.
  • One Team, Diverse Perspectives. We actively seek a range of viewpoints to achieve better outcomes. Even when we see things differently, we stay aligned on our shared mission and support one another to move forward — together.

We Value Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

We believe that creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support, they deserve requires a diverse team with diverse perspectives. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

Position Summary:

This role exists to build Empower’s AI-powered creative production engine at scale, from scratch, end to end. The AI Creative Production Manager owns the full creative pipeline: from initial concept and storyboard through AI-assisted production and final delivery across paid, organic, and educational channels. This is a hands-on production role. You will use the most current generative AI tools to produce static ads, dynamic creatives, short-form and long-form video, and educational content that drives patient and provider acquisition. You will serve as the production backbone for the Campaign team, Performance Marketing team, and Marketing Innovation team compressing time-to-launch, scaling creative output, and ensuring every asset is built to perform.

Responsibilities:

Creative Ideation and Production at Scale

  • Asset Development: Own the full creative production pipeline from concept to completion. Translate campaign briefs into structured creative concepts and visual storyboards before a single tool is opened. Then execute at scale: use generative AI to produce static images, motion graphics, dynamic ad variants, short-form video (15–60s), long-form video (2–5 min), and educational content. Primary tools include ChatGPT, Claude, GPT-4o, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Ideogram, Leonardo.ai, Canva AI, Runway Gen-3, Sora, Kling, Pika, HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, Descript, CapCut AI, and Opus Clip. Build and maintain a structured asset library with versioning, format variants, and variation testing built in.
  • Compliance Execution: Apply FDA, FTC, and HIPAA advertising guidelines to every creative asset. Work within pre-cleared templates to keep content compliant without slowing production velocity.
  • Format Adaptation: Rapidly reformat master creative assets for each platform’s native conventions UGC-style short-form for TikTok and Reels, intent-driven formats for Google, and outcome-focused creative for programmatic and retargeting.

Video and Educational Content Production

  • AI Video: Own end-to-end AI video production from script through final export. Write video scripts and voiceover copy, generate synthetic voiceovers using ElevenLabs (Eleven v3), produce AI-generated video using Sora, Kling, Pika, and Runway Gen-3, and assemble and edit final cuts using Descript and CapCut AI. Deliver platform-ready video in all required formats and aspect ratios without dependence on a separate video editor or post-production team.
  • Educational Content: Produce educational content at scale such as patient education videos, medication explainers, condition awareness content, and provider-facing clinical summaries using AI tools to move from brief to polished output rapidly. Ensure all educational content meets 503A/503B accuracy standards, medical affairs approval, and platform-specific compliance requirements. This content builds brand trust and supports both acquisition and retention across patient and HCP audiences.
  • Content Scaling: Develop and maintain repeatable production systems for educational and long-form content that enable rapid iteration without sacrificing accuracy or compliance. Build modular content frameworks that can be versioned and adapted across audience segments, therapeutic categories, and distribution channels.

Performance Optimization

  • Creative Testing: Execute structured A/B and multivariate tests across hooks, visuals, CTAs, and audience overlays. Document results and apply learnings to the next production cycle to continuously improve ROAS and CAC.
  • Data Analysis: Monitor real-time performance signals (CTR, thumb-stop rate, ROAS, CPL) and use AI-assisted analytics tools to detect creative fatigue and prioritize the next round of iterations.
  • Optimization Reporting: Maintain a creative performance dashboard tracking results by channel, asset type, and audience segment. Share regular performance summaries with clear, data-backed creative recommendations.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Brief Execution: Serve as the primary creative production resource for the Campaign team, Performance Marketing team, and Marketing Innovation team. Translate briefs into structured concepts, storyboards, and production-ready assets on time and at spec. Manage concurrent requests across multiple teams without losing production quality or compliance integrity.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate creative status, test results, and blockers clearly to marketing leads and cross-functional partners. Keep all stakeholders aligned with concise, organized updates.
  • Tool Management: Operate the AI creative tech stack such as generative platforms, DAM systems, and creative automation tools with rigor. Document workflows and flag opportunities to improve speed or quality.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Comprehensive, hands-on proficiency across the current AI creative toolset, including: image generation (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Ideogram, Leonardo.ai, DALL-E 3, Canva AI), video generation (Sora, Kling, Pika, Runway Gen-3, HeyGen, Synthesia), voiceover and audio (ElevenLabs, Eleven v3), copy and ideation (ChatGPT, Claude, GPT-4o), video editing and repurposing (Descript, CapCut AI, Opus Clip), and digital asset management (DAM platforms). Able to move from brief to published asset rapidly across all format types.
  • Creative concept and storyboarding fluency: ability to translate a campaign brief into a structured creative concept, shot list, and visual storyboard before touching a production tool. This upstream thinking is what separates strong AI creative producers from prompt-and-paste operators and is essential for producing work that converts, not just work that renders.
  • Working knowledge of performance marketing fundamentals such as A/B testing, creative fatigue detection, ROAS and CAC tracking and the analytical instincts to act on data rather than intuition. Familiarity with healthcare advertising compliance requirements, including FDA promotional guidelines, FTC rules, and HIPAA-safe messaging, with a track record of producing compelling creative within regulatory constraints.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns and asset requests with strong organizational discipline, clear communication, and a bias for building repeatable systems over one-off solutions.

  • Experience producing compliant creative within a regulated industry is a strong plus; ability to work within legal and brand guardrails without sacrificing performance is required.

jobs.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
jobs.excerpt: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
jobs.description:
We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.

Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model.

‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application.
⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English.
🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM.

WHO CAN APPLY

  • Travel professionals and experienced trip planners

  • 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal)

  • English level: Advanced / Fluent (required)

WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST)
You will review two pre-generated travel tasks. For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification.

Then, for the 2nd task, you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger.

WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION)
A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.).

We call this a Knife:

  • A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable.

  • Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change.

Examples of Knives in Travel

  • Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times

  • Closures and holidays that change what’s possible

  • Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused)

  • Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible)

  • Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility

WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM

You’ll give 3 ratings per task:

  1. Overall Quality (1–5)

    How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)?

  2. Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5)

    Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan?

  3. Checklist Quality (1–5)

    Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria?
    (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”)

You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings.

WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY)
You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger:

  • Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk

  • Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife

  • Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife

  • Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering:

    • feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check)

    • the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint)

    • no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability)

    • branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer

    • safety only when there is real risk

Checklist item example:

PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability.

Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”).

IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK)
You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios:

  • Rating realism and feasibility risk

  • Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives)

  • Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans

COMPENSATION

Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency.

Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning

  • You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations)

  • You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial

  • Manage the development and implementation, including approval process for Product Assessors (sterilization team) and sterilization auditors, new personnel and for on-going monitoring and re-approval of personnel.

In addition to above, as member of the Global Operations Leadership Team:

  • Accountable for resource management within the team reporting to the role, including workload planning, capacity monitoring, and proactive identification and resolution of resource gaps – including Hubs and DO resources.
  • Drive team performance against global targets, with full accountability for chargeability, utilisation, productivity, timeliness, assessment quality, and regulatory compliance – including Hubs and DO resources.

  • Establish a culture of accountability and performance by setting clear expectations, defining individual and team goals, and monitoring delivery against operational and technical objectives.
  • Monitor, analyse, and report team performance, implementing timely corrective actions and providing regular updates to the Head of Operations.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process efficiencies, capability development initiatives, and best practices within the team.
  • Contribute to business growth, including supporting proposals, client interactions, training, and external engagements as required.

Key Accountabilities – Sterilization

  • Maintain a full knowledge and understanding of SGS (Global System and SGS NB 1639) procedures, Best Practices Guides, MDCG Guidance Documents and external approval criteria to allow efficient and effective technical reviews. Ensure full compliance with the Company’s Code of Integrity, Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement and act in accordance with SGS policies, procedures and processes.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance of medical device technical documentation assessments under applicable regulations and schemes
  • Be a point of contact regarding queries relevant to sterilisation and support CE marking activities carried out by SGS, including support of clients’ complaints, support of delivering offices.
  • Provide training, and qualification support in relation to sterilization across the SGS NB 1639 conformity assessment process, including recruitment, assessment, approval, and ongoing capability.
  • Initiate and support process improvements activities as needed.
  • Develop external training packages for clients by providing regulatory advice and guidance within the scope of notified body. Undertake personal professional development and ensure appropriate training records and personal logs are updated to maintain relevant knowledge.
  • At all times adopt a safe behaviour by exercising due regard for the health and safety of yourself, colleagues and clients, in line with the Company’s policies and procedures.
  • Oversee competence management activities, including the authorization of codes(qualification), monitoring, and reapproval of personnel
  • Monitor team KPIs (chargeability, utilization, productivity, timeliness, assessment quality) and support corrective actions when required.
  • Perform an annual appraisal for existing team members and an appraisal after three (3) and six (6) months for new team members. Implementation of the performance management and disciplinary process as required.
  • Support the achievement of medical devices operational and financial targets.

In addition to that as member of the Global Operations Leadership Team additional responsibilities as below:

  • Act as the senior technical authority for the assigned scope, ensuring consistent interpretation and application of regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Provide expert technical support to team members, DOs, and Hubs, including resolution of complex technical issues and escalations.

  • Good working knowledge of medical device management systems, medical device compliance and auditing and technical documentation assessment techniques.

  • Appropriate knowledge and understanding of devices legislation as well as harmonised standards, CS and guidance documents in regards to sterilization.
  • Appropriate knowledge and understanding of the conformity assessment procedures provided for in the regulations for medical devices.
  • Knowledge and experience with the NB’s quality management system, related procedures and the required qualification criteria.
  • The ability to draw up records and reports demonstrating that the relevant conformity assessment activities have been appropriately carried out.
  • Experience of management of cross functional global teams is an asset.

Experience

Essential

  • More than 10 years in the Medical device industry (at least 5 years within sterile medical device research and development and/or manufacturing) including experience in design, control or manufacturing and sterilization processes (microbial monitoring, packaging integrity as well as sterilization validations) of devices but as well in QMS auditing and/or technical documentation assessment covering sterilization.

  • Previous medical device training (e.g. Product Specific; Standards Specific (sterilization standards, ISO 13485, ISO 14971); Directive Specific (93/42/EEC, 98/79/EC), Regulation (EU) 2017/745).

Role Summary

HubSpot Academy is on a mission to be the place people go to learn how to start and grow a business. We offer a variety of educational and inspirational content — from lessons and full certification courses to live, hands-on workshops — that provides valuable business training to people all over the world. This educational content generates new customers for the business and delights our existing ones in service of achieving their business and career goals.

We're looking for a Professional HubSpot Academy Professor - Coach who is passionate about helping customers confidently use HubSpot tools through live, hands-on small group coaching sessions. This role is ideal for someone who shows growing independence and proficiency in live facilitation and content creation, effectively applying skills to enhance customer outcomes while contributing to HubSpot's educational mission at scale.

As a Professional HubSpot Academy Professor - Coach at HubSpot Academy, you'll be responsible for developing and delivering live, small group coaching sessions focused on specific HubSpot tools and use cases, as well as creating supporting on-demand educational content. You'll design engaging workshop experiences and practical learning resources that solve real customer problems, drive product adoption, and support long-term usage of HubSpot products. The role requires good understanding of adult learning principles, live facilitation skills, content creation abilities, and comprehensive knowledge of HubSpot's product offerings, as well as a passion for crafting hands-on learning experiences that deliver measurable impact at scale.

This role sits on the HubSpot Academy team and reports to the Manager of HubSpot Academy Education. You'll work alongside other Academy Professors and Customer Evangelists to develop comprehensive educational strategies that align with HubSpot's business objectives and support customers at scale.

What you'll do:

Facilitate High-Impact Small Group Coaching Sessions:

  • Lead multiple live, interactive coaching sessions each week for groups of customers focused on specific HubSpot tools, features, or use cases (e.g., Advanced CRM, Marketing Automation, Customer Agent, Loop Marketing plays)
  • Run sessions in alignment with standardized agendas and learning objectives while adapting to the needs and questions of each cohort in real-time
  • Demonstrate growing expertise in facilitating workshops where customers work on their real HubSpot challenges and leave having configured something concrete in their portal
  • Create supportive learning environments where customers feel comfortable asking questions, sharing use cases, and learning from peers

Create Supporting On-Demand Content:

  • Develop short educational videos, workbooks, and guides that complement small group coaching topics and enable customers to review key concepts
  • Create practical resources that customers can reference when implementing what they learned during coaching sessions
  • Design follow-up materials that reinforce session learning and support continued product adoption
  • Collaborate with Instructional Designers and content creators to ensure cohesive learning experiences across live and on-demand formats

Drive Product Adoption and Usage Uplift:

  • Design sessions and supporting content so customers leave with actionable next steps and concrete configurations in their HubSpot portals
  • Partner cross-functionality to understand which specific actions and sessions drive the largest usage movement
  • Refine content and facilitation approaches based on data showing what drives measurable customer outcomes
  • Track how coaching sessions contribute to customer activation, feature adoption, and ongoing product usage

Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

  • Work closely with Academy, Product, Creative, and Marketing teams to align session topics with product launches, spotlight moments, and strategic initiatives (e.g., AI adoption, Loop Marketing, Customer Agent)
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and leadership on what customers are saying and where they're getting stuck
  • Ensure coaching insights inform product roadmap and enablement priorities
  • Participate in cross-functional projects to develop educational strategies aligned with business goals

Maintain Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure accurate logging of sessions and attendance via Bevy and HubSpot systems, partnering with operations teams to resolve data integrity issues
  • Follow established workflows for customer inquiries about registration, scheduling, or follow-up questions
  • Use tools like Asana, AirTable, and Google Suite to coordinate session planning, content development, and track key metrics
  • Monitor registration and attendance patterns to optimize session timing, topics, and promotional approaches

Continuously Improve Content and Experience:

  • Iterate on session content, flow, and activities based on NPS, CSAT, qualitative feedback, and performance metrics (attendance, usage impact, repeat attendance)
  • Collect session feedback to continuously improve both live facilitation and supporting on-demand content
  • Experiment with new formats (e.g., "Build With" sessions, customer guest speakers, region-specific variants)
  • Share insights with the broader team to enhance the small group coaching program and on-demand content library

What you'll bring:

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and Portuguese
  • You have demonstrated experience leading live trainings, workshops, or group sessions (virtual or in-person) where you taught, demoed, and troubleshooted on the fly.
  • You possess exceptional facilitation and communication skills—you can read a room, simplify complex topics, and keep diverse audiences engaged and on track.
  • You have strong product aptitude and quickly learn new features, connecting them to real-world customer use cases across Marketing, Sales, and Service workflows.
  • You effectively communicate and collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to align on coaching objectives and customer needs.
  • You're energized by scale—reaching hundreds or thousands of customers through repeatable experiences—and see group coaching as core to the future of customer education.
  • You're customer-obsessed and empathetic, able to meet customers where they are in their journey, even when they're just beginning with advanced features.
  • You comfortably adjust to changing priorities in a fast-evolving environment where programs, tools, and processes are being optimized, and you actively contribute to improvements.
  • You can craft well-structured written content for workbooks, guides, and supporting materials that enhance learning experiences.
  • You independently explore and suggest innovative approaches to coaching and content creation, experimenting with new facilitation techniques and formats.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working directly with HubSpot (as a user, partner, or prior HubSpotter), especially across multiple Hubs
  • Experience facilitating global customer audiences across time zones
  • Familiarity with event platforms, and/or prior experience in scaled programs or live onboarding
  • Experience creating short-form video content or educational materials

En tant que Développeur PLM Windchill, vous participerez au développement, à la personnalisation et à la maintenance des solutions PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) basées sur la plateforme Windchill. Vous serez chargé(e) de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métier et techniques pour répondre aux besoins spécifiques des clients et garantir le bon fonctionnement des processus de gestion du cycle de vie des produits.

Vos principales responsabilités incluront :

  • Concevoir et développer des personnalisations et des extensions pour Windchill selon les besoins métiers.
  • Configurer et adapter les workflows, objets et processus dans la plateforme Windchill.
  • Intégrer Windchill avec d'autres systèmes d'information (ERP, CRM, etc.) via des API ou des connecteurs dédiés.
  • Participer à l’analyse des besoins techniques et fonctionnels pour proposer des solutions adaptées.
  • Gérer les montées de version, les correctifs et la maintenance de la plateforme Windchill.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et fonctionnelle des développements réalisés.
  • Apporter un support technique aux utilisateurs et résoudre les incidents liés à la plateforme.
  • Assurer une veille technologique sur les outils PLM et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de Windchill.
  • Expérience avérée dans le développement et la personnalisation de solutions PLM, en particulier sur Windchill (au moins 5 ans).
  • Bonne maîtrise des langages de programmation Java et XML.
  • Connaissance des outils de développement et des API Windchill (WC SDK, RESTful Web Services, Info*Engine).
  • Expérience dans la configuration et la personnalisation des workflows, lifecycles et business rules dans Windchill.
  • Familiarité avec les bases de données relationnelles (Oracle, SQL Server) et les requêtes SQL.
  • Compétence en intégration de systèmes (via SOAP, REST, ou autres mécanismes).
  • Expérience avec les outils de versionnement de code (Git, SVN).

Vos avantages :

📆 27 jours de congés payés + 10 RTT

🥗 Tickets restaurant : D'une valeur de 9€ (Prise en charge à 60% par Inetum)

👨🏻‍💻 Suivi de carrière individualisé : avec votre manager, leader technique ou chef de projet en proximité tout au long de l'année en plus des entretiens annuels et professionnels.

👋🏻 Parcours d'intégration unique et personnalisé : Accompagnement, référent, rencontre avec les équipes pour vous familiariser avec les valeurs du groupe.

Les petits + Inetum :

💻 Un accord télétravail flexible : Jusqu'à 3 jours/semaine en fonction de notre client

🚌 Une prise en charge à 50% des frais de transport en commun dans le cadre de vos déplacements professionnels

🚀 Politique de formation avantageuse : Formations et Certifications techniques, fonctionnelles, testing, méthodologie et gestion de projet, développement personnel…)

📣 L'opportunité de transmettre votre savoir en tant qu'expert : Animation de Techlunch, participation à des meetup techniques, prise de parole sur des conférences, dans des écoles ou sur des événements.

À propos d’Inetum

Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 26 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe œuvrent chaque jour pour créer un impact digital concret : des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l’innovation et au bien commun.

Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum accompagne les organisations dans leurs enjeux de transformation digitale avec proximité, flexibilité et responsabilité. Porté par sa raison d’être, Inetum défend une vision d’une technologie utile et maîtrisée, capable de révéler le plein potentiel des organisations et de la société : « Let’s make tech right ».

En 2025, le groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 2,2 milliards d’euros.

jobs.description:
At Base, our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to succeed in the global e-commerce landscape. We provide a technology platform that revolutionizes their online sales operations.

Our international team, spanning from Europe to the Americas, delivers a comprehensive, all-in-one solution to thousands of merchants worldwide. We offer seamless integrations with industry leaders, including Amazon, eBay, Shopify, DHL, and FedEx.

However, we are more than just a technology company. We are one of the fastest-scaling platforms in the sector, having achieved 15x growth over the past three years. We cultivate a culture where tangible impact and collaboration are paramount, with our team being the driving force behind our innovation.

If you are driven to shape the future of global e-commerce, we invite you to apply. Your opportunity awaits.

Currently, we are looking for a Business Intelligence Developer (SQL, PowerBI) to take a key role in our data experts team and transform data into actionable insights that will shape the company's dynamic growth strategy. You will play a key role in every stage of the development of our reporting platform, taking end-to-end ownership from gathering requirements, data ingestion and warehousing, through robust data modelling and validation, to the creation of meaningful insights and reporting that enable informed strategic decisions and drive operational excellence across the business.

We seek curious "doers" who are passionate about data analyses and thrive in a role that combines deep technical expertise with strategic business understanding.

You'll be a perfect fit for this role if you have deep expertise in data warehousing and visualization (using Microsoft PowerBI), exceptional analytical and technical skills (advanced SQL proficiency is essential), and a business-first mindset with the ability to think critically and strategically.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence
  • Understanding of data warehousing architecture, data modeling concepts, and ETL/ELT best practices
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL for complex querying, performance tuning, and data manipulation
  • Expertise with business intelligence/data visualization tools (Microsoft PowerBI is a must!)
  • Proficiency with version control (Git)
  • Flexibility to quickly adapt to changing priorities within a very dynamic startup environment
  • Effective and flexible communication skills, including the ability to translate technical details into business and commercial objectives, and vice versa
  • A proactive communication style – you’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and articulate your vision to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Self-driven and detail-oriented mindset while working with data
  • Nice-to-have: hands-on experience with AWS data components, like Iceberg, S3, Glue and Redshift for transformation, ingestion and storage of data
  • Nice-to-have: experience AI-driven data structures development

Tasks

  • Own the full lifecycle of BI development: from gathering and challenging business requirements to solution design, deployment, and fostering end-user adoption
  • Act as a key partner for business stakeholders and data engineers, effectively translating business needs into robust technical solutions
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust Business Intelligence solutions using our modern tech stack (AWS Redshift, AWS RDS, Microsoft PowerBI, Git, AI tools)
  • Develop comprehensive data models and build interactive dashboards using Microsoft PowerBI
  • Perform both ad-hoc data analysis and build automated reporting solutions that empower business users

Benefits

  • Pivotal role in an expert team where your contributions have an immediate and visible impact on the business
  • Chance to develop opportunities in the modern up-to-date cloud technologies environment
  • Casual and friendly atmosphere at work and the ability to work with an international team of passionate professionals
  • High level of ownership and a real impact on our data strategy
  • Growth opportunity in a place focused on long-term collaboration and your personal growth

jobs.excerpt: Accenture Song Life—A Partner for Growth The Agency of Record model we all grew up with was built for stability—long planning cycles, rigid campaigns, and success measured in outputs.
jobs.description:
Accenture Song Life—A Partner for Growth 

The Agency of Record model we all grew up with was built for stability—long planning cycles, rigid campaigns, and success measured in outputs. Today demands something more. With evolving pipelines, diverse patient populations, and accelerated launches, the challenge is not just communication—it’s staying continually relevant. 

At Accenture Song Life, we reinvented the AOR to be a true growth engine for biopharma—anchored in one objective: helping you fuel growth by building continual relevance. 

We do this by being Smarter, Faster, Better 

Smarter—intelligence-led, powered by AI, data, and life sciences expertise, so your brand is always one step ahead. 

Faster—an agile, adaptive model that scales global blockbusters and targets rare disease communities with equal precision, moving at the speed of science and patient need. 

Better—world-class creativity combined with Accenture’s technology and consulting rigor, shifting from campaigns to outcomes—like launch uptake, adherence, and market share. 

The reinvented AOR is not a supplier—it’s a growth partner. Accenture Song Life brings creativity, technology, and strategy together to serve as your growth engine—continually relevant, always accountable, and built to deliver impact for patients, providers, and your business.” 

You Are:

Accenture Song is looking for a rare kind of creative engineer — someone who thinks like a strategist, builds like a maker, and operates like an agency of one. This is not a role about managing AI adoption or evangelizing what's possible. It's about doing it: conceiving ideas, assembling the tools, and shipping solutions that didn't exist yesterday.

You'll help reinvent how Accenture Song works and what it sells — turning emerging AI capabilities into real, repeatable offerings that create genuine value for clients. You move fast, work across disciplines, and are equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with a creative director and a working prototype session with a technologist.

The Work:

Invent & Build

  • Act as a creative engineer and maker — not just a recommender. If you can imagine it, you should be able to rough it out.

  • Prototype rapidly: turn a brief, a conversation, or a napkin idea into something tangible that a team can react to and a client can see

  • Design AI-native solutions from scratch — not retrofitted workflows, but experiences and systems built around what AI actually makes possible

  • Bring creative instincts to technical problems and technical instincts to creative ones

Shape & Scale Offerings

  • Work with Song leadership to identify which prototypes have the legs to become formal, repeatable offerings

  • Define what an offering actually is: the problem it solves, the value it delivers, how it's built, and how it gets sold

  • Develop the reusable assets, playbooks, and reference models that let teams deliver it again and again

  • Ensure everything you build is designed for scale — not one-off heroics

Connect the Dots

  • Serve as the connective tissue between strategy, creative, data, technology, and operations — fluent in all of them, siloed in none

  • Help teams choose the right tools for the right job, without attachment to any one platform or approach

  • Make the complex feel simple: translate AI capabilities into plain language that inspires action at the leadership level

  • Facilitate working sessions, sprints, and incubators that move quickly from "what if" to "here's how"

Challenge & Evolve

  • Question established processes — especially the ones people have stopped questioning

  • Advocate for AI-first approaches rather than AI bolted onto the way things have always been done

  • Help the organization distinguish between process optimization and genuine reinvention

  • Identify the organizational friction that slows innovation and work with leadership to clear it

AI Fluency:

You should be comfortable working with AI tools across the creative and technical spectrum — not as an IT specialist, but as a creative practitioner who knows which tool to reach for and why. Familiarity across some of the following is expected:

Generative & Creative AI

  • Claude, ChatGPT/GPT-4o, Gemini — language, reasoning, and content generation

  • Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway — visual ideation, image and video generation within creative workflows

  • Suno, ElevenLabs, or similar — audio and voice generation for experience prototyping

Agentic & Workflow Automation

  • Building agentic workflows — designing multi-step AI systems that can reason, act, and loop with minimal human intervention

  • Orchestration tools — experience with frameworks that connect models, data, and actions into coherent pipelines

  • Low-code and no-code automation — turning complex processes into streamlined, repeatable flows without writing everything from scratch

Prototyping & Rapid Development

  • Vibe coding and AI-assisted development — using tools like Cursor, Copilot, or Claude to build functional prototypes faster than traditional dev cycles allow

  • API integration and prompt engineering — knowing how to connect AI services and get reliable, repeatable outputs

  • Cloud and deployment basics — enough to get a prototype live and in front of stakeholders quickly

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience across AI solution development, digital transformation, creative technology, product innovation, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Agency, consulting, innovation lab, or product company experience
  • Work that spans marketing, commerce, experience design, content, creative technology, or enterprise operations
  • Experience building reusable IP: accelerators, toolkits, reference architectures, or commercial offerings
  • Familiarity with MLR/PRC review, FDA/EMA standards, or evidence-based content workflows is a genuine plus
  • A demonstrated ability to learn new domains quickly

This opportunity is ideal for experienced Structural Engineers who enjoy solving complex engineering problems and want to apply their expertise to cutting-edge AI technology.

What You'll Do:

  • Design realistic AI training tasks based on structural engineering concepts and real-world design challenges.
  • Create clear engineering problem statements covering structural analysis, design, simulation, and code compliance.
  • Develop reference solutions and deterministic scoring criteria to evaluate AI-generated responses.
  • Build engineering tasks using OpenSees and other structural engineering methodologies.
  • Create evaluation scenarios involving topics such as:
    • Pushover analysis
    • Seismic design
    • Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
    • Reinforced concrete design
    • Steel connection detailing
    • Structural retrofit
  • Review AI-generated engineering solutions for technical accuracy, engineering judgment, and compliance with applicable design codes.
  • Provide structured feedback that helps improve AI performance in structural engineering.
  • Work independently in a fully remote, flexible environment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related field (Master's or PhD is a plus).
  • Professional experience in structural analysis and structural design.
  • Hands-on experience using OpenSees.
  • Strong understanding of structural design standards such as ACI 318, AISC 360, or Eurocode (EN 1992, EN 1993, EN 1998).
  • Experience with structural engineering concepts including nonlinear modeling, response spectrum analysis, pushover analysis, or performance-based design.
  • Ability to write clear, detailed, and technically accurate engineering documentation.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage your own schedule.

Nice to Haves:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Experience with advanced seismic engineering or structural retrofit projects.
  • Experience with finite element modeling and structural simulation.
  • Previous experience reviewing technical work, conducting research, or developing engineering assessments.
  • Interest or experience in AI, machine learning, or engineering model evaluation.
  • Fully remote, project-based opportunity.
  • Flexible schedule — work whenever it fits your availability.
  • Compensation ranges from $80–110 USD per hour, depending on experience.
  • Expected workload is 10–39 hours per week, though project volume may fluctuate.
  • Payments are issued weekly for work completed during the previous week.
  • If selected, you will receive an Upwork contract offer along with onboarding instructions for the client's task platform.

An enterprise client is seeking experienced Structural Engineers to help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems. This opportunity is part of a large-scale initiative focused on improving how AI models solve complex structural engineering problems and generate technically accurate engineering solutions.

You will work alongside a community of subject matter experts contributing real-world engineering knowledge to help shape the future of Generative AI.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Generation Colombia (1 year Fixed Term/Remote)
jobs.excerpt: About Generation:At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
About Generation:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

About the role:

  • Job duration: This is a 12 months fixed-term contract
  • Location requirements: Remote (with reliable WiFi), based in Colombia. Availability to travel within Colombia and attend in-person events
  • Start date: November 2026
  • End date: October 2027

What will you do:

The Program Coordinator will coordinate the execution of training phase logistics and operational activities across Generation Colombia programs. This role may also deliver assigned operational support to mobilization processes, as required.

Main Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for learners, responding to learner inquiries, tracking requests, and escalating issues according to defined protocols.
  • Execute learner onboarding activities (“Day 0”) by preparing onboarding sessions, validating learner readiness requirements, and documenting attendance and commitment prior to “Day 1.”

Job Opening Details:

Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the IgG4-related disease community to join our freelance staff of patient and caregiver columnists on IgG4-RD News, which launches in early June.

A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

Please note you MUST be a member of the IgG4 community — a patient or caregiver — in order to apply for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Fulfill 2x monthly deadlines as agreed upon on hire.
  • Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors.
  • Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures.
  • Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit.
  • Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner.
  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

Experience Required

  • Prior experience with writing for an audience.
  • At least three months’ direct experience with having or caring for someone with IgG4.
  • Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses.

Experience Preferred

  • Experience in being professionally edited for publication.
  • Experienced in generating a blog or column.
  • Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to IgG4.

Knowledge Required

  • Fundamentals of how IgG4 works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the IgG4 community.

Skills Required

  • A swift and independent learner of Internet technology.
  • A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences.
  • Time management.
  • Advanced creative writing.

Skills Preferred

  • Experience in using WordPress for content creation.
  • Experience with the Slack communication app.

Abilities Required

  • Internet access and use.
  • Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities.

Who is Bionews?
Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

Bionews Vision
To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.
