jobs.title: Funnel Strategist & Copywriter - $4-5K USD/mo - Content Marketing SaaS Agency
jobs.excerpt: ✍️ Join a High-Growth Team! If you've got a shelf of copywriting books and at least one of them felt like it finally explained how your brain works, keep reading.
jobs.description:
✍️ Join a High-Growth Team!

If you've got a shelf of copywriting books and at least one of them felt like it finally explained how your brain works, keep reading.

We're looking for a copywriter with a serious command of the English language. Someone who knows you can't create desire, you can only channel it, and who can find the exact words to do that. Someone Eugene Schwartz would be proud of (IYKYK).

You may be earlier in your career. That's fine. We care more about talent and trajectory than years on a résumé.

You may have written good copy before, but you want more than good.

You want to see your words move real numbers.

If you've been looking for an opportunity to:

  • Own the strategy behind a funnel and write every step of it

  • Learn from leaders who have spent decades in digital marketing

  • See how your work performs within weeks

  • Have location and schedule autonomy

This page could literally change the course of your career. But only if you keep reading.

🌟 About AmpiFire:

AmpiFire gets businesses found by people searching for what they sell: on Google, YouTube, social media, podcast apps and AI tools like ChatGPT.

For each customer, we turn one topic into articles, videos, podcasts, social posts and infographics, then publish them across 300+ platforms, including X, YouTube, Google News and Apple Podcasts. Software does the volume; people check the quality.

12,000+ businesses have used AmpiFire, from small businesses to large brands.

We're a remote team of about 70, self-funded and profitable. No investor can push us to grow at any cost, so we put impact first. Big corporations take most of the attention online, and we'd rather help the underdog win some back.

The timing is on our side. Businesses now want content on every channel, made faster with AI, and they want AI tools to recommend them. AmpiFire is the best way to drive traffic from everywhere, AI recommendations included.

We're still small, with huge room to grow. One winning funnel or campaign could add millions in revenue, and you'd be the one building it. We plan to grow fast, on our own terms, and your role grows with us.

🚀 What You'll Do:

  • Get to know our ICPs, competitor messaging and everything else you love to research until you can write in our buyers' own words

  • Plan and write full funnels for AmpiFire's products and offers, from landing pages, offers, sales assets, to things like follow-up emails

  • Write landing pages, email sequences, ads and case studies

  • Collaborate with the team to look at the numbers, find where readers drop off, and fix it

  • Bring ideas to the table, even half-formed ones

  • Work alongside our paid media, creative, sales, and customer success teams

🛠️ What the Work Looks Like

  • Real funnels, real traffic. Your copy goes in front of business owners, marketers, and decision-makers at companies of every size, from small businesses to enterprises.

  • You plan it and you write it. You'll help decide what gets built and why, then write it yourself.

  • Quick feedback. You'll see the numbers on your work, and we'll go through them together.

  • Direct mentorship. You'll work closely with Chris (CEO), and other leadership team members who have decades in digital marketing experience.

🧩 You're a Great Fit If You Have:

  • Exceptional written English. Your copy is clear, persuasive, and reads like a person talking. You know the difference between writing that sounds smart and writing that sells.

  • 1-3+ years writing conversion copy (agency, in-house, and freelance all count)

  • A portfolio of real work, ideally with results attached

  • A feel for funnels. You think about how aware the reader is at each step and what they need to believe before they'll take the next one.

  • Range. You can write for a solo business owner in the morning and an enterprise marketing team in the afternoon.

  • Studied the craft. You've read books like Breakthrough Advertising, Ogilvy on Advertising, Cashvertising, or The Adweek Copywriting Handbook, or taken serious copywriting courses, and you can tell us what stuck.

  • Research habits. You'd rather analyze 50 customer reviews than guess.

  • Persuasion out loud, too. You can make the case for an idea on a call and take pushback without getting defensive.

  • No ego. You share ideas freely, take feedback well, and want to keep learning.

  • Quick thinking. Shifting priorities and fast turnarounds don't rattle you.

  • C2 English proficiency (written and verbal)

  • A love of writing, and the itch to see it pay off

💰 Why Join AmpiFire:

  • $4,000 to $5,000 USD monthly, based on experience and what you show us during the process

  • Real responsibility from day one, and more as you prove yourself

  • Bootstrapped since day 1, with no outside funding or investor pressure (this means we've built something you can 100% believe in)

  • ~70 employees: big enough for momentum, small enough for impact

  • Help businesses of every size grow profitably through organic traffic and sales (solving a BIG problem in the marketing space; IYKYK, and you'll earn major bonus points if you can clearly articulate why that's important to us)

📋 Our Hiring Process: What to Expect?

We've designed our hiring process to be thorough yet efficient, giving both you and our team the chance to decide if we're the right fit for each other.

Total time commitment is typically under 6 hours, and decisions are typically made within a few weeks of your application.

We'll tell you what comes next at each stage.

  1. Application: A few short questions and a quick writing exercise, plus your portfolio

  2. Copy task: Two paragraphs of copy to a short brief.

  3. Screening: A short video submission or a 30-minute call

  4. Test assignment: A real-world funnel and copy brief. Show us how you get from research to final draft.

  5. Final interview: With Chris (CEO) to learn about the vision and culture of the company

  6. Job offer sent to the candidate to join the team

Interested?

Hit the apply button in this posting and include a link to your portfolio.

jobs.description:
This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division - the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants.

As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole.

Gracenote's identifiers and normalized metadata have powered content identification, search, and discovery across the media ecosystem for decades. We are now extending that structured foundation from the title level down to the scene, chapter, and clip level, using multimodal AI to derive rich, queryable understanding directly from video.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to support this team and own go-to-market for the portfolio end to end: the portfolio narrative, the segment-level positioning, the launches, the enablement, and the market intelligence that shapes how we go to market. This is a build-it role, not a maintain-it role. You will help shape a market while it is still forming, and most of what exists twelve months from now will be work you created.

Responsibilities:

Positioning, narrative, and messaging

  • Category definition. Author the market narrative for scene-level video intelligence: the problem, why now, why a shared platform beats point solutions, and why Gracenote is uniquely positioned to provide it.

  • Segment-level value propositions. Translate one platform story into distinct, credible propositions for platform and distribution buyers, content owners, and the advertising ecosystem, each with its own economics, buying committee, and proof points.

  • Messaging architecture. Build and maintain the messaging house, proof-point library, and terminology standards, and hold the organization to consistent language across product, sales, partnerships, and corporate marketing.

Market, customer, and competitive intelligence

  • Competitive program. Maintain a living view of AI video-understanding vendors, platform-native capabilities, and adjacent metadata and ad-tech players. Frame the platform-versus-toolkit distinction in terms buyers actually feel: time to value, integration cost, and cost of ownership at full catalog scale.

  • Voice of the customer. Run a structured discovery cadence with prospects, design partners, and internal commercial teams. Convert conversations into documented segment insight rather than anecdote.

  • Market requirements. Feed evidence-based requirements and prioritization input to product, and co-author market requirements documents that connect capability to demand.

Launch and lifecycle

  • Launch ownership. Own launch strategy and execution across the portfolio: tiering, readiness criteria, cross-functional plans, internal and external timing, and post-launch measurement.

  • Early-access and design-partner motion. Build the collateral and narrative that make early-stage, pre-GA capabilities credible to sophisticated partners, including partner-facing decks, evaluation frameworks, success criteria, and reference stories.

  • Adoption and iteration. Track adoption after launch, identify where the story is not landing, and drive the fixes.

Commercial enablement

  • Sales and partnership readiness. Produce the pitch narratives, first-call decks, battlecards, demo storylines, one-pagers, FAQ libraries, and objection-handling guidance the commercial teams need to run without you in the room.

  • Technical and trust objections. Own the buyer-facing answers to the questions that stall deals: content rights and permitted use, model training boundaries, retention, tenant isolation, explainability, and classification accuracy. Partner with product, legal, and security to keep those answers current and defensible.

  • Deal support. Partner directly on strategic and design-partner opportunities where the narrative is still being invented.

Market presence and thought leadership

  • Analyst and industry relations. Brief analysts, shape the coverage of an emerging category, and represent the portfolio at industry events.

  • Content and demand. Work with corporate marketing and demand generation on campaigns, web content, bylines, webinars, and case studies that build category awareness and pipeline.

  • Product marketing depth.Seven or more years in product marketing, including meaningful time at a senior or lead level in B2B technology, data, or media technology. Demonstrated command of the craft: segmentation, positioning frameworks, messaging development, launch management, competitive analysis, and enablement.

  • Media and entertainment fluency. Real working knowledge of the video ecosystem: streaming and CTV, FAST and ad-supported models, linear and live, device platforms and operating systems, distributors and aggregators, studios and content packagers. You understand how content metadata drives discovery surfaces, program guides, recommendations, and ad targeting, and you can speak to how money moves through this ecosystem.

  • Technical credibility. Comfortable and accurate discussing multimodal AI and modern retrieval: embeddings and vector search, semantic and natural-language search, ontologies and taxonomies, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, and delivery through APIs and data feeds. You do not need to build it, but you must be able to hold asubstantive conversation with our engineers and with a partner's technical team, then explain it plainly to a business buyer without overclaiming.

  • Zero-to-one instincts. Experience taking new or category-creating products to market where the reference customers, the category language, and sometimes the buyer are all still being established. Comfortable operating with incomplete inputs and a moving roadmap.

  • Multi-audience storytelling. You have marketed the same underlying technology to structurally different buyers and kept the story coherent across all of them.

  • Exceptional writing. Clear, dense, persuasive writing is the core output of this role, from a one-line positioning statement to an executive narrative to a partner FAQ.

  • Cross-functional influence. Proven ability to align product, sales, partnerships, legal, and executive stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Education. Bachelor's degree required. MBA or equivalent experience welcome.

Preferred

  • Advertising technology exposure: contextual targeting, dynamic ad insertion, brand suitability, or measurement.

  • Familiarity with content metadata standards, industry consortia, or interoperability initiatives.

  • Experience with data licensing or data-product business models.

  • International or multi-region go-to-market experience.

Who you will work with

You will partner daily with product management and engineering on the platform and product roadmap; with sales, business development, and partnerships on active pursuits and design-partner programs; with corporate marketing on campaigns and events; and with legal, security, and privacy on the trust questions that come with AI-derived content intelligence. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:

As the Director, Arc - Capital Markets Strategy & GTM, you will define and execute Arc's capital markets ecosystem strategy, helping establish Arc as the leading blockchain network for institutional financial activity. Working across Ecosystem Partnerships, Product, and Commercial leadership, you will identify high-value market opportunities, develop the strategic roadmap for the capital markets ecosystem, architect complex partnership and commercial structures, and influence product investments required to unlock adoption.

This is not a traditional business development role. Success in this position comes from defining ecosystem strategy, influencing product direction, architecting partnerships, and creating market adoption across the capital markets value chain. While you will work closely with relationship owners and commercial teams, your focus is on building the capital markets ecosystem, not simply closing individual deals.

You will build and scale the capital markets ecosystem on Arc, creating a network of partners, use cases, and market participants that drive compounding on-chain activity and establish a durable competitive advantage in institutional finance. This is a highly strategic, zero-to-one role focused on ecosystem creation, market development, and product influence rather than traditional business development execution.

What success looks like:

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Develop and socialize a capital markets ecosystem strategy that aligns leadership, product, and commercial stakeholders around priority opportunities.

  • Establish strong working relationships across Product, Ecosystem Partnerships, Business Development, and executive leadership teams.

  • Identify key ecosystem dependencies, market gaps, and strategic partnership opportunities required to accelerate institutional adoption.

  • Build alignment around priority use cases, partnership opportunities, and product requirements needed to support ecosystem growth.

  • Establish an operating cadence with cross-functional stakeholders and define clear ownership across active initiatives.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will:

  • Help bring multiple strategic ecosystem partnerships from concept to execution, creating measurable momentum for Arc within capital markets.

  • Drive new on-chain activity through the successful launch of ecosystem participants, market infrastructure integrations, or institutional use cases.

  • Influence product roadmap priorities that unlock meaningful ecosystem growth and improve the competitiveness of Arc's capital markets offering.

  • Establish repeatable frameworks, partnership structures, and ecosystem development playbooks that enable long-term scale.

  • Build a visible pipeline of future ecosystem opportunities that demonstrate a clear path toward compounding network effects and sustained adoption.

What you'll work on:

  • Define and own the strategic roadmap for Arc's capital markets ecosystem, including market prioritization, ecosystem design, use-case sequencing, and long-term growth strategy.

  • Map and develop end-to-end capital markets value chains, identifying key participants, ecosystem dependencies, market gaps, and opportunities to accelerate institutional adoption.

  • Design and structure innovative commercial partnerships, business models, and economic frameworks that unlock new on-chain capital markets activity.

  • Partner closely with Business Development teams to evaluate, prioritize, and execute strategic partnerships that drive measurable ecosystem growth and network effects.

  • Influence product roadmaps by translating market needs, customer workflows, and ecosystem requirements into actionable product priorities across multiple product organizations.

  • Establish repeatable frameworks, operating models, and partnership playbooks that enable scalable ecosystem expansion and long-term growth.

  • Monitor ecosystem performance, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and market trends to continuously strengthen Arc's position within institutional capital markets.

What you'll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience spanning management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, enterprise partnerships, business development, or related strategic functions.

  • Demonstrated success defining and executing strategy in highly ambiguous, zero-to-one, or emerging-market environments.

  • Proven ability to influence executive leaders and drive alignment across multiple organizations without direct authority.

  • Experience building new business lines, ecosystem strategies, marketplace models, platform businesses, or network-driven growth initiatives.

  • Deep experience structuring complex enterprise partnerships, commercial agreements, and strategic alliances involving significant value exchange.

  • Strong systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to map value chains, identify leverage points, and create scalable growth strategies.

  • Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills with experience engaging senior leaders both internally and externally.

Preferred Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including securities issuance, trading, settlement, custody, market structure, or institutional investing.

  • Experience with tokenization, digital assets, blockchain infrastructure, real-world assets, or emerging financial technologies.

jobs.description:
About LokalIn 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital


About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join our content team. You will be responsible for crafting compelling short-form and mid-length video content across platforms — from social media reels to promotional videos and branded content. This role requires a deep understanding of storytelling, editing trends, platform dynamics, and cultural nuances to create content that drives engagement and delivers impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
  • Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
  • Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
  • Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
  • Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
  • Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
  • Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
  • Edit videos in the required language Telugu, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

Requirements

  • 1–4 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
  • Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
  • Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
  • Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
  • Language proficiency in Telugu and Ability to edit in Telugu with cultural sensitivity and linguistic command.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines.

About ShareGate

ShareGate is the leading Microsoft 365 migration and governance platform, trusted by over 100,000 IT pros for its unmatched simplicity.

Whether migrating from Google Workspace, file shares, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, or tenant-to-tenant, ShareGate gets the job done, without surprises. From cloud transformation to M&A integration, it keeps things just damn simple.

ShareGate also helps organizations stay in control once their data is migrated. Its powerful governance features let users assess environments, uncover issues, and apply fixes on the spot, so everything stays clean, secure, and optimized. It lays the groundwork for safe Microsoft Copilot deployment within organizations.

ShareGate is developed by Workleap Technologies, a Montréal‑based software company.

Your role

ShareGate has built a strong base of named strategic partners across EMEA — but the real growth opportunity lives in the long tail: hundreds of IT resellers and service providers who are knocking on the door without anyone there to bring them in with structure. That's exactly what you'll change.

As Partner Development Manager – EMEA, you'll be the first structured point of contact for new and emerging partners across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. You'll turn early-stage curiosity into real commercial engagement, drive adoption of ShareGate's migration and governance solutions, and build the follow-up discipline that converts conversations into revenue.

Your impact:

  • Convert inbound EMEA partner inquiries into active, revenue-generating partnerships by measurably improving activation rates across non-managed accounts;
  • Drive adoption of ShareGate Protect within the partner ecosystem by opening governance conversations with partners who traditionally focus only on migration;
  • Build a scalable partner development framework — pipeline tracking, re-engagement sequences, progression stages — so no opportunity stalls without a reason;
  • Accelerate transactional onboarding by coordinating with QBS Software, ensuring partners move from initial engagement to first transaction without friction;
  • Reduce time-to-first-transaction by implementing systematic follow-up workflows and consistent outreach discipline across a high volume of active conversations;
  • Integrate AI tools into your daily workflows — drafting follow-ups, summarizing partner calls, analyzing engagement patterns — to cover more partners with more rigour.

Your team

You'll join ShareGate's EMEA Channel team: a tight-knit, commercially ambitious group that operates with high trust, high ownership, and zero ego. Channel Account Managers own named strategic accounts; your job is making sure the broader ecosystem becomes commercially productive. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with the Channel Manager – EMEA, Channel Account Managers, and the QBS Software team for transactional coordination — and collaborate as needed with Technical Sales Specialists, Channel Marketing, and Revenue Operations. Over the next 6–12 months, the mandate is clear: increase inbound conversion, open new conversations around ShareGate Protect, and prove that the non-managed partner base can become a reliable, structured revenue source.

What you'll bring

  • 2–5+ years in partner development, channel sales, or IT solution sales;
  • Experience working with IT resellers or managed service providers — you understand how the indirect channel actually works;
  • Solid understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (migration, governance, tenant-to-tenant — the fundamentals, no certification required);
  • Ability to position technical solutions commercially: you translate complexity into clear business value;
  • Strong follow-up discipline and structured pipeline management — you don't let opportunities die quietly;
  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) daily as a work accelerator — not an experiment, a habit;
  • Bonus: experience in high-volume partner recruitment environments;
  • Bonus: exposure to governance or security-focused SaaS solutions.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $50-60k / OTE: $75 - $90k EUR. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gathering twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

We build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

What You'll Do

You have an important and robust job. You will:

  • Research and draft briefing papers and assemble informational materials, including development and review of data, survey information, technical assistance materials, and protocols modeling new thinking in prosecutive practices
  • Assist FJP staff with information gathering from prosecutors, academics and other subject matter experts in regard to prosecutive best practices, juvenile justice issues, strategies for reducing incarceration, diversion and bail reform, enhancing transparency and accountability, addressing justice system inequities, and fortifying community trust
  • Work with FJP staff to plan, structure, and organize in-person and remote gatherings to enable newly elected prosecutive leaders to learn from each other – and from other experts in the field
  • Work with FJP staff to help develop and conduct interviews, oversee surveys and provide assistance and support to prosecutive leaders who are part of the FJP network
  • Work with FJP staff to help develop, promote and oversee opportunities for academic collaborations
  • Work with FJP staff to help develop and update project management and tracking tools and mechanisms
  • Work with FJP staff to identify and promote other learning opportunities and partnerships that can enhance the ability of FJP prosecutive leaders to learn about and implement new justice system practices and thinking

Who You Are

First and foremost, you have a strong commitment to reforms in prosecution and changes to the criminal legal system and the ability to reimagine the role and function of prosecutive leaders in moving away from past “tough on crime” approaches. Additionally, you have the following background, experience, and skills/abilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, Master’s Degree or equivalent post-graduate degree preferred. However, we value diverse educational and experiential backgrounds. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will also be considered
  • Ability to understand and help support a growing national project focused on reforms of prosecution and of the criminal legal system more broadly
  • Understanding of justice and/or policy reform work
  • Strong writing, research and oral communication skills
  • Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple tasks, and help keep a large national project organized and on track
  • Ability to communicate effectively with, develop credibility among, and gain the confidence of, elected prosecutive leaders and their staffs

What Now?

This role is an extraordinary opportunity to contribute to our mission of justice reform and work with a small but growing creative and dedicated team. If you would like to apply, please submit your cover letter, resume, and a writing sample today. We look forward to hearing from you.

The starting salary for this position is $62,000.

FJP is committed to attracting, developing and retaining exceptional people, and to creating a work environment that is dynamic, rewarding and enables each of us to realize our potential. FJP’s work environment is safe and open to all employees and partners, respecting the full spectrum of race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, political affiliation, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and all other classifications protected by law in the locality and/or state in which you are working.

Women, people of color, LGBTQ candidates, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

Fair and Just Prosecution (FJP) is seeking applications for Research and Policy Fellows. In this role you are responsible for working closely with the executive team and other staff to provide support and assistance to recently elected prosecutive leaders committed to new innovations, enhanced transparency and accountability and moving beyond past incarceration-driven approaches.

You will conduct research, assist with on the ground and remote learning, and draft briefs and other materials to educate these new leaders on issues of importance including strategies for reducing incarceration, promoting diversion and bail reform, enhancing transparency and accountability, addressing justice system racial inequities, and fortifying community trust. You will assist FJP in supporting this network of new leaders, including providing opportunities for them and their staff to learn about best practices, be exposed to reform-oriented national justice thinking and be fortified in their commitment to implement new approaches to promoting healthier and safer communities.

Who We Are

Great strides have been made over the past few years in promoting criminal justice reforms that recognize that prior “tough on crime” and incarceration-driven practices don’t always produce safer or healthier communities. New thinking has started to permeate the justice system and has prompted proactive and prevention-oriented strategies.

Against that backdrop, a new generation of reform-minded state and local elected prosecutors committed to changing their office culture and promoting a less punitive approach to addressing crime has come into office. Recently elected DAs in geographic areas ranging from Los Angeles, St. Louis, and Philadelphia to smaller rural communities are pushing back against the “law and order/tough on crime” rhetoric of past decades and elevating a national conversation around the importance of a fair, equitable and right-sized justice system.

FJP brings together these reform-minded and innovative elected prosecutors as part of a network of leaders committed to promoting a justice system grounded in fairness, equity, compassion, and fiscal responsibility.

jobs.description:
ROLE TITLE

Bookkeeper VA

We are looking for Virtual Professionals based in the Philippines.

You will own the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping for multiple LLCs/business entities, keeping QuickBooks Online, supporting documentation, and financial spreadsheets accurate and current.

This role is execution-heavy: you will enter and code transactions, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, maintain AP/AR records, match documentation to transactions, investigate discrepancies, and prepare books for weekly and month-end review.

You will work within established accounting procedures, the company chart of accounts, and coding standards. When something does not reconcile or a transaction is questionable, you are expected to investigate it within your authorized scope and clearly escalate what cannot be resolved.

This is not a role for someone who needs daily supervision or who is only familiar with basic data entry. Strong QuickBooks Online experience, reconciliation experience, and the ability to independently manage multiple sets of books are required.

Core Responsibilities

QuickBooks & Transaction Management

  • Maintain accurate, current QuickBooks Online records across multiple LLCs/business entities.
  • Enter and categorize transactions using the company's established chart of accounts and coding system rather than creating inconsistent classifications.
  • Record invoices, receipts, payments, deposits, intercompany transactions, and other financial activity with the appropriate supporting documentation.
  • Review entered transactions for missing information, incorrect coding, duplicates, or inconsistencies before they flow into reporting.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation

  • Reconcile assigned bank and credit card accounts against statements and verify that transactions and ending balances agree.
  • Investigate discrepancies when balances or transactions do not match, including checking transaction coding and supporting documentation.
  • Correct discrepancies and miscoded transactions when they fall within your authorized scope.
  • Escalate unresolved, questionable, or potentially incorrect transactions with enough context for management to make a decision rather than simply flagging the issue.

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Maintain AP and AR records by keeping vendor invoices, expenses, payments, deposits, and receivables current.
  • Add and maintain vendor records and keep the vendor list accurate, organized, and current.
  • Reconcile rental income and other expected payments against applicable records or reports.
  • Identify late, missing, or inconsistent payments and report them for management review.
  • Review AP/AR records for missing documentation or transactions that could prevent accurate financial reporting.

Financial Documentation & Recordkeeping

  • Monitor designated email accounts for incoming invoices, receipts, statements, and other bookkeeping documents.
  • Identify which QuickBooks transaction each supporting document belongs to and organize the documentation in the designated cloud storage.
  • Match supporting documents to applicable QuickBooks transactions so records can be located during review or tax preparation.
  • Maintain complete, organized financial records that are usable for bookkeeping and tax support.

Financial Spreadsheets & Reporting

  • Maintain Google Sheets and financial trackers and keep them aligned with QuickBooks records.
  • Update cash flow, deal-related, and other bookkeeping spreadsheets as required.
  • Compare spreadsheet information against QuickBooks and investigate inconsistencies instead of allowing conflicting records to remain.
  • Assist with weekly and month-end Profit & Loss reporting and other financial reports by ensuring the underlying bookkeeping records are complete and accurate.

Month-End Bookkeeping

  • Complete required transaction entries, reconciliations, AP/AR updates, and documentation before the month-end review.
  • Review the books before submission for missing information, discrepancies, duplicate entries, and coding errors.
  • Resolve issues that are within your authorized scope before month-end review.
  • Escalate remaining issues with clear documentation and context.
  • Prepare accurate and complete books for management's final review and close.

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • Strong QuickBooks Online experience — hard requirement.
  • Solid hands-on bookkeeping experience covering transaction entry, bank reconciliation, credit card reconciliation, AP, and AR.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining books for multiple LLCs/business entities.
  • Experience handling intercompany transactions.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and financial spreadsheets.
  • Ability to identify, investigate, and communicate financial discrepancies rather than simply entering data.
  • Ability to consistently follow established accounting procedures, chart-of-accounts structures, and coding standards.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned bookkeeping work without requiring daily reminders or step-by-step direction.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, particularly when managing records across multiple entities.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.
  • High level of honesty, integrity, reliability, and confidentiality when handling financial information.
  • Real estate bookkeeping experience is preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with HUD/settlement statements and real estate transactions is preferred.

Filtering signal: Candidates whose experience is limited to basic accounting data entry, invoicing, payroll support, or administrative bookkeeping without hands-on reconciliation and AP/AR ownership will not meet the minimum bar.

Tools

The role may require regular use of:

  • QuickBooks Online
  • Google Sheets
  • Outlook
  • Dropbox / Google Drive
  • Online Banking Portals
  • Credit Card Portals
  • Asana
  • Canopy

What We Actually Care About

  • You catch problems before they become reporting problems. You notice when a reconciliation does not balance, a transaction is miscoded, documentation is missing, or expected income does not match the records.
  • You can work across multiple sets of books without losing control of the details. Each entity needs to remain properly separated and accurately maintained.
  • You follow the established system instead of creating your own. Consistent coding, documentation, and accounting procedures matter.
  • You investigate before escalating. When something is wrong, you determine what you can verify or correct within your authority and provide useful context when escalation is necessary.
  • You close loops independently. Assigned bookkeeping work should move from transaction entry through reconciliation, documentation, review, and escalation without requiring constant follow-up.
  • You treat financial information as sensitive. Accuracy, confidentiality, honesty, and reliability are operational requirements, not optional personality traits.

What This Role Is NOT

  • Not a basic data-entry position. You are expected to reconcile, review, investigate discrepancies, and maintain accurate books.
  • Not a role for someone who needs daily direction. You will receive established procedures and standards, but you are expected to execute assigned bookkeeping work independently.
  • Not a single-entity bookkeeping role. The position requires maintaining records across multiple LLCs/business entities and handling intercompany transactions.
  • Not a purely administrative accounting role. AP, AR, reconciliations, transaction coding, documentation, and month-end preparation are core responsibilities.
  • Not a role where unresolved issues can simply be left flagged. You must investigate what you can, correct what is within your authority, and escalate unresolved issues with clear context.

Position Details

Work Arrangement: Fully remote

Work Hours: US-aligned work hours

Work Structure: Contractor / Virtual Professional
Environment: Performance-driven, asynchronous, and execution-focused

You will be expected to manage assigned work within agreed deadlines, communicate blockers clearly, and maintain accurate records without relying on constant real-time supervision.

jobs.description:
Mission and Importance of this Role

Wheelhouse has a rich ecosystem of incoming and outgoing integrations with partners. We are at the scale where we require a systematized and streamlined approach to capturing/handling bugs and also more general partnerships asks. A major part of this role will be establishing processes by which integration/partnership issues are raised, tracked and prioritized. This requires interfacing with several internal Wheelhouse teams, as well as with external parters. Sometimes bugs or integration improvements/asks will be addressed by you, and other times you will be responsible for triaging them to the appropriate parties. You will build process flows and internal tooling to help in this endeavor, and to empower non-engineers to investigate some issues themselves.
As we expand into API-first, embedded, and AI-driven integrations, maintaining reliability across our partner ecosystem becomes mission-critical. This role ensures that Wheelhouse operates as a dependable platform, not just a standalone product.

Job Description

Wheelhouse is a revenue management platform for the $500B+ flex rental space. Our technology empowers short & mid-length stay operators, who manage single-family homes, apartment buildings, and (in some cases) hotels - a broad & massive addressable market. Wheelhouse believes a more flexible & connected world is both inevitable & important, and we build technology to make sure the businesses that enable this lifestyle & society can thrive.
As a team, we enjoy shipping products our partners love, on time or ahead of schedule, while balancing work/life & having fun together. We’re best described as transparent & collaborative, and we strive to set our teammates up for success - both professionally & personally. We’re a remote-first, work-anywhere, and “yes - you should make time for that adventure/vacation” company, who believes that “healthy hustle” is the key to good growth.
Now, we’re looking for a Partnership Support Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering, partnerships, and platform operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring our external integrations — including APIs, embedded experiences, and partner platforms — are reliable, scalable, and easy to operate.
You will investigate integration issues, debug complex cross-system behavior, collaborate directly with partner technical teams, and either resolve problems yourself or triage effectively to internal engineers. Over time, you will build tools, diagnostics, and automation that enable both our team and partner teams to operate independently and efficiently.
This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems across organizational boundaries, communicating with external technical stakeholders, and improving system reliability at ecosystem scale.

We’re looking for someone who

  • 3–5 years of experience in a QA engineering or software engineering role.
  • Strong debugging skills across APIs, integrations, and web applications.
  • Experience with programming (ideally Ruby on Rails) to automate tasks and build internal tools.
  • Experience with SQL or ORMs (ideally Active Record) to interact with data
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
  • Experience working with external technical stakeholders and can exhibit strong communication skills.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity across multiple systems you do not control
  • Ability to analyze distributed failures across APIs, webhooks, queues, and data pipelines
  • Experience reading third-party documentation and diagnosing integration mismatches
  • Familiarity with SLAs, incident communication, and cross-company coordination
  • Familiarity with Datadog for analyzing metrics is a plus
  • Experience handling incidents involving external stakeholders
  • Comfort communicating during production issues or degraded service
  • Ability to reason about complex distributed systems and failure modes
  • Experience troubleshooting data synchronization or event-driven systems
  • Experience creating documentation regarding process engineering development.
  • Bonus: Experience supporting B2B SaaS integrations or developer platforms

What you'll be doing

  • Engineer process solutions around incoming integration/partnerships bugs, improvements and asks.
  • Debug integration issues involving external partners(PMSs, OTAs, channel managers, and embedded clients), coordinating directly with their technical teams when necessary
  • Diagnose failures across APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, and synchronization processes
  • Resolve issues directly when possible; otherwise triage effectively with clear reproduction steps and cross-system context
  • Build internal diagnostics, dashboards, and tooling to enable faster investigation of partner issues
  • Create reusable playbooks and runbooks for common integration failure modes
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and observability for partner-facing systems
  • Support launches of new integrations, embedded deployments, or platform features
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison for select strategic partners
  • Identify systemic reliability risks and advocate for engineering improvements
  • Act as the voice of our partner ecosystem within engineering and product teams

Why Join Us

  • Become the technical bridge between our engineering team and a growing ecosystem of partners
  • Directly influence the reliability and scalability of a platform used by thousands of properties worldwide
  • Work on real distributed-system problems spanning multiple companies
  • Opportunity to grow into an integrations lead, platform reliability engineer, or partner engineering leader
  • Collaborative small-team environment where your impact is highly visible

Perks and Benefits

  • The expected base salary range for this position is between $136,000 - $152,000 depending on experience.
  • Competitive salary, cash bonus potential and equity
  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits for each US employee
  • Fidelity 401k available for each US employee
  • Unlimited PTO
  • And…more!

About Us:

Wheelhouse is a fintech platform for the $500B+ flex rental space. Most specifically, we enable short & mid-length stay providers with 1 to 100,000+ listings to earn 20%+ more from their rental properties.
In 2021, our target customer segment voted our platform“Innovation of the Year” at the Data & Revenue Management conference. This sentiment is shared by our customers, as evidenced by our platforms low churn and rapidly growing ARPU. In 2022, we closed a significant funding round, with participation from many of the best tech, travel & real estate investors. We’re lucky to have a long runway, low burn, and rapidly growing revenue.
As a team, we enjoy shipping products our customers love, on time or ahead of schedule, while balancing work/life & having fun together. We’re best described as transparent & collaborative, and we strive to set our teammates up for success - both professionally & personally. We’re a remote-first, work-anywhere, and“yes - you should make time for that adventure/vacation” company, who believes that“healthy hustle” is the key to good growth.
We’re experienced business & product builders who have founded multiple companies together, know our category extremely well, and recognize how rare/special it is to be perfectly positioned around a big opportunity with a very strong cross-functional team.
We’d be eager to say hello and learn more about you!

We are an independent software vendor. We build and support the software, and the channel sells it, with qualified partners also installing, delivering and supporting deployments for their own clients. That model shapes almost every role here: the people we hire spend their time making partners and customers successful rather than pushing paper through a direct sales funnel.

jobs.description:
About us:

Planner 5D is a global hub for home design, uniting over 100+ million users in 230 territories around our planet (yes, we have 2 users connecting from Antarctica each month!). Our platform simplifies the home renovation process from concept to execution, and this process has never been more straightforward with our cutting-edge software. You don't need to be a professional designer to enhance your home or workspace. We are dedicated to streamlining the design experience, making the customization of dream homes accessible to everyone.
Our cross-platform presence spans Web, iOS, Android, Windows, and MacOS, ensuring seamless synchronization for our users. Planner 5D is more than just software; it's a vibrant community of enthusiastic and product-oriented professionals. From diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates across time zones, fueled by a shared passion to revolutionize the home design market.
We are constantly looking for like-minded talent eager to take ownership and drive innovation within our expanding suite of tools. Join us in shaping the future of home design.
We are looking for an expert in SEO/GEO to lead our brand towards even better visibility for our potential customers and already existing users.

You will lead all SEO/GEO activities, including content, keyword, and link-building strategies to maximize brand visibility and drive traffic from both traditional search engines and AI answer engines across multiple languages.

Our team is fully hands on, independent and very much grounded to the core of the business. We tend to do and experiment, rather than wait and discuss for too long.

If it sounds like your story - please apply.

Key responsibilities:

  • Track, report, and analyze traffic performance
  • Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
  • Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
  • Optimize copy and landing pages for search/answer engine marketing
  • Research and analyze competitor websites and activities
  • Develop and implement link building strategy
  • Work closely with the development team to ensure SEO/GEO best practices are properly implemented in newly developed code
  • Lead content creation and content programming
  • Recommend and implement where applicable changes to website architecture, content, linking and other factors to improve SEO/GEO positions for target keywords

Requirements:

  • Proven SEO/GEO experience with international brands (3+ years)
  • Proven list of projects for GEO
  • Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
  • In-depth experience with website analytics tools (e.g, GA, GSC, Data Studio, WebTrends, Semrush, etc)
  • Knowledge of ranking factors, search engine algorithms, answer engines algorithms
  • Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO, GEO, SEM
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript development and constraints
  • Proficiency conducting keyword analysis and research across multiple markets and languages
  • Upper-Intermediate level of English. Additional languages, especially French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese are a big advantage
  • Daily use of coding tools

What we offer:

- Great work environment that balances freedom and responsibility
- Our team is made up of friendly and passionate enthusiasts who are eager to help and share their knowledge
- We believe in work-life balance, so you'll receive around 30+ days of paid holidays per year
- Company computer equipment by request
- Education courses for our team members, and we're willing to allocate funds toward your training expenses
- English classes on our corporate platform
- Offline company events in Lithuania and online team-building
- Unlimited free Planner5D subscriptions

jobs.description:
Job Family

Procurement

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Serve as the primary functional owner of our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform and related procurement technologies. Serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, sourcing teams, legal, risk, TPRM, technology, suppliers, and platform providers. Drive operational excellence, lead contract intake and governance processes, manage vendor relationships, support technology enhancements, and ensure the stability and optimization of procurement systems. Act as the primary point of contact for CLM strategy, platform administration, business requirements, escalations, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and continuous improvement initiatives.

Job Description

Responsibilities


• Serve as the primary administrator and business owner of the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. Escalation point for platform issues and operational disruptions.

• Manage platform configuration, workflows, templates, clause libraries, user access, and governance controls.

• Lead system enhancements, upgrades, releases, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform optimization.

• Partner with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Risk, TPRM, IT, and business stakeholders to improve contracting processes and user experience.

• Act as the primary point of contact for contract intake, routing, approvals, escalations, and stakeholder support.

• Ensure contracts follow established governance requirements based on risk, supplier type, spend thresholds, and business needs.

• Manage system integrations and data flow between CLM, procurement, and related technology platforms.

• Gather business and technical requirements and lead testing efforts for integrations, enhancements, releases and defect remediation.

• Develop reporting and dashboards; analyze contract cycle times, intake volumes, bottlenecks, supplier activity, and operational performance.

• Lead issue resolution, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives while recommending new platform capabilities and enhancements.


Qualifications


• Bachelor's degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Finance, or related field or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant work experience

• 5+ years of experience in Procurement, Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Contract Management, or Supply Chain

• Strong knowledge of contract lifecycle processes and procurement operations

• Hands-on CLM administration experience

• Experience supporting contingent workforce, statement of work (SOW), and supplier engagement processes

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into system solutions

• Strong experience managing system integrations and cross-functional technology initiatives

• Demonstrated experience leading vendor management and governance activities

• Experience supporting system incidents, escalations, and production issue resolution

• Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills


Preferred Qualifications


• Sirion Labs CLM expertise

• Power BI and reporting expertise

• Knowledge of supplier management, third-party risk, and contract compliance programs

• Experience supporting procurement transformation initiatives

• PMP, CPSM, CPSP, Certified Procurement Professional, or similar certification


Working Conditions

• Remote work environment


he Salary for this position generally ranges between $94,000.00- $124,000.00 annually. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.



What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

Compensation Benefits

  • Competitive Pay

  • Bonus for Eligible Employees

Benefits Package

  • Pension Plan

  • 401k Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Disability Insurance

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Employee Discounts

  • Career Training & Development Opportunities

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.

  • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).

  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars

  • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.

  • Adoption Assistance

  • PTO for Volunteer Hours

  • Employee Matching Gifts Program

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

 

Transamerica’s Parent Company 

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. About Us

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software.

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

  • BYOD reimbursement

Embedded AI Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Embedded AI Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an Embedded AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. The ideal candidate has shipped edge AI in production environments where compute, memory, energy, and connectivity constraints fundamentally shape the engineering trade-offs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement edge AI solutions optimized for diverse hardware including mobile SoCs, NPUs, and embedded accelerators.
  • Apply quantization, pruning, distillation, and architectural optimization to fit models within edge constraints.
  • Tune model performance for latency, energy efficiency, and memory footprint on target hardware.
  • Build cross-platform inference runtimes leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, and Core ML.
  • Optimize models for specific accelerator backends including DSPs, NPUs, and mobile GPUs.
  • Implement on-device model update, versioning, and rollback workflows that allow safe staged rollouts to large device populations and rapid recovery if a model release behaves unexpectedly in the field.
  • Design hybrid edge-cloud architectures that gracefully degrade based on connectivity and device capability.
  • Build telemetry pipelines that respect privacy while enabling continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to align AI capabilities with device constraints.
  • Implement secure execution paths, model protection, and integrity verification on edge devices.
  • Develop benchmarking suites that characterize accuracy, latency, and energy trade-offs across devices.
  • Drive responsible AI considerations including on-device privacy and bias evaluation.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Stay current with edge AI hardware and software developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in ML engineering, with significant work on edge or mobile AI.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience with model compression, quantization, and pruning techniques.
  • Experience with at least one major edge inference framework.
  • Solid understanding of mobile and embedded hardware architectures.
  • Experience deploying ML models to production on mobile or embedded platforms.
  • Strong performance engineering and profiling skills.
  • Familiarity with on-device privacy and security considerations.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with custom NPU or DSP toolchains.
  • Familiarity with federated learning or on-device personalization.
  • Exposure to safety-critical or industrial edge deployments.
  • Open-source contributions to edge AI frameworks.
  • Experience optimizing LLMs for on-device inference.
